author: Unknown
title: Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi'nde siber saldırı duyurusu: 140 bin öğrencinin verisi çalınmış olabilir
content:
Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi'nde (YTÜ) 1 Ekim'den bu yana yaşanan sistem aksaklıklarının arkasından siber saldırı çıktı. Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurulu'nun (KVKK) 7 Ekim tarihli kararıyla üniversitedeki veri ihlali resmi olarak kamuoyuna duyuruldu. Yaşanan siber saldırı ve veri ihlalinden yaklaşık 140 bin öğrenci ile 4 bin 500 personelin etkilendiği belirtildi.

Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi'nde altyapı sorunu: Öğrenciler çevrimiçi derslere erişemiyor

Üniversitenin resmi internet sitesi, Öğrenci Bilgi Sistemi (OBS), Online Yıldız ve çeşitli başvuru sistemlerine günlerce erişim sağlanamazken, üniversite yönetiminin yaşanan aksaklıklara ilişkin ilk etapta kapsamlı bir açıklama yapmadığı görüldü. Yönetim, 3 Ekim'de yaptığı ilk duyuruda süreci yalnızca "teknik çalışma" olarak nitelendirmişti. Ancak KVKK'nın devreye girmesiyle birlikte sistem kesintilerinin arkasında bir fidye yazılımı saldırısının olduğu netlik kazandı.

Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurulu’nun yayımladığı duyuruda "Veri sorumlusu sıfatını haiz Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi tarafından Kurula iletilen veri ihlal bildiriminde özetle; ihlalin 01.10.2026 tarihinde başladığı ve aynı gün tespit edildiği, veri sorumlusunun sanallaştırma altyapısı ve üzerinde çalışan sunucuların fidye yazılımı saldırısından etkilendiği, ihlalden etkilenen ilgili kişi grubunun öğrenci, personel ve ziyaretçiler olduğu, mevcut kayıtlara göre ihlalden etkilenmiş olabilecek ilgili kişi sayısının yaklaşık 140.000 öğrenci ve 4.500 personel olduğu, ziyaretçilere ilişkin sayının henüz belirlenemediği, ihlalden etkilenen kişisel veri kategorilerinin belirlenemediği bilgilerine yer verilmiştir" ifadeleri kullanıldı.

Öğrencilerin hangi kişisel verilerinin siber saldırıdan etkilendiği ve dışarı sızdırıldığı konusundaki belirsizlikler ise hâlâ devam ediyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Brian Hioe
title: What Did China Intend to Accomplish Through Surveilling Lai Ching-te’s Son?
content:
THE FBI HAS arrested a woman, Wanying “Heather” Zhang, for acting as an unregistered foreign agent of China. In particular, Zhang’s arrest occurred because she was apparently conducting surveillance on Lai Ting-yu, the son of President Lai Ching-te.

Lai’s family generally keeps a low public profile. Lai, who is in his 30s, is thought to work for electronics manufacturer Philips and to have a young child. Zhang is accused of traveling to Seattle from Los Angeles and renting a vehicle to surveil Lai’s home along with an accomplice.

Zhang is accused of being in contact with a Chinese handler through WeChat, as well as other individuals she knew were Chinese government officials. Zhang worked as a real estate agent and was detained as she was about to board a flight for Shanghai. It is possible, then, that Zhang could be a civilian recruited by China, or that the Chinese government has continued with its practice of employing “disposable” agents.

It is unclear what China hoped to gain from surveilling Lai, who was not likely to have any sensitive government information. Nevertheless, one aim could be to threaten, by putting Lai and his family members living abroad on edge, and to warn of the potential repercussions of going against China. If China wished to broadcast that it was aware of Lai Ting-yu’s whereabouts and could potentially threaten him, this could be used for leverage over Lai, or to blackmail him. China might also seek to project power, in suggesting that it is omnipresent and all-reaching, such that it can surveil and threaten relatives of Taiwanese politicians abroad.

Otherwise, it is possible that China aimed to obtain political ammo from surveilling Lai’s son. The presence of Lai’s son in the US, for example, could be used to suggest that Lai himself may push for strengthening defense against China, but that his own children live in the US, and that Lai would potentially abandon Taiwan in wartime.

Indeed, even if the daughter of Chinese President Xi Jinping is also thought to live in the US, the presence of Lai’s children in the US has been used as a political attack for some time by the KMT. More generally, Taiwanese politicians who have children in the US, or who may have potentially held Green Cards or US passports in the past, have been used to attack them with the allegation that they plan to abandon Taiwan in wartime.

More generally, one notes that the Chinese government has been increasingly willing to target relatives of Taiwanese politicians. DPP legislator Puma Shen’s father has been sanctioned, for example, due to owning a car parts company in China. It is possible that there are other cases in which relatives of Taiwanese politicians have already been threatened, but which have not necessarily come to light.

author: Mike Ludwig
title: Progressives and Republicans Introduce Competing Bills to Rein In Flock Cameras
content:
The Ban Flock Act aims to slow the rise of Flock-style cameras amid rising fears about AI mass surveillance.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Republicans and Democrats in Congress have introduced competing legislation to rein in the government’s use of Flock cameras and other automated license plate readers (ALPRs) following widespread abuses by police and intense public backlash to the powerful surveillance technology.

ALPRs allow police to track vehicles and their drivers across expansive areas by using a variety of easily searchable data points from images captured by the cameras. The Ban Flock Act, backed by some Democrats and progressives, would halt federal funding to slow the rise of AI-powered surveillance nationwide. A competing GOP bill creates legal guardrails for police when using ALPR data but would not “ban” license plate surveillance by the federal government.

Introduced on October 2 by Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vermont), Sen. Jeff Merkley (D-Oregon), and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-New York), the Ban Flock Act would prevent federal funds from being used to purchase ALPRs, including but not limited to Flock cameras. In order to incentivize a “moratorium” on the use of ALPRs by local police, only state and local governments with laws or policies in place to prohibit the use of ALPRs could continue receiving financial assistance from several federal entities, including from the Departments of Justice, Homeland Security, Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Health and Human Services.

The bill would also ban the use of both ALPRs and the data gathered by them at the federal level while creating a legal avenue for lawsuits against the federal government over privacy violations.

However, the legislation would not place an outright ban on the use of Flock and similar cameras attached to license plate analytics software, nor would it ban the use of AI-powered surveillance systems by local governments and private actors. The Ban Flock Act would also allow Congress to pass legislation allowing police to use ALPRs for a specific purpose with privacy restrictions, including deleting data after 48 hours. ALPRs used to collect tolls are exempt from the bill.

Speaking at an event in Bakersfield, California, on October 5, Sanders linked Flock cameras to the controversial rapid advances in AI. While the AI systems that enhance ALPR surveillance are not the most controversial frontier models still in development, AI-powered search engines made by Flock Safety and its competitors to analyze data collected by ALPRs make the systems much more powerful.

When asked by Sanders if they had heard of AI data centers and Flock cameras, the crowd booed.

“We are looking at the possibility [of] the evisceration of privacy rights in America,” Sanders said.

Flock Safety is the leading manufacturer of ALPRs along with competitors such as Axon and Motorola Solutions, which some cities are turning to as the Flock brand becomes increasingly controversial. With an estimated 120,000 ALPRs installed nationwide, Flock’s cameras alone record and analyze about 20 billion images of vehicles each month. The anti-surveillance group DeFlock has mapped more than 143,000 ALPR cameras across the lower 48 states.

ALPRs are not new, but the technology has advanced rapidly in recent years and is often integrated with AI, allowing police to effortlessly search for vehicles and people without needing to enter a license plate number. ALPRs capture images of each passing vehicle, recording location, date, and time, as well as the vehicle’s make, model, color, and identifying features such as dents, roof racks, and bumper stickers, and then turn these into searchable data points.

For example, when police in Lenexa, Kansas, put a local activist under ALPR surveillance in 2025 after he wrote an op-ed criticizing city officials and was investigated in connection to a petty vandalism case, they were able to easily track his grocery shopping habits and even identify his shoes, according to internal records.

In a statement, Ocasio-Cortez said the widespread integration of AI-powered cameras into everyday life is “unconscionable.”

“Across the country, Big Tech companies like Flock Safety have built a mass surveillance system to harvest Americans’ private and personal data without their consent,” Ocasio-Cortez said on October 2. “AI-powered cameras are …

author: Isaac Nellist
title: Lizzie O’Shea: ‘Surveillance technology is a threat to democracy’
content:
Lizzie O’Shea, a writer, lawyer and founder of Digital Rights Watch, told the New South Wales Council for Civil Liberties’ (NSWCCL) annual fundraising dinner and journalism awards on October 1 that rapidly developing surveillance technology is throwing up many challenges.

Digital technology and democracy are in a “significant amount of tension”, O’Shea said. She added that defending civil liberties is not about “clever people working to impose civil liberties on everybody else”, but that campaigners “have to convince a critical mass that they have to defend their own rights”.

Referencing the origins of professional policing in London in the late 18th century, she described it as “a period of immense technological disruption”, as the Industrial Revolution was reshaping society.

The new police force, O’Shea said, was used to “monitor, enforce and impose the new conditions of social order”. Specifically, it ensured merchants’ profits and prevented dockworkers from supplementing their wages by pilfering stock. The idea was to get the state and industry to collaborate, with a “form of surveillance of everyday people”.

“Policing was talked about as a new science in the detection and prevention of crime,” she said. The spectacle of force “offered an economical and effective way of maintaining order”.

O’Shea said it helps explain the state’s decisions in the digital age. “Like their historical counterparts, modern police understand the power of surveillance in enforcing a form of discipline.

“‘Safety’ is about preserving social order, rather than reducing harm. By allowing law enforcement and intelligence agencies to tell us what is safe, we allow them to use technology in increasingly oppressive ways.

“Rapid technological advances have been accompanied by disruptive transformations in social relations, and an acceleration of policing has often been a response.”

O’Shea described advances in technology in the 21st century as being “a fundamental threat” to democracy. She said more than 100 “security” bills have been passed over the past two decades, connected to surveillance, national intelligence agencies and law enforcement, and 875 new offences have been created.

Many have sought to repurpose existing systems of corporate surveillance for state surveillance, while surveillance technology companies receive lucrative government contracts.

O’Shea also said Labor has “effectively abandoned” regulation of artificial intelligence (AI) and facial recognition technology.

“Less than 10% of Australians think it’s reasonable for a retailer to ask for your biometric information to access their services, but on an almost daily basis they will experience this.

“Everyone is telling us that AI is fundamentally important — politicians, the financial markets, a media that takes industry sources as truth — but a study by the University of Melbourne found that Australians are among the least optimistic in the world about artificial intelligence.

“More people are concerned about the negative outcomes than the benefits … 87% would be more inclined to trust and use AI products if international standards were in place to protect them.”

O’Shea pointed to the campaign to remove Palantir from Coles stores and the defeat of a data centre proposal in Lane Cove as examples of where most people’s attitudes lie.

“The hand of power is seeking to crush us, but we have the capacity to land a counterpunch,” she said. “This is the time for organisers, agitators, lawyers, ratbags and policy nerds to work together to build an alternative future where civil liberties are protected and our democracy can flourish.”

NSWCCL president Timothy Roberts told the gathering that the NSWCCL aimed to be an “ever-watchful guardian” of civil liberties, noting the huge challenges. He referenced last year’s March for Humanity, across the Sydney Harbour Bridge, when 300,000 people marched to protest Israel’s genocide in Gaza and demand that Labor act.

“It felt like the flame of liberty could not burn brighter or stronger — we must continue to celebrate that occasion as an example of the collective exercise of our human rights,” Roberts said.

The NSWCCL’s journalism awards went to Guardian journalists Ariel Bogle and Nino Bucci for uncovering the use of “less-lethal” weapons by police. Star Observer journalist Jacques Nieuwoudt won the young journalist award for his coverage of police raids of LGBTIQ spaces on Oxford Street.

author: Sofia Little
title: Get the Flock Out
content:
On September 23rd, the Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Crime and Counterterrorism held a hearing titled “Always Watching: Flock’s Nationwide AI Surveillance Network,” examining the privacy risks, data sharing, and misuse of private automated license plate reader (ALPR) networks.

The hearing was chaired by Sen. Hawley (R-MO) and featured five witnesses, including Lindsey Isaacs, a wrongfully accused driver, Alasdair Whitney from Legislative Counsel Institute for Justice, Sheriff Ross Teeple, Benn Jordan, a self-proclaimed “hacker”, and policy counsel analyst Chad Marlow from the ACLU, where they have coined a campaign called “Get the Flock Out.”

The hearing highlighted pertinent concerns about how ALPR technology can be used and shared. Public concern about Flock cameras has also grown in recent months. A September 2026 Navigator Research survey found that 62% of registered voters were concerned about Flock camera use, including 66% of Democrats, 55% of Republicans, and 70% of Independents.

Flock Safety was founded in 2017 by CEO Garrett Langley, operating as a small startup meant to provide ALPR cameras to homeowners associations and neighborhoods looking to reduce petty theft and local property crimes. Now, it has grown into something alarmingly dystopian: an AI powered network of over 120,000 cameras across 49 states that photograph, scan, tag, and log every driver that passes, whether or not they are suspected of any crime.

License plate reader technologies have existed since the 1970s, in the form of speed, toll, and red-light cameras. These are only triggered by a specific action, such as running a red-light or driving through a toll booth, and only track license plate numbers. The entry of venture capitalist funding and advanced AI technology into the mass surveillance industry has transformed these automatic traffic enforcement cameras into a complex web of invasive surveillance tools.

During the hearing, ACLU’s Mr. Chad Marlow argued that companies operating ALPR systems are profiting from the collection and sharing of information about people’s movements. The ACLU has called for greater limits on how ALPR data can be collected, accessed, and shared.

Privacy concerns extend to how ALPR data can affect people seeking reproductive health care. During the hearing, Sen. Booker (D-NJ) raised concerns that states could use ALPR technology to track people traveling to obtain reproductive care. The concern comes amid documented cases of law enforcement using vehicle surveillance systems to investigate people seeking or suspected of seeking abortion care.

Unfortunately, this ‘hypothetical’ scenario has become the reality for women across the country.

Witnesses Alaster Whitney and Sheriff Ross Teeple both testified about the overreach of Flock’s ALPRs, with Whitney highlighting jurisdiction concerns which police officers have already been accused of taking advantage of.

In Texas, a sheriff’s deputy used 83,000 Flock ALPRs to track a woman who allegedly performed a self-administered abortion, at the behest of her abusive partner. In Massachusetts, a police officer used Flock networks to stalk a former romantic partner who said she had changed her identity to escape from his abuse. In Kentucky, a police officer was accused of searching his child’s mother 1,000 times through Flock’s network, though she has a protective order. The Institute for Justice has catalogued more than 200 incidents of these ALPR abuses, including romantic stalking, wrongful stops and detentions, non-law enforcement use and other types of misconduct.

These encroachments do not just stop here, as Sen. Padilla (D-CA) spotlights the use of loopholes within Flock, which ICE officers take advantage of to track immigrant communities. While Flock has guaranteed no direct access to the Border Patrol subagency, Witness Marlow points out all it takes is one sympathetic person connected to ICE for the agency to obtain access to billions of pictures of citizens, including facial properties.

Concerns about ALPR surveillance have crossed traditional political lines. During the hearing, Sen. Hawley noted that supporters of the Second Amendment have “long feared national databases of any kind.” This has drawn criticism from across the political spectrum highlighting the bipartisan opposition.

While Flock operates as a leading company which produces ALPRs, they are not the sole producers. Companies like Axon and Motorola have slowly begun increasing …

Open Source Is Not the Same Thing as Liberation

Open Source Is a Tool, Not a Commandment

There is a peculiar form of ideological dogmatism that has emerged within parts of the FOSS movement. Even in anarchist circles, some people seem to believe that opposition to intellectual property must take precedence over virtually every other ethical consideration. After all, if copyright, patents, and other forms of intellectual property are inherently illegitimate, then any attempt to place limits on how the things we create are used or distributed must necessarily be reactionary, right? Even when those limits are intended to protect workers, creators, and wider communities from exploitation by capital?

Anarchists do not seek to abolish one particular category of property while leaving other relations of domination untouched. Nor do we advocate stripping workers of control over the fruits of their labor in the name of an ideological dogma that ultimately has little to do with fostering anarchism.

The rise of so-called “generative AI” has made this contradiction impossible to ignore. My recent essay on this technology was criticized by some open-source diehards because, in their view, no one has the right to restrict the flow of information — even when that flow gushes directly from the minds and labor of workers and creatives into the bulging bank accounts of Silicon Valley billionaires.

To be clear: I am not opposed to free and open-source software. The forum I run (Raddle.me) was built on software (Postmill) that my cofounder released into the commons from the outset under a FOSS license. Even when fascists forked her code to spread hate and harassment, and when a scummy developer violated the license and tried to pass her work off as his own for profit, we did not respond by retreating behind a closed-source license. As anti-authoritarians and anti-capitalists, we certainly could have justified doing so when her work was being used to harm marginalized communities and enrich capitalists, but the license was kept open.

The same principle applies to my own writing. I release all of my essays freely, and I give zine-makers permission to reprint them without restriction. I believe in sharing knowledge and making creative work accessible. People have the option to donate to support my work if they want to. What I oppose is capital taking that generosity, enclosing it within a for-profit ecosystem, and turning it into another mechanism for extracting wealth from the people who created it.

This is not an argument that copyright is inherently liberatory. It is an argument that the abolition of intellectual property is not, by itself, liberation.

I feel compelled to take a stand against the increasingly rigid open-source absolutism that has taken hold in parts of the milieu: against the ruling class taking our collective knowledge, privatizing it, and selling it back to us. I do not consider this a pro-IP argument, but I’m sure plenty of people will disagree. It is an argument against AI slop …

author: subMedia en español
title: Terrni un Centímetro en Territorio No Cedido
content:
Existe un movimiento creciente de supremacistas blancos que niegan el genocidio en el  territorio llamado Canadá.


El 27 de septiembre, integrantes de los Second Sons, una milicia nacionalista blanca, marcharon por territorio no cedido de los Secwépemc, llevando pancartas racistas, cerca del sitio de una antigua escuela residencial donde en 2021 se descubrieron fosas comunes de niñas y niños indígenas.


Esta acción tuvo lugar tres días antes del Día Nacional de la Verdad y la Reconciliación, un intento deficiente y limitado de reconocer el genocidio de los pueblos indígenas de Canadá.


Los Second Sons están estrechamente vinculados al llamado movimiento de los «Active Clubs» y haber llamado a expulsar de Canadá a las personas no blancas a punta de pistola[canon?].


Los Secwépemc tienen una larga historia de resistencia al colonialismo canadiense, incluido el enfrentamiento de Gustafsen Lake en 1995 y, más recientemente, el movimiento Tiny House Warriors, surgido en resistencia al proyecto del oleoducto Trans Mountain.


La supremacía blanca es inherente al colonialismo.


Les anarquistas tenemos una responsabilidad particular de apoyar la soberanía indígena y confrontar a los nacionalistas blancos allí donde asomen sus horribles cabezas.


Organícense. Júntense. Enfrenten la supremacía blanca en todas sus formas.

author: groundxero
title: Barricades, Internet Shutdown, Mass Detentions: Delhi Police Violent Crack Down on Protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar and SIR
content:
Thousands of protesters gathered around Delhi’s Jantar Mantar on 2 October, defying the denial of police permission and a sweeping security clampdown imposed to prevent the protests from taking place. Barricades sealed the designated protest site from all four directions, mobile internet was suspended across central Delhi, several Metro stations were shut, and riot-control forces were deployed in large numbers. What followed was a day of mass detentions, many involving the use of force against women, students, journalists and other protesters. The violent crackdown came amid a renewed call for mobilisation for a ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ and ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demands for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, with organisers calling the 2 October action only the beginning of a wider protest movement.


 


New Delhi, 2 October 2026


by

Mouli Sharma


 


“Thousand is a lowballed estimate,” said a lawyer’s group called

Lawyers for Detainees

, one of several such collectives formed after the historic protests that shook the national capital a mere three months ago after uproar against repeated failures and irregularities in the conduct of public examinations under the tenure of former Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Now, recent history is attempting to recreate itself as a similar uproar against the government’s Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, and the recent revelations of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s alleged role in the same has led to widespread national outrage.


 


“85 people have been detained in this station alone,” said Adv. Surya Prakash, who was present at the Badarpur police station. “We have reports that at least 20 buses filled with detainees left the protest site during the day. Many detainees were released informally at random locations far away from the centre of the city, while still more were taken to stations like this one. The actual number of detentions is much higher than whatever numbers will be produced here at the stations,” he said.


 


The figure, though, may include repeat detentions, the most prominent case being of AISA president Neha Bora herself, who was detained at least three times from the same location outside the Royal Plaza Hotel, near the East entrance of the protest site near the Kerala Bhawan canteen, first alongside psephologist and activist Yogendra Yadav, a second time with several student protesters of other parties, and a third time again with fellow AISA leader Anjali of the Delhi University. Former Delhi CM Atishi, independent journalist Harsh Yadav, and at least 700 more students were detained through the day.


 


“700 is the count we have so far from police stations taken across the city,” said Adv. Vertika Mani, also a part of the lawyers’ collective. “But that obviously cannot account for the many detainees who were released at unofficial locations.”


 


The CJP’s ultimatum to the government of witnessing a ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ should Gyanesh Kumar fail to resign within 48 hours (given on 25 September, the deadline for which had long since passed) kicked off with a bang on Friday, as an identical call for the police-defying protest in Shivaji Park, Mumbai was given by countless student, labour, farmer and other political organisations at the eponymous Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, led by prominent activists including Neha Bora, Yogendra Yadav, Nandita Narain, and Prashant Bhushan. Hundreds of civilians took to the streets on the morning of 2 October, on the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, only to be met with armed state forces deployed in massive numbers and a once-designated protest site cut off from their access through curfews (Section 163 of the BNS was declared in the region, without any justification beyond prevention of a ‘crowd forming’) and police barricades blockading entrances to the site from all four directions, dispersing protesters across a wide 2km radius.


 


What followed was a circus of media, police, and protester, as for four hours following the 11 am time given for the assembly, bus after bus was filled with peaceful protesters ‘detained’ under the simple justification of following ‘orders from above’. At least one protester, a young man named Roveen from the All India Students’ Association (AISA) (of whom Neha Bora is national president), was grievously assaulted by the police and had to be taken to a …

Avec toute cette propagande en faveur de la guerre, qu'en est-il de l'impact sur nos vies personnelles

La politique «

 

d'économie de guerre

 

» lancée par Emmanuel Macron ne consiste pas uniquement à produire plus d'armes. C'est un projet de société qui va toucher l'ensemble de la population. Basé sur une lecture attentive des documents officiels, le livre "Economie de guerre - Leur feuille de route et la nôtre" de Loïc Fournil alerte sur les dangers de la militarisation de nos existences et donne des pistes d'action pour enrayer la course à la guerre.


Vous pouvez en retrouver un court extrait ici :

https://www.lemondealenvers.lautre.net/doc/economie_de_guerre_extrait.pdf


L'objectif de ces causeries, inspirées des causeries du 19

e

 siècle, est de créer un espace social, où l'on peut échanger en dehors du cadre du travail ou du cadre amical/familial, faire société ensemble. C'est un espace où on peut confronter nos idées et nos arguments et y politiser nos vies, face à un système qui nous pousse de plus en plus à en être passif. Chacun.e y est légitime pour prendre la parole, ou simplement écouter. Chacun.e y est légitime pour modérer la parole, dans une organisation sans hiérarchie, une organisation anarchiste. Vous pouvez amener quelques victuailles à partager lors des causeries. Aussi bien à manger qu'à boire, même si le bar est ouvert

title: Trump Administration, Accused of Crimes Against Humanity, Sanctions Entire ICC
content:
Officials announced the sanctions just hours after the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to a former ICC judge.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Trump administration officials, facing numerous allegations of war crimes in its actions ranging from Iran to Cuba, issued punishing sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC) on Friday that threaten the future of the entire body and its work to hold war criminals and genocidaires to account.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio, fresh off of his ultra-nationalist speech at the Acropolis this week, said in a video announcing the sanctions that the U.S. is banning “transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate against us.”

The sanctions are slated to cut the court off from using U.S.-based financial services, companies, and even the U.S. dollar after six months — a move that is ruinous for the court’s officials, as the global financial system is highly dependent on the U.S. dollar.

The administration announced the sanctions just hours after Navi Pillay, who was formerly the UN’s human rights chief and an ICC judge, was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. Last year, Pillay led the independent UN commission that declared genocide in Gaza. The prize announcement incensed President Donald Trump, who reposted a message saying that the Nobel Committee “shamed itself beyond repair” on Truth Social.

The ICC warned that the sanctions are unprecedented, and called on its 125 member states to fight back against the U.S.’s actions.

“It is an attempt to obstruct the course of justice and to prevent the Court from doing what it was created to do. It is an assault on the rule of law and on the very foundations of the international legal order which strikes at the simple principle that no one stands above the law,” the ICC said in a statement. “Future generations, and above all the victims of mass atrocities, will ask how we responded when an institution created to protect them came under attack.”

The U.S. has already sanctioned 13 other ICC judges and prosecutors in recent months, including numerous officials who have worked on the ICC’s prosecution of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The Trump administration has also previously demanded that the ICC formally end its investigation into U.S. soldier wrongdoing in the U.S.’s invasion of Afghanistan that was already previously put on pause.

Rubio said that the move is about supposedly protecting U.S. sovereignty and shielding American officials and allies from being targeted by the ICC. “Either the ICC will end its threats, or we will end the ICC,” Rubio said.

Similar claims have previously been debunked by legal experts as an attempt by Rubio to use rhetorical scare tactics to paper over Trump officials’ real desire in dismantling the ICC: impunity for themselves and violent allies like Israel. Trump administration officials have faced numerous accusations of war crimes and violations of international humanitarian law, for their massacres of civilians across numerous fronts; ICE raids and mass deportation campaign; and transfers of weapons to countries committing or implicated in war crimes.

Rather than threaten U.S. sovereignty, the sanctions on the ICC actually threaten the sovereignty of many states and peoples who have been victimized by powerful war criminals with no other method of recourse, critics said.

“By sanctioning the entire International Criminal Court, the Trump administration has taken a sledgehammer to the most important development in international justice in half a century,” said Omar Shakir, executive director for Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN). “U.S. sanctions threaten to shut the last viable road to justice for millions of victims of serious crimes, from Gaza and Sudan to Afghanistan and Ukraine.”

DAWN is one of several organizations that have filed lawsuits against previous U.S. sanctions against the ICC. The group called on the European Union to use its Blocking Statute, as it has for previous U.S. sanctions, to prohibit the EU from complying with the sanctions. The group also called on the ICC to prosecute Trump, Rubio, and other U.S. officials for the sanctions, which DAWN Advocacy Associate Isabelle Hayslip said are a crime under the ICC’s founding statute.

Τρία χρόνια γενοκτονίας στην Παλαιστίνη από το σιωνιστικό κράτος του Ισραήλ και οκτώ μήνες αμερικανοϊσραηλινών επιθέσεων στη Μέση Ανατολή, σε πολλές πόλεις σε όλο τον πλανήτη διοργανώνται αντιπολεμικές διαδηλώσεις, επικεντρώνοντας στην αντίσταση του παλαιστινιακού λαού. Στην ελληνική γεωγραφία:


Αθήνα: 14:00 πλ. Ελευθερίας

ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑΤΑ 


ΑΘΗΝΑ


Διαδήλωση αλληλεγγύης στην Παλαιστίνη


7 Οκτώβρη 2026 – Τρία χρόνια πάλης του Παλαιστινιακού Λαού για λευτεριά και αυτοδιάθεση


Όλες-όλοι στη διαδήλωση αλληλεγγύης στον Παλαιστινιακό λαό και την Αντίστασή του


Σάββατο 10 Οκτώβρη 2026, 14:00


Πάρκο Ελευθερίας – πορεία προς τις πρεσβείες των ΗΠΑ και του Ισραήλ


Την Τετάρτη 7 Οκτώβρη 2026 συμπληρώνονται τρία χρόνια από την έναρξη της επιχείρησης «Κατακλυσμός του Αλ Άκσα» της Παλαιστινιακής Αντίστασης, που αποτέλεσε σημείο καμπής στον αγώνα του παλαιστινιακού λαού για λευτεριά, ανεξαρτησία και αυτοδιάθεση. Τρία χρόνια μετά, ο αγώνας αυτός συνεχίζεται, μέσα σε συνθήκες πρωτοφανούς καταστροφής, κατοχής, εκτοπισμού και μιας εύθραυστης εκεχειρίας που απέχει πολύ από το να έχει τερματίσει τη βία και την κατοχή.


Η 7η Οκτώβρη 2023 δεν αποτέλεσε την αρχή του παλαιστινιακού αγώνα. Αποτέλεσε μια νέα και δραματική φάση ενός αγώνα που ξεκίνησε πολύ πριν από την ίδρυση του κράτους του Ισραήλ το 1948 και συνεχίζεται εδώ και δεκαετίες ενάντια στην κατοχή, τον εποικισμό, τον εκτοπισμό και την άρνηση του δικαιώματος του παλαιστινιακού λαού να αποφασίσει ο ίδιος για το μέλλον του.


Τρία χρόνια μετά την 7η Οκτώβρη, το Παλαιστινιακό παραμένει στο κέντρο της διεθνούς πολιτικής επικαιρότητας. Η προσπάθεια να κλείσει οριστικά το ζήτημα μέσα από μια προσωρινή κατάπαυση του πυρός χωρίς τερματισμό της κατοχής και χωρίς αναγνώριση των εθνικών δικαιωμάτων του παλαιστινιακού λαού δεν έχει αποδώσει τα προσδοκόμενα στους σιωνιστές, ενώ η σιωνιστική οντότητα έχει μετατραπεί σε κράτος-παρίας που υπάρχει αποκλειστικά και μόνο γιατί το θέλουν οι αμερικάνοι ιμπεριαλιστές. Η 7η Οκτώβρη άλλαξε το πρόσωπο της Μέσης Ανατολής και τράβηξε εκτατοντάδες εκατομμύρια ανθρώπους στο κίνημα αλληλεγγύης στον παλαιστινιακό λαό.


Ο παλαιστινιακός λαός εξακολουθεί να αγωνίζεται για λευτεριά και αυτοδιάθεση. Η Παλαιστινιακή Αντίσταση εξακολουθεί να αποτελεί αναπόσπαστο κομμάτι αυτού του αγώνα, παρά τις τεράστιες απώλειες και την καταστροφή που έχει υποστεί η Γάζα.


Απέναντί του βρίσκεται ένα ισχυρό στρατιωτικό και πολιτικό μπλοκ, με τη διαρκή υποστήριξη των Ηνωμένων Πολιτειών, των δυτικών ιμπεριαλιστικών κρατών, των αντιδραστικών καθεστώτων του Περσικού και φυσικά ενεργή συμμετοχή σε αυτό έχει η εξαρτημένη ντόπια υπαλληλία που δίνει γη και ύδωρ και στέκεται δίπλα στους σιωναζιστές με κάθε τρόπο.


Απέναντι σε αυτή την πραγματικότητα, το διεθνές κίνημα αλληλεγγύης στον παλαιστινιακό λαό δεν μπορεί να περιοριστεί σε δηλώσεις συμπάθειας και ανθρωπιστικές εκκλήσεις. Η αλληλεγγύη πρέπει να μεταφραστεί σε έμπρακτη πολιτική δράση ενάντια στην κατοχή, τον εποικισμό, τον εκτοπισμό και κάθε μορφή συνενοχής με την ισραηλινή πολεμική μηχανή, χωρίς προκαταλήψεις και πρόστυχες ιδεοληψίες που στο όνομα μιας δήθεν μαζικότητας αφαιρούν από τον παλαιστινιακό λαό το δικαίωμα να αντιστέκεται ένοπλα στον σιωνιστή κατακτητή της πατρίδας του.


Τρία χρόνια μετά την 7η Οκτώβρη, ο παλαιστινιακός λαός παραμένει όρθιος.


Ο αγώνας για λευτεριά, επιστροφή και αυτοδιάθεση συνεχίζεται.


Λευτεριά στην Παλαιστίνη!


Νίκη στα όπλα της Παλαιστινιακής Αντίστασης!


Άμεσος τερματισμός κάθε σχέσης, οικονομικής, πολιτικής, πολιτιστικής και στρατιωτικής, του ελληνικού κράτους με το κράτος του Ισραήλ!

Το Σάββατο 10 Οκτώβρη βγαίνουμε μαζικά στους δρόμους στην Παγκόσμια Αντιπολεμική Ημέρα Δράσης. Συντονιζόμαστε με εκατομμύρια σε όλον τον πλανήτη για να βάλουμε τέλος στην γενοκτονία του Ισραήλ στην Παλαιστίνη, στον πόλεμο του Τραμπ στη Δυτική Ασία, στην εμπλοκή των κυβερνήσεων – με πρώτη και καλύτερη της Νέας Δημοκρατίας – σε αυτά τα εγκλήματα.

title: Yoksulluğa değil, savaşa bütçe: Savunma harcaması 2027’de yüzde 229 artacak
content:
Merkez Bankası’nın İstanbul Finans Merkezi'nde düzenlediği İstanbul Ekonomi Forumu başladı. Dünyanın farklı ülkelerinden merkez bankası başkanları ve üst düzey politika yapıcıların katıldığı forumun açılış konuşmasını Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek yaptı.


Konuşmasında küresel ekonomide yaşanan sorunlara değinen Şimşek, tedarik zincirlerindeki aksamalara, emtia fiyatlarındaki artışa ve yükselen enerji maliyetlerine dikkat çekti. Şimşek, ekonomik krizin kontrol altında olduğunu savundu.


Savunma harcamalarına yüzde 229 artış


Şimşek'in konuşmasında en dikkat çekici başlıklardan biri ise 2027 yılı bütçesine ilişkin açıklaması oldu.


Türkiye'nin caydırıcılığını güçlendirmeye devam ettiğini belirten Şimşek, çatışmaların yaşandığı bir dünyada savunma alanına yatırım yapılmasının zorunluluk olduğunu söyledi.


Şimşek, kısa süre önce hazırlanan ve TBMM'ye sunulması beklenen 2027 yılı bütçesinde savunma harcamalarının yüzde 229 artırılacağını duyurdu.


Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda savunma sanayisine önemli yatırımlar yaptığını söyleyen Şimşek, 1990'lı yıllarda dünyanın en fazla savunma sanayisi ürünü ithal eden beş ülkesi arasında bulunan Türkiye'nin bugün en büyük 10 ihracatçı arasına girmeye yaklaştığını ileri sürdü.


Savunma projelerindeki AR-GE büyüklüğünün 100 milyar doların üzerinde olduğunu belirten Şimşek, yaklaşık 1400 ürün geliştirme projesinin yürütüldüğünü de açıkladı.


2026’da Milli Savunma Bakanlığına ayrılan bütçe 822 milyar 930 milyon 177 bin TL’ydi.


Şimşek'in sözünü ettiği 2027 yılı için yüzde 229'luk artış doğrudan Milli Savunma Bakanlığı’nın bütçesine uygulanırsa kurumun ödeneği yaklaşık 2,71 trilyon TL’ye yükselecek.


Ancak Şimşek'in yüzde 229 artışla Milli Savunma Bakanlığı bütçesini mi, yoksa daha geniş kapsamlı savunma harcamalarını mı kastettiği bilinmiyor. Savunma ve güvenlik için ayrılan toplam kaynak, yalnızca bakanlığın bütçesinden ibaret değil.


Öte yandan Stockholm Uluslararası Barış Araştırmaları Enstitüsü’nün (SIPRI) 2025 verilerine göre Türkiye’nin askeri harcamaları son 10 yılda yüzde 94 artarak 30 milyar dolara ulaştı. Bu da Türkiye'yi dünya en yüksek askeri harcama yapan ülkeler arasında 18. sıraya soktu.


Ülkeler silahlanmaya 2025’te 2,9 trilyon dolar harcadı


27 Nisan 2026


86 milyon 92 bin kişilik nüfus düşünüldüğünde hükümet kişi başına yaklaşık 375 dolarlık (yaklaşık 18 bin 500 TL) askeri harcama yapıyor.


Milyonlarca kişi yoksulluk riski altında, çocuklar öğün atlıyor


Savunma harcamalarındaki artış açıklaması, Türkiye'de milyonlarca yurttaşın geçim sıkıntısıyla mücadele ettiği bir dönemde geldi.


Türkiye İstatistik Kurumunun (TÜİK) 2025 yılı Yoksulluk ve Yaşam Koşulları Araştırması'na göre nüfusun yüzde 27,9'u, yani yaklaşık 24 milyon kişi, yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında bulunuyor. Medyan gelirin yüzde 50'si esas alınarak hesaplanan göreli yoksulluk oranı ise yüzde 13. Bu da yaklaşık 11 milyon kişiye karşılık geliyor.


Çocuklarda ise tablo daha çarpıcı. TÜİK verilerine göre 0-17 yaş grubundaki çocukların yüzde 36,8'i yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında. Başka bir ifadeyle Türkiye'de her üç çocuktan birinden fazlası bu riskle karşı karşıya.


Aynı araştırmaya göre nüfusun yüzde 35,1'i, yani yaklaşık 30 milyon kişi, ekonomik nedenlerle iki günde bir et, tavuk veya balık içeren bir öğünün masrafını karşılayamıyor. Yurttaşların yüzde 19,6'sı ise evinin yeterince ısınma ihtiyacını ekonomik olarak karşılayamadığını belirtiyor.


"Her üç çocuktan biri yoksulluk riski altında”


13 Temmuz 2026


Öte yandan TÜRK-İŞ'in Eylül 2026 araştırmasına göre dört kişilik bir ailenin sağlıklı ve dengeli beslenebilmesi için yapması gereken aylık asgari gıda harcaması 37 bin 801 TL'ye yükseldi. Gıda dışındaki zorunlu giderleri de kapsayan yoksulluk sınırı ise 123 bin 130 TL'ye ulaştı.


2026 yılında net asgari ücretin 28 bin 75 TL olduğu düşünüldüğünde, tek asgari ücretle geçinen dört kişilik bir hanenin aylık geliri yalnızca gıda için hesaplanan açlık sınırının bile yaklaşık 9 bin 725 TL altında kalıyor.


Çocukların beslenme sorunu eğitim hayatına da yansıyor. Ekonomik İşbirliği ve Kalkınma Örgütünün (OECD) PISA 2022 araştırmasına göre Türkiye'deki 15 yaşındaki öğrencilerin yüzde 19,3'ü, yiyecek alacak yeterli para bulunmadığı için haftada en az bir kez öğün atladığını bildirdi.


Milli Eğitim Bakanlığının 2025-2026 istatistiklerine göre resmi okullarda yaklaşık 15,2 milyon öğrenci eğitim görüyor. Bu öğrencilerin tamamına yılda 180 gün boyunca ücretsiz bir …

title: David Cameron Defends Trail Hunting: Four Days Later The Heythrop Kill A Fox
content:
On 14 September 2026, former Prime Minister David Cameron joined the Countryside Alliance in another performance of defending so-called trail hunting at an event in Westminster.


Kennel Huntsman Josh Tierney looks back to see who is watching before retrieving the body of the fox that is being killed in front of him. Image: Three County Hunt Sabs


Four days later, on 18 September, the Heythrop Hunt – a hunt Cameron has ridden with and was seen attending earlier this year – was out near Lower Swell in Gloucestershire.


Three Counties Hunt Sabs were there when the Heythrop’s hounds killed yet another fox, before members of the hunt carried its mauled body away.


Tierney legging it with the fox remains: Image: Three County Hunt Sabs


Cameron’s association with the Heythrop goes back decades. Most recently, on 28 February this year, Three Counties Sabs photographed the former Prime Minister attending a joint Heythrop and Tynedale meet at Dean Manor in Oxfordshire.


Cameron is spotted at a Heythrop meet in February 2026. Image: Three County Hunt Sabs


Cameron’s connections to hunting go beyond the Heythrop. His stepfather-in-law, Viscount Astor, is the chairman of the British Hound Sports Association (BHSA), the governing body for registered hunts in Britain.


Astor recently made the news when his

plot to “hoodwink” government ministers

 over the proposed trail hunting ban made The Times newspaper.


William Waldorf Astor III, 4th Viscount Astor, stepfather-in-law of David Cameron and Chairman of the British Hound Sports Association (BHSA). Image: Bristol Hunt Saboteurs


Another senior figure at the BHSA has an even more direct connection to the Heythrop. It is the BHSA’s executive director, Julian Barnfield.


Barnfield is the former huntsman of the Heythrop, and he has history with Cameron.


Quadruple-convicted former Heythrop Huntsman, now the executive director of the BHSA Julian Barnfield.


In 2008, Barnfield was charged with three offences under the Hunting Act over allegations he had hunted foxes with hounds. At the time Cameron was Leader of the Opposition and the Heythrop was his local hunt. Cameron was also Barnfield’s constituency MP.


Following a private meeting between the two, Cameron intervened personally and wrote to the Attorney General on his constituent’s behalf, reportedly questioning whether prosecuting the Heythrop huntsman was

“really a productive use of police time?”

 The case was subsequently discontinued.


Attempts to obtain a copy of the letter under the Freedom of Information Act were unsuccessful.

Did the CPS cave to pressure from Cameron?


Four years later, Barnfield was back before the courts for illegal hunting. In December 2012, Barnfield pleaded guilty to four charges of illegally hunting foxes with dogs. Heythrop senior master Richard Sumner also pleaded guilty to four offences, as did Heythrop Hunt Ltd itself.


The case made history, as the Heythrop became the first hunt to be convicted as a corporate body under the Hunting Act.


Barnfield, the quadruple-convicted huntsman, on whose behalf David Cameron had personally intervened during the earlier prosecution, would go on to become the executive director of the organisation responsible for governing hunts in Britain.


On the morning of 18 September 2026, Three Counties Hunt Sabs were with the Heythrop when its hounds entered woodland.


WATCH THE VIDEO


The hunt had surrounded the woodland while hounds were pushed through the covert – classic cub hunting. Riders can be heard slapping their saddles – a tactic used to scare fleeing foxes back towards the hounds.


The fox was killed just inside the fenceline.


Kennel huntsman Josh Tierney was filmed climbing into the woodland and emerging carrying the fox’s mauled body, before running away with it.


When the sabs were able to reach the kill-site, they found blood and internal body parts – including the fox’s liver, left behind.


Blood on the fence where the fox’s body had been dragged (top) and liver and intestines (bottom)


Before joining the Heythrop, Tierney had been huntsman of the South Dorset Hunt. On 24 July 2024, he was convicted of racially/religiously aggravated intentional harassment, alarm or distress.


The Heythrop’s current master and huntsman Oliver Dale received a police caution after an

assault on a female sab

 in November 2024. Dale was also

charged with three Hunting Act offences

 whilst master and huntsman of the North Cotswold Hunt …

title: Wandkalender 2027
content:
Tiere einfach leben lassen – Wandkalender 2027

Dieser besondere Wandkalender für 2027 stellt 12 Bewohner*innen aus dem Land der Tiere vor und zeigt anhand ihrer Geschichten, wie viel Glück diese wenigen Tiere hatten, ihrem zugedachten Schicksal zu entkommen. author: L214
title: Végétalisation des menus des cantines scolaires : l’état des lieux de L214
content:
Au lendemain de la rentrée scolaire 2026, L214 dresse l’état des lieux de la végétalisation des menus des cantines scolaires dans 40 villes de France. Ce bilan, le premier depuis la prise de fonction des nouveaux élus à l’issue des élections municipales de mars 2026, révèle des situations contrastées : là où certaines villes se contentent du minimum imposé par la loi, d’autres font preuve de plus d’ambition, indépendamment de leur couleur politique.

La végétalisation des menus dans les cantines scolaires constitue un levier puissant et efficace à disposition des maires pour contribuer à réduire le nombre d’animaux tués pour l’alimentation en France. C’est pourquoi L214 propose trois mesures de végétalisation dans sa charte d’engagement du Sauvetage du siècle à destination des maires : instaurer une option végétarienne quotidienne, deux journées végétariennes hebdomadaires et un plat végétalien hebdomadaire.

Ce début d’année scolaire révèle de fortes disparités d’une ville à l’autre sur la mise en place de deux journées végétariennes par semaine. Sur les 40 villes de plus de 100 000 habitants étudiées par L214 :

14 villes proposent deux journées végétariennes par semaine ou plus,

12 villes proposent 5 à 7 journées végétariennes par mois,

14 villes se contentent d’une journée végétarienne par semaine, le minimum légal imposé par la loi EGalim.

Concernant la mise en place d’une option végétarienne quotidienne, le tableau est là aussi très contrasté : 11 villes proposent déjà cette option, alors que 24 villes proposent une option « sans viande » ou « sans porc » pouvant contenir du poisson, une alternative qui n’est donc pas végétarienne. Cinq villes ne proposent aucune alternative végétarienne quotidienne.

Certaines villes comme Bordeaux, Grenoble, Lyon, Montpellier et Paris font figure de bonnes élèves en cumulant d’ores et déjà une option végétarienne quotidienne et deux journées végétariennes hebdomadaires. D’autres villes vont même au-delà des mesures portées par L214, à l’image de Saint-Denis, qui propose 3 journées végétariennes chaque semaine dans ses cantines, ou de Montpellier, qui propose deux plats végétaliens chaque mois.

À l’inverse, Boulogne-Billancourt, Limoges et Le Mans notamment se limitent à une journée végétarienne par semaine, le minimum prévu par la loi.

→ Découvrir la charte d’engagement du Sauvetage du siècle

Cet état des lieux montre que la volonté de végétaliser les menus dans les cantines scolaires n’est pas portée par un seul parti politique. Parmi les cinq villes qui cumulent une option végétarienne quotidienne et deux journées végétariennes hebdomadaires, Bordeaux est dirigée par une majorité du centre, Grenoble et Lyon par des majorités écologistes, et Montpellier et Paris par des majorités de gauche.

Plusieurs villes affiliées à droite renforcent elles aussi la végétalisation de leurs cantines. Aix-en-Provence propose désormais deux journées végétariennes une semaine sur deux, et Metz en propose 5 à 7 par mois.

Pour Erwin Goeller, chargé d’affaires publiques de L214 : « La végétalisation des menus dans les cantines scolaires est un choix politique concret à la portée de chaque maire. L’enjeu a été pris au sérieux par plusieurs municipalités, mais les efforts restent très disparates selon les villes. Nous appelons les nouveaux élus à se saisir pleinement de ce sujet pour contribuer, à leur échelle, à réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués pour l’alimentation en France ! »

title: Dixon Mink Farm in Bluffdale, Utah will be Forced to Close
content:
Dixon Mink Farm at 15028 Pony Express Road in the town of Bluffdale, Utah will be forced to close.

The city council of Bluffdale has eliminated fur farming as a permitted use. Fur farms will be unable to operate in Bluffdale.

The councilperson who pushed for the change said:

“I saw the serious issue the mink farm had on the lives of our residents. As I knocked on doors of our independence area there were so many flies people couldn’t open their door to talk to me. Because of this ordinance change the city can not approve the business license for this or any other mink farm.”

title: NINE MICE LIBERATED FROM A LABORATORY.
content:
19th September, New Orleans USA.


[editor’s note: whilst we have received text relating to the action, and it references extensive footage of the inside of the laboratory, we have not seen any of the footage and cannot confirm the validity of the report. No news press articles have been found at the time of writing. Image is unrelated, historical rabbit liberation image.]


received anonymously via email:


“The Animal Liberation Front claims responsibility for the liberation of nine mice from the University of New Orleans earlier this month.


On September 19, 2026, nine female mice (including four so-called “breeding females”) were loaded up and spirited away from a miserable, windowless cinderblock room on the 2nd floor of UNO’s Psychology Building to begin a new life in safety and comfort. All nine are being lovingly looked after and tended to. None were released into the wild.


The lab chosen was that of Christopher Harshaw, who subjects mice and rats to experiments that purportedly aim to study autism, body temperature regulation and social behavior. This includes injecting them with drugs (including acetaminophen to induce neurodevelopment disorders), shutting them into small lighted cabinets overnight, and putting poisonous chemicals into their water like aniline (known to cause blood disorders and spleen tumors in rodents).


Moreover, Christopher Harshaw and his research assistant Anna are personally responsible for the killing of hundreds of animals per year, sometimes as many as 30-50 in a single day, as noted in Harshaw’s “Euthanasia Log” notebook, which on a previous visit was removed, had its pages photocopied (along with other documents related to animal research) and then put back. His death tally: 323 in 2023 (rats and mice), 575 in 2024 (rats and mice, including one wild mouse caught in a live trap and killed on the premises), and 363 in 2025 (all mice). His method: gassing them to death with co2.


Extensive video was also taken documenting the decrepit conditions of the lab as well as Roberto Refinetti’s animal room full of cages formerly housing squirrels (empty at the time of filming).


As should be clear: the purpose of this action wasn’t to vandalize, nor was it mere opportunism. This was a carefully planned and orchestrated live liberation of mice from Chris Harshaw’s lab. Its only purpose was getting the animals to safety as quickly as possible, therefore no equipment was damaged and no messages left at the scene. The whole operation, from entering the building to exiting with the animals, took ten minutes.


It should also be noted: This action was carried out using a minimum number of tools (none) and a minimum number of personnel (one).


This proves not only that lab raids can still be completed in 2026 but that one person, working alone, can successfully accomplish them.


To Chris Harshaw: Accessing your lab was child’s play, and with the hammer and drill on site it would have been only too easy to decommission every piece of equipment you own. Consider this a warning. In the end you were shown more mercy than the animals you hold captive.


And a word to all you would-be liberators out there: These facilities are not the fortresses you think they are. They are not impregnable. In fact the animal abusers in white coats have become so secure in their belief that no one is watching that they sometimes don’t even bother locking their doors! Use this negligence to your advantage. And while they sleep, go and do your work.


THE LAB RAID IS BACK.


Nine go free…


Another victory for the animals,


ALF”

author: winter oak
title: Never Accidentally Offer Luxury Recycled Cream Cakes to Portuguese Vegan Punks!
content:
This is the fifth and final chapter from the book 

King of the Squatters

 by jaybo which we are delighted to be able to share on Winter Oak. The whole text can be found as a pdf

here

.


I had enjoyed going for food at the social centre twice weekly. But it became tiresome for me to recognise blatant hierarchies and leaders when their on-line blurb claimed that they were anarchists against leaders, organised along horizontal lines, not vertical, top-down power structures. But my relationship with the social centre was completely destroyed one afternoon, after I had just recycled some expensive, fancy cream cakes.


In front of our house, a fiesta had been happening all weekend, so lots of drunken revellers engulfed our usually quiet home. Our squat had been under siege for the three days, being attacked by young adults who threw stones and came into our building looking for trouble. I had not been sleeping well and was very tired one day as I ate some luxury recycled cream cakes in the city centre. Then the social centre’s leader passed me and stopped to speak. We had only ever seen each other previously at the centre, never in public. I offered yer man a fancy cake, without thinking that they were patently not vegan.


He refused and asked me exactly where our squat was. I innocently told him directions to our home. Then he left to go on a demonstration against workers’ exploitation. That night as I walked home, I was stopped dead in my tracks by fresh graffiti on the bridge just before our squat. In big white letters it simply stated, “vegan limit!!!” I had no doubt that the vegan punk anarchist leader had just sprayed the graffiti as some kind of attempted bullshit intimidation directed at me. Because I had offered to share my hard-earned cakes with him.


I never went back to the social centre after that. I was so angry that I knew if I had returned then I would have certainly made trouble and probably have given the leader an excuse to ban me anyway. I hate egos and authoritarians. However, as always, I tried to turn a negative into a positive. That incident inspired one of my most popular signs for The Whimsical Atrocity Theatre (TWAT): “I only eat vegans”.


The next day, TWAT proudly unveiled its new message to the world. It worked immediately. The show was good. I was a little bit worried that one or more of the social centre vegan punks would pass by, see the sign and beat me up. I was probably safe in my theatre, as I usually had a police escort at one side, looking out for the tourists’ safety. But they knew where I lived.


Some brave souls came and spoke to me during or after my cardboard shenanigans. But things reached dizzying heights for TWAT when an American woman came up to me and asked me how much my signs were. I was absolutely flabbergasted. Someone wanted to buy my recycled carton signs. I replied to her spontaneously that, if she wanted to buy a sign, then she had to tell me how much it was. She put four euros into my hat for “I only eat vegans”. Black permanent marker pen on quality recycled cardboard.


Women were flirting with me almost every day when I performed, but I was caught completely off guard when an extremely attractive, well-dressed young French woman came up to me with her friends, picked up the condoms and said, “OK, let’s go!” She was absolutely serious and in a pathetic response, I replied, “You’re wearing a wedding ring.” She countered with, “It’s only an engagement ring. This is my last chance. Are you coming?” Her friends’ looks assured me that she was absolutely serious. I did not go. One of her friends looked at me as though I must have been insane. One of several potentially delicious sexual opportunities that I missed in life.


As the summer really heated up, it felt as though all of Portugal’s crazy folk were coming out of the woodwork and heading for fun in Lisbon. As I worked one day, a sun-drenched, handsome, young man swaggered up the steps towards me. He wore rags as clothes, had matted, unkempt hair flopping all over his face and had a long stick over his shoulder, with a cloth bundle tied up at the other end. He asked if he could write something on one of my signs. I told him he could, so he picked up “this sign was my bed” and wrote on it, “but I washed it in my jacuzzi first”, which killed me and the audience. Then he shouted for all to hear, “We are homeless because we choose to be.”


Before his departure, he asked me if he could take a condom because …

author: PETA-Team
title: Geheimsache Tierversuche: Neue ZDF-Doku zeigt Tierleid hinter verschlossenen Labortüren
content:
Symbolbild


Die neue „37°“-Dokumentation „Geheimsache Tierversuche – Unter Ausschluss der Öffentlichkeit“ geht der Frage nach, was eigentlich mit Tieren in Versuchslaboren geschieht – und warum die Öffentlichkeit so wenig davon sehen darf.


Am 

29. September 2026 um 22:15 Uhr im ZDF

 sehen die Zuschauer:innen hinter die Kulissen einer Branche, in der Mäuse, Ratten, Hunde, Affen, Kaninchen, Schweine und viele weitere Tiere für Experimente missbraucht werden.


Millionen Tiere leiden für „wissenschaftliche Zwecke“


Nach den offiziellen Zahlen wurden in Deutschland

im Jahr 2024 über drei Millionen Tiere

 für „wissenschaftliche Zwecke“ missbraucht. Einen großen Teil nimmt die Grundlagenforschung ein, in der Tieren zum Beispiel der Schädel aufgebohrt wird, um Elektroden in ihr Gehirn zu setzen. In regulatorischen, gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Tests werden die Tiere teils vergiftet und getötet.


Solche Experimente finden nicht irgendwo weit entfernt statt, sondern an verschiedenen Forschungseinrichtungen in Deutschland.

Experimente an Affen

, die in der Dokumentation ebenfalls thematisiert werden, sind in der Hälfte der Bundesländer vertreten.


Was passiert in den Versuchslaboren?


Für die Dokumentation hat der Journalist Manfred Karremann mehr als ein Jahr lang versucht, Einblicke in deutsche Tierversuchslabore zu bekommen. Trotz angebotener Anonymität erklärte sich nur eine Einrichtung bereit, ein wenig Einblick zu geben.


Die Dokumentation macht damit ein Problem sichtbar, das Tierschützer:innen seit Jahren kritisieren: Tierversuche finden weitgehend im Verborgenen statt. Sie werden verharmlost und die wenigsten Menschen erfahren, was den Tieren tatsächlich angetan wird. Dabei geht es um Lebewesen, die Angst und Schmerzen empfinden wie wir – und die schlichtweg nicht dazu da sind, dass wir an ihnen experimentieren.


Die Dokumentation zeigt unter anderem Aufnahmen aus einem britischen Labor. Zu sehen sind Hunde,

Affen

, Kaninchen und Ratten, die für sogenannte

Giftigkeitstests

 missbraucht werden. Die Versuche gelten als standardisierte Verfahren und werden nach internationalen Richtlinien durchgeführt – auch in der EU. Tiere müssen dabei beispielsweise Chemikalien einatmen oder bekommen Testsubstanzen über einen Schlauch direkt in den Magen verabreicht.


Jetzt lesen


Forschung und Medizin


Tierversuche in Deutschland: Was wirklich in den Versuchslaboren passiert


In deutschen Tierversuchslaboren werden Affen, Hunde, Katzen, Nagetiere, Fische & Insekten gequält. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über die Versuche!


Jetzt lesen


Tierversuche sind keine gute Wissenschaft


Tierversuche werden oft als „wissenschaftlich notwendig“ gerechtfertigt – doch die Dokumentation zeigt, dass die Wissenschaft längst mit Methoden arbeitet, die ohne Tiermissbrauch auskommen. Expert:innen aus Industrie und Wissenschaft kommen zu Wort und erklären, warum modernste Methoden wie menschliche Zellkulturen oder Organs-on-a-Chip Tierversuchen nicht nur ethisch, sondern auch wissenschaftlich überlegen sind.


Diese Ansätze arbeiten direkt mit menschlichen Zellen und menschlichem Gewebe. Dadurch können sie bei bestimmten Fragestellungen auch Erkenntnisse liefern, die sich besser auf Menschen übertragen lassen.


Jetzt einschalten und hinschauen!


Die „37°“-Dokumentation gibt einen seltenen Einblick in die abgeschottete Welt, in der Tiere in Laboren ihr Leben lang gefangen sind – und zeigt gleichzeitig, warum es längst überfällig ist, dass sich Wissenschaft und Forschung von Tierversuchen abwenden.


„37°: Geheimsache Tierversuche – Unter Ausschluss der Öffentlichkeit“

 läuft am

Dienstag, 29. September 2026, um 22:15 Uhr im ZDF.

 Ab 5:00 Uhr ist die Dokumentation auch über das ZDF-Streaming-Angebot abrufbar.


Jede Unterschrift zählt


PETA fordert von nationalen und internationalen Entscheidungsträger:innen einen strategischen Ausstieg aus Tierversuchen und eine Modernisierung der Forschung. Unterstützen Sie den Research Modernisation Deal und helfen Sie uns, grausame Tierversuche endlich zu beenden.


		Jetzt unterschreiben

Geheimsache Tierversuche: Neue ZDF-Doku zeigt Tierleid hinter verschlossenen Labortüren

 appeared first on

PETA Deutschland e.V.

.

title: Guilty Verdict For King’s Sheep Rescuers In Theft Trial
content:
After a four-day trial at Norwich Crown Court, Rose Patterson, Sarah Foy, and Rosa Sharkey have all been found guilty of theft after the rescue of three lambs from King Charles III’s Sandringham Estate in May 2023. Sentencing to follow today.

Despite the verdict, Animal Rising claims that the rescue and subsequent trial have helped to put a spotlight on the reality behind animal farming in the UK, with over 10 million sheep being slaughtered yearly [1].

The controversial rescue made front-page news across the UK and headlines around the world [2]. It captured the attention of the British public, questioning how we relate to animals in the food system and if it’s a rescue or a theft to take them from farms.

Animal Rising director Rose Patterson, alongside Rosa Sharkey and Sarah Foy, rescued the lambs - Sammy, Sunny and Sooty - before informing police the following day. The women held signs outside Windsor Castle reading “I rescued the King’s sheep” before reporting what they had done to police. They each face up to 7 years' imprisonment.

Earlier this year, Patterson was found not guilty by a jury over another Animal Rising open rescue, after helping to rescue beagle puppies from MBR Acres, a facility breeding animals for testing [3].

Animal Rising director Rose Patterson, one of the three defendants found guilty today, said:

Sammy, Sunny and Sooty remain safe and are now fully grown.

The trial followed a series of open-rescue trials relating to Animal Rising’s rescue of beagles from MBR Acres. In January this year, Animal Rising made history by securing the UK’s first-ever not-guilty verdict in an open-rescue case [4]. The lambs were rescued from Appleton Farm, which forms part of the Sandringham estate.

Defendants Patterson and Foy are available for comment or broadcast interview upon request.

For further information, comment, or to arrange an interview, please email press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691

High-Quality Pictures and Videos: https://show.pics.io/animal-rising-breaking-news

All images and videos in this file, on our social media, and website can be used with credit to Animal Rising under ‘fair use’ for the purposes of reporting.

[2] https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-12431619/Animal-Rising-protesters-charged-stealing-Kings-sheep-royal-Sandringham-Estate-driving-away-animals.html

https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-12126009/Will-stop-eco-clowns-Just-Stop-Oil-throw-orange-powder-Animal-Rising-kidnap-lambs.html

[3] https://www.cambsnews.co.uk/peterborough-court-acquittal-animal-rescue-beagles/

[4] https://www.animalrising.org/post/not-guilty-verdict-for-beagle-puppy-rescuers-in-landmark-legal-case

Rose Patterson, 37, is the Director of Animal Rising. An advocate for animals since 2012, she holds an MSc in Animal Welfare Science, Ethics, and Law and previously worked with World Animal Protection before joining Animal Rising in 2020.

Sarah Foy, 26, has been involved in a range of campaigns advocating for a just and sustainable food system that works for animals, farmers, and the planet. She brings a practical, hands-on approach to her advocacy, with real-world experience caring for rescued farm animals at sanctuaries and protesting alongside farmers.

Rosa Sharkey, 26, is a food charity worker. She is passionately committed to reducing the impact of our food system on the climate crisis, community action, and animal rights.

Animal Rising is a nonviolent campaign group working to fundamentally transform our relationship with animals and nature, and build a more sustainable future for animals, people and the planet. Animal Rising is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040 and support a transition to a sustainable plant-based food system.

The group has used a variety of civil disobedience and nonviolent direct action tactics, notably blockading McDonald's distribution centres in May 2021, blockading dairy industry sites in September 2022, disrupting the 2023 Grand National, rescuing lambs belonging to King Charles III in May 2023, and carrying out the UK’s largest undercover farm investigation in 2024.

author: Sophie Lemcke
title: So ist es, als Huhn in der Fleischindustrie leben zu müssen
content:
Die Hühnermast ist ein grausames System, das auf maximale Schnelligkeit, Wachstum und Profit ausgelegt ist und mit einem gewaltvollen Tod für die Tiere endet.


Wie fühlt es sich an, als „Masthuhn“ geboren zu werden

, ohne die Möglichkeit, der leidvollen Industrie zu entkommen

?


Der einzige Grund, weshalb die Industrie dich „produziert“ hat: Du sollst so schnell wie möglich so schwer wie möglich werden – und wirst dann getötet.


Du kommst in einem Hühnerschlupfbetrieb mit tausenden anderen Küken zur Welt. Um dich herum piepsen sie verzweifelt. Und auch du suchst nach Nähe und Wärme. Aber da ist keine Mutter, in deren Gefieder du dich kuscheln kannst – und du wirst sie auch niemals kennenlernen.

Noch am ersten Tag deines Lebens wirst du über Förderbänder geschleudert und in eine Kiste gepackt. Dann beginnt die oftmals stundenlange Fahrt zum Mastbetrieb – eingepfercht mit Dutzenden anderen Küken, ohne Wasser, ohne Nahrung.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Du kommst in einer riesigen Halle an. Hier wirst du die nächsten rund 5 Wochen verbringen – die einzigen Wochen deines Lebens.


Um dich herum Tausende andere Küken. Du teilst dir einen Quadratmeter mit bis zu 23 anderen Tieren. Jetzt seid ihr noch klein, doch das wird sich schnell ändern.


Du wächst. Unnatürlich schnell. Das Futter steht dir Tag und Nacht zur Verfügung – hochkalorisch, proteinreich, entwickelt für maximales Wachstum in kürzester Zeit.


Du hast keinen Platz, um dich natürlich zu bewegen, es gibt nichts zum Erkunden. Keinerlei Möglichkeiten, deine natürlichen Verhaltensweisen auszuleben. Es ist trist und laut. Da ist nur diese Enge.


Die Luft ist stickig. Der Ammoniakgeruch von den Ausscheidungen Tausender Tiere brennt in deinen Augen, in deinen Lungen. Du bekommst Atemwegserkrankungen. Jeder Atemzug tut weh.


Dein Körper wurde durch jahrzehntelange Züchtung so manipuliert, dass du in wenigen Wochen das Gewicht erreichst, für das ein Huhn unter natürlichen Bedingungen Monate bräuchte.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Deine Brustmuskeln wachsen so schnell und werden so schwer, dass deine Knochen dein Gewicht nicht mehr tragen können. Deine Beine verformen sich. Dein Herz ist zu klein für deinen massiven Körper, es hat Probleme, deine Organe mit ausreichend Blut zu versorgen. Du hast Schmerzen beim Gehen und deine Gelenke sind entzündet.


Um dich herum sind Hühner, die gar nicht mehr aufstehen können. Sie liegen in ihrem eigenen Kot und leiden unter extremen Schmerzen. Sie verdursten und verhungern.


Andere Hühner werden aufgrund der Enge von ihren Artgenossen versehentlich totgetrampelt und erdrückt – ihre Körper verwesen zwischen dir und den tausenden anderen Tieren. Auch du hast keine Chance, den anderen Hühnern auszuweichen.


Dann ist es soweit. Menschen kommen und packen dich. An deinen Beinen, kopfüber, werden du und deine Artgenossen gegriffen und in enge Transportkisten geworfen. Deine ohnehin schon schmerzenden Beine brechen unter der groben Behandlung. Du hast Schmerzen und Todesangst.


Zusammengepfercht, ohne Wasser, ohne Futter, geht es zum Schlachthof. Die Fahrt kann Stunden dauern. Manche Hühner sterben bereits im Transporter – vor Stress, vor Erschöpfung, erdrückt von anderen Tieren.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Im Schlachthof riechst du Blut. Du hörst die Schreie anderer Hühner. Dann bist du selbst an der Reihe. Unter grausamen Bedingungen wirst du betäubt und getötet. Du bist gerade einmal 35 bis 42 Tage alt geworden.


Es ist unvorstellbar, was Hühner in der Fleischindustrie erleiden müssen.


Die Wahrheit hinter „Hähnchenfleisch“


Wie grausam das kurze Leben von sogenannten Masthühnern ist, haben wir schon mehrfach bei Undercover-Recherchen aufgedeckt, beispielsweise in einem (jetzt ehemaligen) Zuliefererbetrieb der großen Marke Wiesenhof. Hier erfährst du mehr über unsere Aufdeckungen und kannst unsere Petition für strengere Tierschutzvorgaben, -kontrollen und -strafen unterzeichnen:


Jetzt für Hühner unterschreiben 


In Deutschland wird mehr Fleisch von Hühnern konsumiert als produziert – und die Nachfrage ist in den vergangenen Jahren stetig gestiegen. Unterstütze dieses grausame System nicht: Entscheide dich konsequent für pflanzliche Lebensmittel.


In den meisten Supermärkten findest du mittlerweile eine Vielfalt tierfreundlicher Alternativen, die hervorragende Proteinquellen sind – probiere sie aus. Oder koche unsere zahlreichen pflanzlichen Rezepte von Love Veg nach, wie unsere

.

title: The Law Catches up with the Lauderdale: Huntswoman Convicted of Illegal Fox Hunting
content:
Claire Bellamy, 51, veteran huntswoman for the Lauderdale Hunt, became the first fox hunter convicted under Scotland’s new hunting laws, following a case in which footage captured by Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs exposed illegal hunting taking place beyond the boundaries of licensed operation.


Claire Bellamy after the incident. Image: Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs


On Monday, 5 October 2026, Bellamy, the former master and huntsman was found guilty at Paisley Sheriff Court of deliberately hunting a fox with dogs during an outing at Kirkton Wood, between Houston and Kilmacolm in January, 2025.


The hunt had been granted a licence by NatureScot, allowing dogs to be used under controlled circumstances. But the footage, which was played to the court, showed the hounds pursuing a fox outside the area covered by that licence.


Under the Hunting with Dogs (Scotland) Act 2023, NatureScot can licence more than two dogs to search for, stalk or flush a fox from cover, where this is necessary to prevent serious damage and where an alternative control is not available – it is not a licence to hunt foxes in any traditional sense.


This fox was hunted as hounds were allowed to hunt in the open. Image: Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs


Dogs can be used to search for and flush a fox from cover, but the dogs must remain under control. The fox can be flushed towards waiting guns and shot as soon as possible. The hounds are not allowed to pursue or kill the fox.


The hounds in pursuit of the hunted fox. Image: Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs


Licences are also geographically restricted, specifying exactly where the activity is permitted to take place.


So, the legal model is that dogs can enter the cover, flush the fox, and the waiting guns shoot the fox. What is not allowed is that dogs find the fox, and then pursue the fox across the country.


Sabs warned when the new legislation was introduced that licensing created a loophole, through which traditional fox hunting could continue under the guise of wildlife management and Bellamy’s conviction shows those warnings were well founded.


WATCH THE VIDEO


The footage was filmed by hunt saboteurs and shown in court. It shows the hunt spread out across the countryside with hounds moving over open ground along the edge of the woodland.


Bellamy argued that the hounds had got away from her and that she was attempting to regain control. However, the terms of the licence state that the dogs must be under control, but more importantly, the court rejected that this was an accidental loss of control.


After viewing the footage, Sheriff Sukhwinder Gill found Bellamy guilty of deliberately hunting a fox with dogs outside the area in which the licensed activity was permitted.


The old “whoopsie my dogs were out of control” is not a defence under the Scottish Hunting Act.


Terrier-men with quads stuffed with terriers follow behind. Image: Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs


Bellamy’s conviction vindicates sabs concerns that hunts would turn the licences into loopholes to continue with traditional fox hunting.


Naturally, Bellamy was not operating in isolation; behind her stands an organised network of dedicated wildlife killers, eagerly searching for any loophole to carry on traditional fox hunting just as they always have.


In 2023, following the passing of the new Scottish hunting laws, another hunt – the Lanarkshire & Renfrewshire announced that it was folding after 252 years.


At their final meet

, the hunt gave thanks to riders and supporters who had followed the hunt, and to the farms and landowners who had allowed them to cross their land over the years.


The Lanarkshire & Renfrewshire meet for the last time ever in March 2023. Image: Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs


The foxhound pack was disbanded, with the hunt saying that the hounds would be rehomed. But the organisation itself did not disappear. Instead, it announced that it would continue to operate as a ‘hunt club’.


A hunt club can maintain the social network of riders and hunt supporters, organise events such as Point-2-Points, and preserve the relationships with landowners and farmers within the countryside where the hunt previously operated.


It was on the former Lanarkshire & Renfrewshire country that Bellamy and the Lauderdale hounds were operating on the day of the illegal hunt.


The Lauderdale packing up under the watchful eyes of Glasgow sabs. Image: Glasgow Hunt Saboteurs


Bellamy’s conviction is important not just because she is the first fox hunter to …
