Существенное свойство научной истины заключается в том, что она может быть показана или доказана. Либо показана чувствам с помощью наблюдения и эксперимента, либо доказана разуму так, что с ней невозможно не согласиться. В первом случае истина называется экспериментальной (опытной) и всегда может быть скорректирована более точными и широкими наблюдениями и новыми экспериментами. Во втором случае она называется логической или математической истиной и, если нет ошибки в рассуждениях, кажется абсолютно достоверной – по крайней мере, до тех пор, пока человеческий разум остается таким, какой он есть в данный момент.

Экспериментальная наука изучает факты: факты настоящие и прошлые, но никак не будущие, поскольку то, что еще не существует и еще не произошло, не является фактом. Констатируя повторение одних и тех же фактов при одних и тех же обстоятельствах, наука приходит путем индукции к установлению «законов природы». Истина этих законов тем более вероятна, чем более обширными и длительными были наблюдения, на основе которых они были выведены. А, наряду с экспериментальными науками, логика и математика стремятся открыть и доказать те универсальные, необходимые истины, которые можно назвать законами понимания, законами человеческого разума.

Таким образом, наука, открывая законы природы – то есть устанавливая, что за определенными фактами обязательно должны следовать другие определенные факты, – предвидит, предсказывает будущее. И если бы было правдой, что всё подчинено законам природы; если бы было правдой, что никакая спонтанная, созидательная сила не может вмешаться в качестве свободного фактора и изменить ход естественных фактических процессов, то наука, достигнув своего совершенства, могла бы предвидеть абсолютно всё. Но тогда, если всё предсказуемо, значит, всё предопределено; и совершенно бесполезно, иллюзорно тратить силы ради достижения какой бы то ни было цели. Социальные науки были бы возможны постольку, поскольку они пытаются открыть законы, которым следует жизнь человеческих обществ; но были бы смешны те партии, которые ставят себе целью осуществление чего-либо, всякое человеческое усилие было бы тщетным. Если что-то должно обязательно произойти, оно всё равно произойдет в свое время без того, чтобы кто-то боролся за его осуществление; а если оно не должно произойти, оно не произойдет вопреки всем человеческим желаниям и усилиям.

Нельзя быть анархистом, нельзя быть социалистом, нельзя быть вообще человеком, стремящимся к какой бы то ни было цели, если не исходить из предпосылки – осознавая это или нет, признаваясь в этом или нет – о действенности человеческой воли.

Конечно, эта воля не всемогуща, поскольку она обусловлена законами природы; но она становится тем более мощной, чем дальше продвигается в открытии этих законов. Знание этих законов, хотя и кажется, что ограничивает её власть, на самом деле дает ей возможность осуществлять свои желания, дает ей реальную силу.

И поскольку в мире человек живет не один (да и в одиночку он не мог бы обратить силы природы себе на пользу), воля каждого является более или менее действенной в зависимости от того, способствуют ли воли других людей его воле или противодействуют ей.

Задача естественных наук – открывать непреложные законы физического мира, которым человек должен подчиняться, чтобы использовать их. Задача социальных наук (и только выполняя эту задачу, они являются истинными науками) – открывать, определять, каковы необходимые факты, фатальные законы, вытекающие из сосуществования людей в различных обстоятельствах, в которых они могут оказаться; и тем самым предотвращать тщетные усилия и делать так, чтобы воля разных людей вместо того, чтобы парализовывать друг друга, содействовали общей цели, полезной …

Dos décadas antes de la fundación del Estado de Israel, Camillo Berneri advirtió del peligro de un derramamiento de sangre en Palestina, ya que los sionistas querían convertirse en los nuevos amos de ese territorio. Para Berneri, el sionismo no era solo una cortina de humo para la política imperialista británica, sino también una amenaza nacionalista y hegemónica para la coexistencia pacífica entre los nuevos colonizadores y los habitantes históricos de Palestina. Lo que, en cambio, era necesario era una situación de plena tolerancia hacia los judíos en Europa, porque solo así se podría resolver verdaderamente el problema del sionismo.

Dejemos en paz el «Muro de las Lamentaciones». No es más que el fondo del cuadro. Simbólicamente se le puede considerar el centro de la tragedia, pero históricamente no lo es. Al muro de Salomón, que jurídicamente pertenece a los árabes, los judíos acudían libremente todos los viernes, desde hace diez años, para llorar la desesperación y las desgracias de su pueblo. La furia árabe nunca se ha cebado contra el elemento judío ortodoxo. Los árabes son tolerantes en materia religiosa, como buenos mahometanos. Su «fanatismo» se explica más por datos demográficos que por reminiscencias históricas y especulaciones psicológicas. La revuelta árabe ha sido, por circunstancias, antijudía; por naturaleza, simplemente xenófoba.

Tengo ante mis ojos dos entrevistas: una del doctor Weizmann, presidente de la Organización Sionista Universal, y otra de Amein Hussein, líder religioso de los árabes de Palestina. El primero afirma que es necesario que los árabes comprendan que Inglaterra no quiere modificar en absoluto su política de protección del sionismo; que es necesario facilitar la inmigración judía en la mayor medida posible. El segundo reafirma que el actual Gobierno de Palestina es contrario, tanto en su Constitución como en su política, a los árabes; exige la adopción de una forma de gobierno democrática, en la que estén representados todos los habitantes de Palestina de manera proporcional, y el abandono de la política inglesa a favor del desarrollo de un «centro nacional judío», especialmente en lo que respecta a la inmigración.

Dos posiciones claramente opuestas. Un conflicto difícilmente resoluble. ¿De qué lado está la razón? Del lado de los árabes. El sentimentalismo está fuera de lugar. Si la prensa mundial ha dado cuenta de las víctimas judías y ha descrito las horribles escenas de las masacres de colonos sionistas indefensos; si existe una justa tradición de compasión hacia los judíos víctimas de leyes absurdas e injustas y masacrados en los pogromos; si es admirable el esfuerzo sionista, todo ello se ve contrarrestado por el peso de las víctimas árabes, por el hecho de que el sionismo sirve de tapadera a la política imperialista británica y al régimen de desigualdad que impera en Palestina.

Los judíos se han declarado seguros de que en el futuro serán los hegemones en Palestina. Los árabes han visto bajar a cientos de judíos de cada barco de vapor que llegaba a Jaffa y a Haifa, han visto cómo los judíos ocupaban las zonas más propicias de su territorio, han visto cómo pasaban a manos de los judíos tierras que los agricultores árabes habían hecho fértiles, han visto cómo la mayor parte de los gastos en obras públicas …

Så kom Bresa-Litovsk-freden. Två månader förut, i december 1917, hade Trotzky tillbakavisat med en fin gest av nobel indignation den av Tyskland erbjudna freden på villkor som voro mycket fördelaktigare för Ryssland. "Vi föra intet krig, vi underskriva ingen fred!" hade han sagt, och det revolutionära Ryssland applåderade honom. "Ingen kompromiss med den tyska imperialismen, inga medgivanden" ekade det genom landet; och folket stod färdigt att försvara sin revolution ända till döds. Men nu fordrade Lenin ratificeringen av en fred som innebar det mest modlösa förräderi mot den större delen av Ryssland, Finland, Lettland, Lithauen, Vitryssland, Bessarabien - alla gingo över till den tyska inkräktaren och deras egen bourgeoisis förtryck och exploatering.

Lenins inflytande var starkt. Han segrade. Brest-Litovsk-freden ratificerades av den 4:de sovjetkongressen.

Det var Trotzky, vilken först försäkrade under avvisande av den tyska freden på de erbjudna villkoren i december 1917 att arbetarna och bönderna, inspirerade och beväpnade av revolutionen, skullem edelst guerillakrig besegra en invasionsarmé. Vänstersocialrevolutionärerna kallade nu till bonderesningar, till kamp mot tyskarna, övertygade att ingen skulle kunna besegra den revolutionära glöden hos ett folk som kämpade för bevarande av dess stora revolutions frukter! Arbetare och bönder, lyssnade till detta upprop, bildade militärdetachement och störtade till Ukrainas och Vitrysslands hjälp, tappert skridande mot de tyska inkräktarna. Trotzky befallde ryska armén att förfölja och undertrycka dessa friskaror.

Mordet på Mirbach följde härefter.

Det var det vänstersocialrevolutionära partiets protest och utmaning mot den preussiska imperialismen i Ryssland. Bolsjevikregeringen började vidta åtgärder till deras underkuvande, den hade nu en känsla av att stå i obligation till Tyskland. Dzerzhinsky, allryska utomordentliga kommissionens ledare, fordrade terroristernas utlämnande.

Det var en unik situation i revolutionsannalerna: ett revolutionärt parti med makt krävande av ett annat revolutionärt parti, med vilket det samarbetat, arrestering och bestraffning av en revolutionär för avdagatagandet av en imperialistisk regerings representant. Brest-Litovsk-freden hade ställt bolsjevikerna i den onaturliga ställningen av en gendarm för Tyskland. Vänstersocialrevolutionärerna besvarade Dzerzhinskys fordran med den senares arrestering. Denna handling och de väpnade skärmytslingarna, som följde därpå, (ehuru obetydliga i sig själva) voro helt och hållet utförda av de bolsjevikiska politikerna. De förklarade att det var ett försök av vänstersocialrevolutionära partiet att bemäktiga sig regeringstömmarna. De förklarade detta parti fågelfritt och dess utrotning började.

Denna bolsjevikiska metod och taktik var icke av tillfällig natur. Snart blev det klart att det är den kommunistiska statens ständiga politik att krossa varje slags yttring som icke var i överensstämmelse med regeringen. Efter ratificeringen av Brest-Litovsk-freden återkallade vänstersocialrevolutionärerna sina representanter i folkkommissariernas sovjet. Bolsjevikerna voro i besittning av den ensamma kontrollen över regeringen.

Under en och annan förevändning fullföljde de den mest godtyckliga och grymma undertryckning av alla de andra politiska partierna och rörelserna. Mensjevikerna och högersocialrevolutionärerna hade "likviderats" långt förut, tillsammans med den ryska bourgeoisin.

Nu var det de revolutionära elementens tur - vänstersocialrevolutionärerna, anarkisterna, de partilösa revolutionärerna.

Men dessas "likvidation" inbegrep mycket mer än undertryckandet av små politiska grupper. Dessa revolutionära element hade strängt förföljts, vänstersocialrevolutionärerna bland bönderna, anarkisterna huvudsakligen bland stadsproletariatet. Den nya bolsjeviktaktiken inneslöt …

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 24: The Transformation of Surplus-value into Capital
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to Marx's Capital volume one, chapter 24.

The employment of surplus-value as capital = accumulation of capital.

Although net revenue (sales minus costs) = surplus-value, it takes the form of money. It only becomes capital when invested in more means of production and in the hiring of more labor.

For this to happen annual production must include: whatever new means of production that are needed to replace worn-out means of production (depreciation), new means of production that can be bought by the net revenue or surplus-value, new labor power (workers) that can be hired and new means of subsistence to sustain them.

The availability of new labor-power implies wages that "suffice, not only to maintain [the existing working class], but also to increase its numbers."

"The cycle of simple reproduction alters its form and, to use Sismondi's expression, changes into a spiral."

Thus laws of private property that assume equal exchange [and indeed often prosecute unequal exchange or cheating] thus hide the real relationship. Equal exchange (assuming wages = value of labor-power) is a mere semblance - a form that mystifies the real content of the relationship, i.e., money/surplus-value (=unpaid labor) is stolen from workers.

"Originally the rights of property seemed to us to be grounded in a man's own labor." [e.g., John Locke's theory of property](1)) But in capitalism property - of the means of production - "turns out to be the right . . . to appropriate the unpaid labor of others".

"General law of commodity production" = "law of exchange" = exchange of equal values. Marx assumes this to always hold, yet exploitation exists because workers produce more value than the value of their wages.

Generalization of commodity production only occurs when labor-power becomes a commodity - which happens only with the development of capitalism - thus capitalism includes this generalization.

There are two basic points in this section. The first is that for capitalism to expand beyond simple reproduction the surpus-value earned through the exploitation of workers, and accruing to the capitalists as money realized through the sale of the commodities produced by those workers, must be invested rather than consumed. The second point is that such investment, wherein surplus-value is used to purchase new means of production and to hire new workers to expand production, doesn't violate the "laws of exchange", i.e., we can continue to assume equality in exchange. But, because the extraction of surplus-value constitutes the very unequal exploitation of workers, the "laws of exchange" hide the reality of the situation.

Investment: by corporations, by philanthropies and by the state.

In simple reproduction - where the existing situation is merely reproduced - all surplus-value is consumed, either by the capitalist class to whom it belongs or, perhaps, by the beneficiaries of any charity the capitalists might distribute to the poor. Marx doesn't discuss charity but others of his time were well aware of this use of a little bit of surplus-value. Some, such as the Reverand Thomas Malthus whom Marx both draws upon and frequently mocks, argued against it. (2) Others, such as Emile Zola, the French novelist, drew biting portraits of such condescention on the part of capitalists. (see the description in Germinal (1885)(3) of the annual charity bestowed on coal miners by the wives of the mine owners.) Beyond charity, a few extremely wealthy capitalists have employed some of the surplus-value they have extraced from workers for "philanthropy." (see below)

In expanded reproduction, or accumulation, surplus-value is used to buy more means of production and to hire more workers in order to expand both the scale of production and to expand the amount of surpus-value/money realized from enlarged sales. Such expanded reproduction in industry, however, requires that both the new means of production and the new workers be available. Therefore, current production must produce not only the means of production necessary to replace worn-out or used up means of production but also new means of production available in exchange for surplus-value that can be used to expand production. At the same time, current production must produce sufficient means of subsistence to support the expanded reproduction of the working class, i.e., the procreation and rearing of children. Thus: in the case of accumulation "ordinary wages suffice, not …

La propaganda no es y no puede ser más que la repetición continua, incansable, de aquellos principios que deben servirnos de guía en la conducta que debemos seguir en las varias contingencias de la vida.

Repetiremos, pues, con palabras más o menos diferentes, pero con un fondo constante, nuestro viejo programa socialista-anarquista-revolucionario.

Nosotros creemos que la mayor parte de los males que afligen a los hombres dependen de la mala organización social, y que los hombres, si quisieran y supieran cómo, podrían destruirlos.

La sociedad actual es el resultado de las luchas seculares libradas por los hombres. No comprendiendo las ventajas que podrían sacar de la cooperación y de la solidaridad, viendo en los demás hombres (excepto lo más vecinos por los vínculos de la sangre) un competidor y un enemigo, han procurado acaparar, cada uno para sí, la mayor cantidad posible de disfrutes sin preocuparse por los intereses de los demás.

Dada esta lucha, naturalmente debían salir vencedores los más fuertes o los más afortunados, y de una u otra forma, someter y oprimir a los vencidos.

Mientras el hombre no fué capaz de producir sino lo que necesitaba para su sostén, los vencedores no podían hacer otra cosa que matar al vencido y apoderarse de los alimentos por éste cosechados.

Más tarde, cuando con el descubrimiento del pastoreo y del la agricultura un hombre pudo ya producir mas de lo que necesitaba para vivir, los vencedores encontraron mas ventajoso reducir a los vencidos a esclavitud y hacerles producir para sus dueños.

Más tarde aún, los vencedores se dieron cuenta de que era más cómodo, más productivo, y más seguro explotar el trabajo ajeno con otro sistema: retener la propiedad exclusiva de la tierra y de todos los medios de trabajo, y dejar nominalmente libres a los despojados, los cuales, no teniendo ya medios con que vivir, venían obligados a recurrir a los propietarios y a trabajar para éstos en las condiciones que éstos querían.

De este modo, poquito a poco, a través de toda una red complicadísima de luchas de todo género, invasiones, guerras, rebeliones, represiones, concesiones arrancadas, asociaciones de vencidos unidos para la defensa y de vencedores unidos para la ofensa, se ha llegado al estado actual de la sociedad, en la cual unos cuantos detienen hereditariamente la tierra y toda la riqueza social, mientras la gran masa de los hombres, desheredada de todo, se ve explotada y oprimida por unos poco propietarios.

De este estado de cosas depende el estado de miseria en que generalmente se encuentran los trabajadores y por consiguiente todos los males que de la miseria derivan: ignorancia, delitos, prostitución, la abyección física causada por la desnutrición, la depresión mental, y la muerte prematura. De este modo depende la constitución de una clase especial (el gobierno), la cual, provista de medios materiales de represión, tiene la misión de legalizar y defender a los propietarios contra las reivindicaciones de los proletarios, sirviéndose, además, de esta fuerza, para crearse a sí misma ciertos privilegios y para someterse, cuando se puede, incluso hasta la misma clase propietaria. De esto depende la constitución de otra clase especial (el clero), la cual, con una serie de fábulas sobre la voluntad de Dios, sobre la vida futura, etc …

author: Unknown
title: Demo in London says Öcalan’s freedom is fundamental condition for peace
content:
The international conspiracy launched on 9 October 1998 against Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan was protested with a march held in London on its 28th anniversary.


Kurds from Kurdistan and their supporters gathered in front of Wood Green Library for the demonstration, organized under the leadership of the London Communities Union. Flags bearing photographs of Öcalan were carried, while banners and placards calling for the implementation of the right to hope and the securing of Öcalan’s physical freedom were displayed.


 


Speakers at the gathering emphasized that the international conspiracy launched on October 9, 1998, targeted not only Öcalan but also the Kurdish people’s struggle for freedom and their democratic will. The speakers pointed out that, despite the 28 years that have passed, Önder Apo’s freedom has still not been secured. They stated that the Kurdish people have not abandoned their demands for freedom and a democratic solution.


Highlighting the historical significance of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, the speakers stressed that, for the process to lead to a lasting solution, Öcalan must be granted the conditions necessary to work freely, communicate, and engage in negotiations.


The demonstration once again called for the implementation of the right to hope and the securing of Öcalan’s physical freedom, emphasizing his role in achieving a democratic and peaceful resolution of the Kurdish question.


Following the speeches, the crowd began marching toward the Haringey Kurdish Community Centre. Throughout the march, participants carried flags bearing photographs of Önder Apo and banners calling for freedom. They chanted slogans, applauded, and performed zılgıt, traditional celebratory ululations, to protest the international conspiracy.


Songs composed in honor of Öcalan were played during the march, and demonstrators distributed hundreds of leaflets along the route.


An attempt at a racist provocation occurred during the Haringey section of the march. After Kurdish young people reacted to the provocation, a brief tension arose between the police and demonstrators. The march resumed following the incident. The demonstration, during which demands for Öcalan’s physical freedom and the implementation of the right to hope were reiterated, concluded in front of the Haringey Democratic Kurdish Community Centre.

author: Dion Nissenbaum
title: Post Office and Election Officials Urge Voters to Mail Ballots Before Deadlines
content:
Officials say dropping off ballots early is the best way to avoid rejection due to delays in delivery.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

The U.S. Postal Service had enough problems even before President Donald Trump tried to transform the agency into a de facto election regulation hub that would have had the power to reject ballots heading to voters this November.

That plan was quashed by the Supreme Court after a tumultuous legal battle. But that hasn’t taken the spotlight off the Postal Service, which is still facing a lot of questions about how prepared it is to handle the massive flow of ballots moving around the country over the next four weeks.

The Postal Service has lost money for decades. Since 2007, the agency has lost $118 billion. Despite a mantra that “neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night” would keep the mail from getting through, the Postal Service is charging customers more and delivering some mail more slowly. Things are so bad that the Postmaster General has warned that the agency could run out of cash early next year.

The problems are a concern for tens of millions of Americans expected to vote by mail in this November’s elections. This year, the challenges could be compounded by belt-tightening measures that could lead to more ballots being rejected if voters aren’t paying attention.

The so-called Regional Transportation Optimization plan the agency rolled out last year has reduced pickup times at more than 15,000 post offices that are more than 50 miles from a regional processing center. That means a ballot could sit in a local post office and not get a postmark until the following day.

For people dropping off their ballots at the last minute, that could mean the difference between their votes being counted or rejected. The problems are likely to have the biggest impact on rural areas, which tend to be more likely to vote for Republicans.

Oregon has been an early case study in how the system works — or doesn’t. Oregon, which was the first state to shift to voting entirely by mail in 1998, was part of the Postal Service pilot project testing the consolidation process. The results were not encouraging. The Postal Service’s own audit found that performance declined and complaints increased.

Most importantly for voters, Oregon has seen an increase in ballots being rejected because they weren’t postmarked as required by Election Day. During the primary election this past May, more than 7,300 ballots that might have been counted when they came in after Election Day were rejected because they didn’t have a proper postmark, amounting to a 13% rejection rate, up from 9.5% in 2024.

That set off some alarm bells in Oregon, which is trying to address the problems and ensure that fewer ballots are rejected this November.

Leading the charge is Secretary of State Tobias Read, a Democrat who has worked to expand the state’s ballot drop box system, which operates independently of the Postal Service. Oregon has more than 320 drop boxes. More than 60% of all Oregon voters used drop boxes in 2024, but it’s much easier for people in urban areas to use them than those in rural areas, where it can take an hour or more to reach one. Read just got state lawmakers to add another 20 for the November election to help expand the system’s reach.

Read is so worried about postal delays that he’s encouraging people to send ballots back a week before the election or instead plan to secure a postmark or vote another way.

“We can’t count on it,” said Read, referring to the Postal Service. “It might work, but I don’t want anyone to be taking a chance with their ballot.”

Voters who send their ballots back close to Election Day should go into the post office and ask workers to manually postmark the ballot, Read said.

“It’s not that the Postal Service is something you should avoid,” he said. “Just do it early if you’re going to use the mail.”

The Postal Service itself is also encouraging voters to send their ballots back well before Election Day to ensure they are counted. The agency has a 90-second public service announcement on its website urging people to “mail early.” For some voters, the agency suggests that people send their ballots in at least a week before the deadline.

author: Alfredo Seguel
title: Histórica alianza trasandina: Madres del Silencio firman acuerdo con Abuelas para buscar bebés apropiados por la dictadura en Chile
content:
La Fundación Hijos y Madres del Silencio, de Chile, firmó en Buenos Aires un convenio con Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo para buscar bebés sustraídos durante la dictadura de Pinochet. Registros oficiales identifican más de 23.400 niños enviados al extranjero. La unidad de búsqueda creada el 2025, fue desmantelada de inmediato con el Gobierno de Kast.


Las madres chilenas a las que dijeron que su bebé había muerto buscan a sus hijos con las Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo


Las otras víctimas de Pinochet:


En febrero de 1974, cinco meses después del golpe de Estado liderado por Augusto Pinochet, Amelia Flores dio a luz a su hijo Fernando en el Hospital Parroquial de San Bernardo. Dos horas después, el personal médico le dijo que había muerto, no le mostró el cuerpo y le aplicó una inyección que la dejó dormida tres días. A su esposo le entregaron un ataúd cerrado y un servicio fúnebre ya pagado. Así lo relató el periodista Manuel Barrientos en Página 12 de Argentina.


En 2020, Amelia vio por televisión el testimonio de una mujer con una vivencia idéntica y comprendió que su historia no era única, sino un patrón. Se acercó entonces a la

Fundación Hijos y Madres del Silencio (FHMS),

 nacida en 2014 como un grupo de Facebook. Según

Página 12

, junto a madres que buscaban a sus hijos escribían adultos desde Estados Unidos, Italia, Australia o los países nórdicos intentando descifrar su origen, lo que reveló una red de sustracción forzada y tráfico de niños a gran escala.


Los registros oficiales consolidados a partir de denuncias ante la justicia chilena identifican a más de 23.400 niños enviados al extranjero, aunque los investigadores creen que la cifra real podría duplicarse

. La fundación detectó chilenos apropiados en veinte países: unos 8.000 en Estados Unidos, más de 2.200 en Suecia y 500 solo en Cerdeña, además de cientos en Francia y Dinamarca. Según el reportaje, el despojo afectó a mujeres en situación de vulnerabilidad, muchas de comunidades originarias, y en él habrían operado congregaciones de la Iglesia Católica como intermediarias.


Cerca del 80% de los integrantes de la FHMS son mujeres

. Su presidenta y fundadora,

Marisol Rodríguez, busca un hermano o hermana que a su madre le dijeron que nació muerto; la periodista Ana María Olivares logró encontrar a una sobrina. La relación con el Estado ha sido de desidia y promesas incumplidas

: en 2019, una comisión investigadora de la Cámara de Diputados reconoció violaciones a los derechos humanos y la Corte Suprema designó un equipo para la causa penal.

Hacia el cierre del gobierno de Gabriel Boric se creó una unidad de búsqueda, desmantelada de inmediato tras la asunción de José Antonio Kast.


La semana reciente,

cuatro integrantes de la fundación viajaron a Buenos Aires para firmar un convenio de cooperación con Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo

. Por Abuelas firmaron la vicepresidenta Buscarita Roa, nacida en Chile, y el secretario Manuel Goncalves, nieto restituido; por la FHMS, Marisol Rodríguez, Ana María Olivares, María del Carmen García Castro y Amelia Flores. García Castro destacó que Abuelas es un referente mundial y que “nosotros no podemos inventar la pólvora”. Amelia, de 72 años y matemática, ve en el trabajo de Abuelas la clave para que la búsqueda de su hijo continúe en sus hijas y nietos.

author: CMI Argentina
title: #39EncuentroPlurinacional: “merecemos poder existir en la diversidad de cuerpos que somos”
content:
Entre los más de cien talleres del 39° Encuentro estuvo el de Activismos gordes, que se realizó en la Escuela Francisco Ortiz de Ocampo.


Mercedes Estruch, socióloga, del Colectivo Gordes Activistas de Argentina (CGA) y presidenta de la Fundación AnyBody Argentina, nos dijo que “el activismo gordo nace de la necesidad de defender los derechos de las personas gordas y denunciar la violencia, la discriminación y el odio hacia la gordura, y, por ende, hacia las personas gordas. Lo que reclamamos es la despatologización de la gordura para poder romper con el odio y el estigma a la gordura”.


“Creemos que las personas gordas y las mujeres, sobre todo, merecemos poder existir en la diversidad de cuerpos que somos, y sin tener que cumplir con un modelo único de cuerpo y de belleza, que está perpetuado por una cultura de la dieta, de las farmacéuticas, de la belleza, del fit”, agregó.


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Activismos-gordes-01.ogg


Audio: Mercedes Estruch


Con respecto al acceso al trabajo, “también es un derecho que se vulnera”, nos contó Mercedes Estruch. “Nuestra aspecto físico y nuestra corporalidad se vuelve una barrera discriminatoria”.


“En una situación como la que estamos, de crueldad absoluta y de crisis económica y social, las personas gordas estamos completamente vulneradas porque solemos tener acceso a trabajos más precarios e incluso también se vive mucho, cuando uno entra a trabajar, en la imposibilidad de que te brinden un uniforme como corresponde o mobiliario cómodo para la diversidad de cuerpos”.


“También vivimos muchas cuestiones que tienen que ver con la convivencia en los espacios de trabajo, donde nuestro nuestro cuerpo se pone en cuestión, se nos señala como algo que nos hace ser víctimas de desmerecimientos o malos tratos”.


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Activismos-gordes-02.ogg


Audio: Mercedes Estruch


Mercedes comentó que además, desde el Colectivo Gordes Activistas de Argentina organizan “los encuentros plurinacionales gordes. El último se realizó en CABA. Nos pueden seguir en las redes sociales,

@gordesactivando

, o

@encuentrogorde

. También pueden seguir a

@anybodyargentina

 y saber más sobre nuestro laburo”.

author: CMI Argentina
title: #39EncuentroPlurinacional: “El que avala a un compañero que violó se convierte en un cómplice”
content:
En el marco de la Asamblea Abya Yala, dos compañeras integrantes de Jubiladas Insurgentes realizaron importantes intervenciones.


“Nosotras, como jubiladas, que estamos luchando todos los miércoles desde hace tantos años, queremos luchar, decirles que luchamos por la jubilación de todos los trabajadores, que no se van a poder jubilar, y menos las nuevas generaciones, y que nuestra lucha es la lucha de todos. Por eso tenemos que darla unidos”, dijo una de las integrantes de Jubiladas Insurgentes.


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


Una publicación compartida por Indymedia Argentina (@indymedia.argentina)


“Y queremos saludar también, porque queremos decir que el feminismo es nuestra causa, porque el feminismo une. En momentos en que muchas organizaciones se ven partidas, el feminismo une, porque saca todos los males de raíz, que es el patriarcado y es la violencia machista. Así que luchamos con todos hasta el último día de nuestra vida. Gracias, compañeras”.


Por su parte, la segunda integrante de Jubiladas Insurgentes hizo énfasis en el silenciamiento y la invisibilización de la violencia de género y abusos dentro de las organizaciones: “Entre los grupos, sobre todo, jubilados y otros grupos y otros colectivos, hay muchísima violencia machista”.


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


Una publicación compartida por Indymedia Argentina (@indymedia.argentina)


“Quiero que lo sepan”, señalaron, “porque hay un montón de compañeras, chicas, adolescentes que están acusando a hombres adultos que realmente se zarpan ya porque fueron violadas, fueron violentadas, y están dentro de todos los grupos metidos. Por eso necesitamos, porque las chicas lo denuncian, pero ¿saben qué? ‘Hay que hablar con ellos’. ¿Qué hay que hablar con ellos? No tenemos nada que hablar con ellos. Porque tenemos que creerles a las chicas, no queremos más violentas y violentos dentro de los grupos”.


“Digo violentas también, porque hay mujeres que realmente nos dicen, ‘hay que ver si es así’. No tenemos nada que ver, no queremos más que las chicas queden afuera, que las mujeres queden afuera. Que queden ellos afuera, no nosotres”.


“El que avala a un compañero que violó se convierte en un cómplice”, apuntaron las Jubiladas Insurgentes, y reafirmaron: “No hay más vueltas que darle a eso, y nosotras ni por omisión queremos ser cómplices de eso”.


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


Una publicación compartida por Indymedia Argentina (@indymedia.argentina)

content:
En el marco del #39EncuentroPlurinacional se realizó el encuentro del Bloque Intersindical de mujeres de organizaciones gremiales de las tres centrales.


Allí, Carla Gaudensi, Secretaria General de la Federación Argentina de Trabajadores de Prensa (FATPREN) dijo “lo que nos afecta a todas es lo mismo. Estamos atravesando una situación hace 3 años, estamos viviendo bajo el asedio de este gobierno de Milei, por lo tanto, lo que nos agrupa es defender los derechos de las trabajadoras, de los trabajadores como clase, porque tenemos que echar a este gobierno, se tiene que terminar”.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por Indymedia Argentina (@indymedia.argentina)


“Los trabajadores y las trabajadoras que dependemos de nuestro salario, que vivimos de nuestro trabajo, no podemos estar ni un día más con este gobierno, así que fuera Milei. Para eso vamos a seguir militando con organización y lucha, lo vamos a derrotar”.

title: #39EncuentroPlurinacional: “es importante escuchar, debatir, reflexionar sobre la soberanía alimentaria”
content:
Sol Laje, de Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles de la Fundación Alimentaris, nos contó que participa del 39° Encuentro “en el marco de un proyecto que se llama Leguteca, donde trabajamos cuadernos de legumbres para comedores y para agentes de salud, donde buscamos contextualizar las legumbres, tanto desde la historia, la cultura, el cómo se comen, la cuestión nutricional, para que podamos comer más legumbres”.


Sol Laje


“Argentina es un país productor”, dijo, pero “comemos muy pocas legumbres, y es un alimento que está buenísimo incorporar a nuestras comidas, porque es nutritivo, porque es saludable, porque mejora las tierras, porque, además, como decía antes, somos productores, porque ayuda a reconstruir los suelos”.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por Indymedia Argentina (@indymedia.argentina)


“Pensamos que es fundamental compartir con personas de diferentes lugares del país, con mujeres y con diversidades, la soberanía alimentaria especialmente. Además, otros temas que nos convocan específicamente porque trabajamos con alimentación, sentimos que era importante escuchar, debatir, reflexionar sobre la soberanía alimentaria”, agregó Sol.

author: CMI Argentina
title: #39EncuentroPlurinacional: “Cuidar es un trabajo, se tiene que pagar”
content:
Marina Joski de Barrios de Pie e integrante de la mesa ejecutiva de la UTEP, nos contó que se hicieron presentes en el 39° Encuentro “con nuestras cuidadoras comunitarias, compañeras que vienen peleando desde el 11 de diciembre de 2023. Que fueron perseguidas, que fueron judicializadas, que les sacaron los alimentos de sus espacios comunitarios y que luego les sacaron sus salarios, nuestros salarios”.


Foto: Indymedia Argentina


Y continuó afirmando que “seguimos reivindicando y exigiendo el reconocimiento del trabajo comunitario como trabajo, un reconocimiento que no solo tiene que ser simbólico, sino real, efectivo y económico. Y somos parte del Acuerdo Nacional de los Cuidados”.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por Indymedia Argentina (@indymedia.argentina)


Por su parte, Norma Morales, Secretaria General Adjunta de la UTEP y también parte de Barrios de Pie, agregó que “el reconocimiento salarial es muy amplio. No es solamente ese sueldo asegurado a fin de mes, es mucho más amplio. Nuestras compañeras son compañeras que vienen sosteniendo la vida en nuestros espacios de cuidado comunitario en los barrios populares de todo el país. Y son compañeras que están grandes, ¿no? Compañeras que no van a tener la posibilidad de jubilarse, compañeras que hoy no son monotributistas, porque este gobierno se ha encargado de desmantelar todas esas políticas públicas que fortalecían, que nos fortalecían a nosotras mismas”.


“Entonces, también les ponemos en desafío a la sociedad, a la política, a los estados y a quien sea, quién nos cuida ahora a nosotras, ¿no? Somos nosotras las que nos ponemos siempre en primera línea cuando nuestro país atraviesa situaciones de crisis. Pero ¿y ahora? Nosotras ya estamos grandes, estamos en una generación ya en donde queremos empezar a disfrutar de nuestra vida. Pero, bueno, no tenemos nada asegurado”.


“Por eso estamos acá, visibilizando este reconocimiento salarial, reconocimiento social y reconocimiento político”, reafirmó Norma Morales.

title: Edirne'de devlet korumasındaki çocuklar kayıp iddiası
content:
Edirne’de Çocuk İlk Kabul Merkezi’nde koruma altında tutulan çok sayıda çocuğun, kendilerine verilen ihtiyaç izni süresinin dolmasına rağmen merkeze geri dönmediği bildirildi.

Eğitimden Haberler’in aktardığına göre olay, 11 Ekim günü saat 14.30 sıralarında emniyet kayıtlarına geçti. Kurumda görevli İ.K., merkezde kalan çok sayıda çocuğun ihtiyaç iznine çıktıktan sonra belirlenen süre içerisinde kuruma dönmediğini belirterek yetkililere başvuruda bulundu.

Kurum görevlisi İ.K., Selimiye Polis Merkezi Amirliği’ne giderek durumu polise bildirdi. Görevli, çocukların bulunarak güvenli bir şekilde merkeze teslim edilmesini talep etti.

Başvuru sırasında çocukların güvenliğine ilişkin endişeler dile getirilirken, herhangi bir olumsuzluk yaşanması durumunda sorumlular hakkında kurum adına hukuki yollara başvurulacağı ifade edildi.

İhbar üzerine ekiplerin çalışma başlattığı belirtilirken, izin süresi dolmasına rağmen kuruma dönmeyen çocukların nerede olduğuna dair henüz net bir bilgi bulunmuyor. Emniyet birimlerinin incelemesi sürerken, resmi kurumlardan henüz bir bilgi gelmedi.

title: Walter White'ın oğlunu canlandırmıştı: RJ Mitte 34 yaşında hayatını kaybetti
content:
Fotoğraf: Gage Skidmore from Peoria, AZ, United States of America/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 2.0

Breaking Bad dizisinde Walter White’ın oğlunu canlandırmasıyla tanınan ABD’li oyuncu RJ Mitte, 34 yaşında hayatını kaybetti.

Serebral palsiyle yaşayan Mitte'nin ölüm nedenine dair bilgi verilmedi. Temsilcisi Sean Reilly tarafından BBC'ye yapılan açıklamada “Sevilen oyuncu, hayırsever ve engelli haklarının tutkulu savunucusu RJ Mitte’nin trajik ölümünü derin bir üzüntüyle paylaşıyoruz” denildi.

Reilly, “Mitte, rolüne sahicilik kattı ve engellilik konusunda farkındalığı ve kapsayıcılığı destekleyen bir platform oluşturdu” dedi. United Cerebral Palsy ve Shriners Children’s kuruluşlarının elçiliğini üstlenen Mitte, “kalıp yargılara meydan okumak ve engelli bireylerin daha fazla temsil edilmesini sağlamak için” The Mitte Foundation’ı kurmuştu.

title: Trabzonspor net borcunu 2,9 milyar TL olarak açıkladı
content:
Trabzonspor, 1 Haziran-31 Ağustos 2026 dönemine ilişkin mali tablolarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu’nda yayımladı. Kulüp, yapılan netleştirmeler sonrasında 31 Ağustos 2026 itibarıyla net borcun 2,9 milyar TL olduğunu bildirdi.

Kulüpten yapılan açıklama şu şekilde:

"Şirketimizin 1 Haziran - 31 Ağustos 2026 dönemine ilişkin mali tabloları, bugün itibarıyla Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu’nda (KAP) açıklanmıştır. Mali tablolarımız incelendiğinde, kısa ve uzun vadeli borçlar toplamından, 6,7 milyar TL tutarındaki dönen varlıklar toplamı, kamulaştırma gelirlerimizden Trabzonspor Kulübü uhdesinde olan Sportif A.Ş. konsolide mali tablolarında yer almayan 2,6 milyar TL tutarındaki alacağımız ve 1,8 milyar TL tutarındaki enflasyon muhasebesi kaynaklı herhangi bir nakit çıkışı yaratmayacak işlemler netleştirildiğinde, kulübümüzün 31.08.2026 tarihi itibari ile net borcu 2,9 milyar TL olduğu görülecektir. Açıklamamızda görüleceği üzere, kamuoyumuzun da malumu olan 4,9 milyar TL tutarındaki kamulaştırma alacağımız toplam borçlarımızdan düşülmüştür. Bununla birlikte rapor tarihimiz itibari ile gerçekleşmiş olan bonservis borçlarımızın ileriye dönük tüm tutarları bu borçlarımız içerisinde yer almaktadır."

author: Unknown
title: Trump: Enerji ateşkesini Rusya da Ukrayna da ihlal ediyor
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Rusya ile Ukrayna arasında varılan enerji ateşkesi anlaşmasının "her iki taraftan da" ihlal edildiğini, ancak anlaşmanın geçerli olduğunu savundu.

Seçim mitingi için Ohio'ya hareketinden önce Beyaz Saray'ın çıkışında basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtlayan Trump, Moskova ile Kiev arasındaki enerji ateşkesi anlaşmasının halen geçerli olup olmadığı sorusuna, "Evet (anlaşmayı) kabul ettiler. Neden biliyor musun? Çünkü kabul ettiklerini ben söyledim. İşte bu yüzden kabul ettiler; çünkü onların kabul ettiğini söyledim. Artık bu meselenin çözülmesi gerekiyor. Bu savaş tam bir felaket" yanıtını verdi.

ABD Başkanı, Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Zelenskiy'nin, "Rusya'nın anlaşmayı ihlal ettiği" yönündeki açıklamasının hatırlatılması üzerine, "Buna bakmamız lazım, çünkü her iki taraftan da ihlaller oldu" değerlendirmesini yaptı.

Trump, sadece Putin'in anlaşmayı desteklediği, ancak Zelenskiy'nin desteklemediği yönündeki haberlere katılmadığını kaydederek, iki liderin de anlaşmaya destek verdiğini savundu.

Daha sonra iki ülke arasındaki son duruma ilişkin de açıklamalarda bulunan Trump, "Bence Putin bir anlaşma yapmak istiyor, Zelenskiy'nin de anlaşma yapmasını istemesini sağlamalıyız. Bence Putin, anlaşma yapmayı Zelenskiy'den daha fazla istiyor" değerlendirmesini yaptı.

İki liderin de anlaşma yapmak istediğini, ancak nasıl anlaşacaklarını bilmediklerini savunan ABD Başkanı, Putin ve Zelenskiy'nin anlaşmasını sağlamaları gerektiğini ifade etti.

ABD Başkanı ayrıca, Rusya ile yaptıkları dizel anlaşmasının sadece ABD için değil, tüm dünya için önemli bir anlaşma olduğunu ve bunu tüm ülkeler için yaptığını dile getirdi.

ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Suudi Arabistan'a yönelik saldırılara dair, "Husiler yanlış işler yapıyorlar hem de çok yanlış. Bu durum hiç iyi değil" değerlendirmesini yaptı.

AA muhabirinin, "Husilerin son dönemde saldırılarını artırması ile ABD'deki Kongre ara seçimleri arasında bir ilişki görüp görmediği" şeklindeki sorusunu da cevaplayan Trump, şunları söyledi: "Bunun seçimleri nasıl etkileyeceğini bilmiyorum. Bunu hesaba katmıyorum. Tek bildiğim, İran’ın asla nükleer silaha sahip olmayacağı ve bu durumun artık gerçekleşmiş olduğu. Asla nükleer silaha sahip olmayacaklar. Ancak Husiler yanlış davranıyorlar."

author: infolibre
title: Παράσταση διαμαρτυρίας εκπαιδευτικών αισθητικής αγωγής και ΣΕΠΕ – ΕΛΜΕ, πραγματοποιήθηκε σήμερα στη Θεσσαλονίκη – ΦΩΤΟ
content:
Παράσταση διαμαρτυρίας πραγματοποίησαν σήμερα, Δευτέρα 12 Οκτωβρίου 2026, οι εκπαιδευτικοί Αισθητικής Αγωγής (Μουσικής – Θεάτρου -Εικαστικών), μαζί με Συλλόγους Εκπαιδευτικών Πρωτοβάθμιας και Δευτεροβάθμιας Εκπαίδευσης, στην Περιφερειακή Διεύθυνση Εκπαίδευσης Κεντρικής Μακεδονίας. Βασικό αίτημα της κινητοποίησης ήταν η

ΑΜΕΣΗ

πρόσληψη εκπαιδευτικών Αισθητικής Αγωγής, προκειμένου να καλυφθούν

ΟΛΑ

τα εκπαιδευτικά κενά

,

Διαφάνεια

 καταγραφής των κενών και

Κατάργηση

 των αναθέσεων των καλλιτεχνικών μαθημάτων. Η πλήρης απαλλαγή όλων των εκπαιδευτικών που έχουν κληθεί σε απολογία, καθώς και η οριστική αρχειοθέτηση όλων των εκκρεμών πειθαρχικών που σχετίζονται με τη συμμετοχή των εκπαιδευτικών στην Απεργία–Αποχή από την αξιολόγηση.


Ιδιαίτερα αρνητική εντύπωση προκάλεσε η απουσία τόσο του Περιφερειακού Διευθυντή Εκπαίδευσης όσο και του αναπληρωτή του

, παρότι η παράσταση διαμαρτυρίας ήταν γνωστή. Η απουσία τους δεν συνέβαλε στην ουσιαστική επικοινωνία με τους εκπαιδευτικούς και τους εκπροσώπους των Συλλόγων, οι οποίοι προσήλθαν για να θέσουν τα προβλήματα και να διεκδικήσουν άμεσες λύσεις.


Για το λόγο αυτό πραγματοποιούμε:


NEA

 ΠΑΡΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΔΙΑΜΑΡΤΥΡΙΑΣ των κλάδων ΑΙΣΘΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΑΓΩΓΗΣ (ΜΟΥΣΙΚΗΣ-ΘΕΑΤΡΟΥ-ΕΙΚΑΣΤΙΚΩΝ)


Την Τετάρτη 14/10/2026 και ώρα 14:00 στην Π.Δ.Ε.Κεντ. Μακεδονίας (Κτίριο

ZEDA

)


Καλούμε τους Συλλόγους Εκπαιδευτικών Πρωτοβάθμιας Εκπαίδευσης, τις ΕΛΜΕ, τους Συλλόγους Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων, τους φοιτητικούς συλλόγους, τους εκπαιδευτικούς όλων των κλάδων και κάθε πολίτη που υπερασπίζεται το δημόσιο σχολείο να στηρίξει την κινητοποίηση.


Εκπαιδευτικοί μουσικής, θεάτρου και εικαστικών ζητούμε διαφάνεια και άμεση στελέχωση των σχολείων


Η σχολική χρονιά έχει ήδη προχωρήσει και όμως σε σχολεία εξακολουθούν να υπάρχουν ώρες μουσικής, θεατρικής αγωγής και εικαστικών

χωρίς

 τον αντίστοιχο

εκπαιδευτικό ειδικότητας.

 Την ίδια στιγμή, εκπαιδευτικοί των συγκεκριμένων κλάδων

 παραμένουμε διαθέσιμοι στους πίνακες αναπληρωτών, περιμένοντας να προσληφθούμε.


Απτό παράδειγμα συρρίκνωσης των εκπαιδευτικών αισθητικής αγωγής αποτελούντα στοιχεία των προσλήψεων των Μουσικών ΠΕ79.01.


Στην Κεντρική Μακεδονία, οι προσλήψεις ΠΕ79.01 στην Α΄ φάση της Γενικής Παιδείας μειώθηκαν από 107 το 2022-23 σε μόλις 9 το 2026-27, δηλαδή κατά 91,6%. Η πορεία είναι συνεχής: 78 προσλήψεις το 2023-24, 54 το 2024-25, 20 το 2025-26 και 9 φέτος. Στην Α΄ και Β΄ Θεσσαλονίκης μαζί, οι 58 προσλήψεις της Α΄ φάσης του 2022-23 περιορίστηκαν σε μόλις 4 φέτος.


Τα στοιχεία προκύπτουν από τους επίσημους ονομαστικούς πίνακες προσλήψεων του Υπουργείου Παιδείας και έχουν καταγραφεί με κοινή μεθοδολογία για όλα τα έτη.


Το πρόβλημα, όμως, δεν περιορίζεται μόνο στον αριθμό των προσλήψεων.


Θέτουμε ένα βασικό ερώτημα:


Πόσες είναι πραγματικά οι ανάγκες των σχολείων και πόσες από αυτές φτάνουν τελικά να καταγραφούν, να εγκριθούν και να καλυφθούν ως κενά;


Υπάρχουν ώρες μουσικής, θεάτρου και εικαστικών στα ωρολόγια προγράμματα. Υπάρχουν εκπαιδευτικοί των αντίστοιχων ειδικοτήτων διαθέσιμοι στους πίνακες. Παρ’ όλα αυτά, ανάγκες παραμένουν χωρίς κάλυψη.


Γι’ αυτό ζητούμε πλήρη και δημόσια εικόνα για ολόκληρη τη διαδρομή ενός κενού: από τη στιγμή που διαπιστώνεται μέσα στη σχολική μονάδα έως τη δήλωσή του από τις αρμόδιες υπηρεσίες, την έγκρισή του και, τελικά, την πρόσληψη του εκπαιδευτικού που θα το καλύψει.


Πόσες ανάγκες καταγράφηκαν; Πόσα κενά ζητήθηκαν; Πόσα προωθήθηκαν; Πόσα εγκρίθηκαν; Πόσα καλύφθηκαν και πόσα παραμένουν σήμερα ακάλυπτα;


Δεν πρόκειται για γραφειοκρατικές λεπτομέρειες. Χωρίς αυτά τα στοιχεία δεν μπορεί να υπάρχει πραγματική εικόνα της στελέχωσης των σχολείων.


Γιατί το γεγονός ότι ένα κενό δεν εμφανίζεται τελικά στις προσλήψεις δεν σημαίνει ότι η εκπαιδευτική ανάγκη έπαψε να υπάρχει.


Ιδιαίτερο προβληματισμό προκαλεί το τι συμβαίνει όταν ώρες καλλιτεχνικών μαθημάτων παραμένουν ακάλυπτες ή αντιμετωπίζονται μέσω αναθέσεων σε άλλους κλάδους και άλλων διοικητικών λύσεων. Ζητούμε να αποσαφηνιστεί αν και σε ποιο βαθμό αυτές οι πρακτικές επηρεάζουν την καταγραφή των πραγματικών κενών.


Εάν πραγματικές ανάγκες δεν αποτυπώνονται ως κενά της αντίστοιχης ειδικότητας, υπάρχει κίνδυνος να δημιουργείται ένας μόνιμος κύκλος συρρίκνωσης: λιγότερα καταγεγραμμένα κενά, λιγότερα αιτήματα για προσωπικό, λιγότερες προσλήψεις και τελικά ακόμη μικρότερη παρουσία των καλλιτεχνικών ειδικοτήτων στα σχολεία.


Δεν ζητούμε να δημιουργηθούν τεχνητές θέσεις. Ζητούμε να αποτυπωθούν οι ανάγκες που ήδη υπάρχουν μέσα στα σχολεία και να γνωρίζουμε …

author: Unknown
title: Special and psychological warfare propaganda targeting the process
content:
The dialogue and negotiation process surrounding the Peace and Democratic Society Process, which has been progressing over the past two years at what could be described as a painfully slow pace, has reached a critical juncture. The process appears to be experiencing turbulence, while the deepening climate of uncertainty is weakening public confidence.


Devlet Bahçeli's election-related remarks at the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) parliamentary group meeting appear to indicate that a policy is being pursued to extend the process into the election period. As developments unfold in this way, the slow pace or prolongation of the process creates more opportunities for groups seeking to interfere with it. It also provides fertile ground for the complaints of those opposed to the process and the hostile rhetoric of pro-government media.


Alongside attacks on Peoples’ Leader Abdullah Öcalan and the Kurdish Freedom Movement by fascist, nationalist and profiteering groups opposed to the process, the disinformation and aggressive rhetoric spread by pro-government media align with the forces seeking war rather than peace. Their primary objective is to create a sense of resignation and despair among the public and democratic forces.


Throughout world history, major propaganda campaigns have shaken societies, drawing on particular sources and methods.


The political establishment is pursuing its policies by emulating Hitler's propaganda minister, Joseph Goebbels, and adopting his methods. The special warfare media aligned with the government also operate along the lines of National Socialism, following the statement attributed to Hitler's propagandist: “Give me a media without a conscience, and I will organise the whole of society and turn it into an instrument.”


It is important to recognise that the attacks carried out by pro-government media and online trolls, as well as local nationalist and collaborationist groups, within a particular ideological framework are not solely the work of the government itself. The emergence of systematic attacks at this stage appears linked to the shrinking room for manoeuvre of powerful figures behind the war and profiteering lobbies. The outbursts of these groups amount to little more than demands for the continuation of war to preserve the interests of big capital and a system built on profiteering. They therefore conduct most of their attacks through digital platforms and television, seeking to legitimise them through war propaganda.


On one side stands the free press, which represents the language of truth and seeks to reveal the democratic character of social reality. On the other stands the pro-government media network, which represents dominant and ruling powers and seeks to influence society through widespread propaganda, aiming to achieve more lasting and deeply rooted results through psychological warfare. An ideological and political struggle is taking place between these two sides: those who profit from war and those who insist on advocating peace.


The Turkish state has repeatedly introduced censorship and bans to prevent people from following the free press, which reports on the basis of facts. Over the past two weeks, hundreds of social media accounts, including those belonging to free press outlets and related organisations, have either been blocked or shut down on the grounds that they allegedly “threaten national security.”


Institutionalised racism, sexism and corruption are deepening in Turkey. Rather than confronting groups that have lost their moral values and profiteering lobbies, the government and political establishment are targeting free press outlets that practise peace journalism and seek to build public engagement with the process.


To understand what pro-government media are doing today and why psychological propaganda is being used so extensively as part of special warfare, we need to examine what propaganda and agitation actually mean.


As is widely known, propaganda and agitation activities have become increasingly important today. These activities naturally bring to mind the work of the press and broadcasting organisations. Such efforts are primarily carried out within a specific programme and aim to spread a particular idea. The purpose is not simply to talk. The real objective is to put a particular idea into practice through conscious and systematic efforts. We can therefore say that society's emotions, consciousness, perceptions and psychology …

author: Unknown
title: Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan: Society should stand by artists, and artists should stand by society
content:
ANF spoke with artist Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan, one of the signatories of the “1,001 Signatures for a Democratic Republic and Peace” campaign announced on 12 September, about the role of art and artists in the Peace and Democratic Society Process.


We met with Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan at her exhibition titled “Îhtîmaleke Asîman / A Sky of Possibility,” which opened on 22 September. She is the daughter of a family that migrated from Eruh to Istanbul in 1993 during the forced evacuation of villages. The artist, who was held at Bakırköy Women’s Closed Prison from 2017 to 2024, describes the works featured in the exhibition as follows: “In my works, I have depicted my own ten-year journey. This period encompasses three stages of my life: one before prison, another during my time in prison, and the final stage, which is the transition to freedom.”


Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan, who says she works across multiple disciplines, focuses on subjects such as memory, space, freedom, human rights, and ecology in her art.


“Artists must keep the process and its memory alive”


After her release from prison, one of the most important concepts she began to question was freedom. We started our conversation with Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan in front of her work titled “Laş / Body.” In this piece, in which she uses a wall as a metaphor, Dîlan Cûdî portrays the resistance of a body that dissolves into the wall while simultaneously scraping away at it.


Explaining why she felt compelled to sign the “1,001 Signatures for a Democratic Republic and Peace” campaign, Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan said: “Unfortunately, there have been periods when peace was not discussed enough in Turkey. Given that such significant steps are being taken, I considered that I, too, have responsibilities to fulfill. That is why I needed to become a signatory at this point.”


“Artists must be closely connected to the people”


Saruhan added: “I believe artists have a duty to keep this process and its memory alive, document it, expand the space for freedom of expression, and bring out art’s capacity for satire and irony. Softening the harsh atmosphere that currently exists is also among these responsibilities. That is why we artists have a great deal of responsibility.”


She continued: “We are talking about a society in which peace and freedom are discussed and freedom of expression is not restricted. At the same time, I believe the Peace and Democratic Society Process is creating an environment that supports art, opens up space for it, and strives to bring it further into the foreground,” said Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan, adding that art plays a role in advancing society, preserving its memory, and connecting it with its culture.


Emphasizing that artists must remain closely connected to the people and society, Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan said, “And while maintaining that connection, they must find a language that allows them to talk about everything. They must be able to create such a language and open up a channel. I believe that once they open up that channel, they can connect with society and with people, enter every sphere of life, and foster mutual understanding.”


Once again reminding artists of their responsibilities, Dîlan Cûdî Saruhan called on everyone to take responsibility, making the following appeal: “At a time when we need peace more than ever, unfortunately, artists may not occupy a particularly loved or valued place in society, but we are still among those who can transform it. We have roles to play and responsibilities to fulfill.


We are at a point where society must stand by artists, and artists must stand by society. And we are talking about peace at such a time. Talking about peace is a serious matter and truly requires a courageous approach. At this point, I call on everyone to take responsibility.”

author: Unknown
title: MHP Deputy Chairman expects results in the peace process by the end of November
content:
As part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, MHP (Nationalist Movement Party) Deputy Chairman Feti Yıldız expects concrete results by the end of November. Following this, legal procedures are expected to be initiated for prisoners incarcerated for so-called terrorism-related offenses. According to Yıldız, around 2,800 people could benefit from the legal provisions. However, founding members of the PKK are expected to be excluded.


Yıldız spoke to Sabah columnist Yavuz Donat about the next stages of the peace process. AKP Deputy Chairman Hüseyin Yayman also took part in the talk. Both politicians are members of the parliamentary Commission for National Solidarity, Fraternity and Democracy and were among the representatives who met with Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan on the prison island of İmralı on behalf of parliament.


“No one can say they are not involved”


Yayman described the peace process as a matter that concerns both the state and society and must be advanced with restraint. “Such things are not achieved through talking, but through silence,” he said. At the same time, he pointed to the government’s existing “red lines.” According to Yayman, a public opinion poll conducted in September showed 73.4 percent support for the process. He described the framework law, adopted by the Turkish parliament with 467 votes, as a safeguard for the next stages of the process.


“After the 467 votes in favor in parliament, no one can say anymore, ‘I am not involved in this matter, in this process.’ It is the responsibility of all of us to resolve this issue and look to the future,” Yayman said. The AKP politician also emphasized that the talks held over the past two years and the contacts with Öcalan had not undermined Turkey’s territorial integrity. He said one of the most important achievements was that families were no longer receiving news of further deaths in the war.


Yıldız reaffirms constitutional limits


Feti Yıldız interpreted the broad parliamentary support for the framework law as an expression of the political will to resolve the conflict. At the same time, he made it clear that the first four articles of the Turkish Constitution, which establish, among other things, the form of government and fundamental principles of the state, are unalterable and cannot even be proposed for amendment. The MHP politician referred to the work of the parliamentary commission, which had listened to numerous social groups over the course of 21 sessions. These included families of fallen soldiers, disabled war veterans, civil society organizations, the so-called Diyarbakır Mothers, the Saturday Mothers, business representatives, and academics.


Regarding the next steps, Yıldız stated: “Results will be achieved by the end of November. After that, legal proceedings will begin for those imprisoned for ‘terrorism-related offenses.’ Around 2,800 people will benefit from the law.” However, he said, the proposed provisions would not apply to members of the PKK’s founding cadre dating back to 1984 or to approximately 230 senior leaders. Yıldız did not provide further details on how the measures would be implemented.

title: Mohamed: Attacks in Heseke an attempt to undermine Kurdish-Arab coexistence and regional stability
content:
Ruksen Mohamed, spokesperson for the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ), spoke about the dangers posed by the recent attacks in the city of Heseke. She considered the targeting of women’s symbolism and the denigration of their struggle and sacrifices to be attempts to undermine stability and incite discord among the components of Syrian society, particularly Kurds and Arabs.


Ruksen Mohamed stressed that women have demonstrated their ability to bring about positive change through their struggle and their political, social, organisational, and military participation. She noted that the experience of women in Rojava has established their fundamental role in building a society characterised by peace and stability and respect for diversity.


She also explained that attacks on women’s values, existence, and will reflect a mindset seeking to weaken society and dismantle the bonds between peoples. She emphasised that these practices are not coincidental, but rather part of a plan carrying messages that threaten social cohesion, security, and stability.


The YPJ spokesperson further stressed that targeting Kurdish women, their sacrifices, and their standing threatens coexistence among the peoples of the region and opens the door to further tensions and division.


Ruksen Mohamed affirmed that recognising women’s existence, identity, and will is an essential condition for any serious path towards democratic change in Syria. She called for respect for the rights of all components of society and for ensuring their political and social participation, free from exclusion and discrimination. She also called for those responsible for the attacks and acts of sabotage to be held accountable, stressing that they must not escape legal accountability. She urged the adoption of serious measures to protect civil peace and prevent the incitement of discord.


She concluded by affirming that women’s struggle will continue and that their sacrifices and struggle entitle them to defend their identity, rights, and position, protect their achievements, and work towards strengthening security, stability, and coexistence within Syrian society.

title: Future Syria Party demands justice seven years after the murder of Hevrîn Xelef
content:
On the seventh anniversary of the murder of Kurdish politician Hevrîn Xelef, the Future Syria Party (Arabic: Hizbul Suri Mustakbel, Kurdish: Partiya Sûriyeya Pêşerojê) called on the international community to hold those responsible for the crime accountable. In a statement marking the anniversary on October 12, the party leadership commemorated its former secretary-general, who was murdered in 2019 by members of an Ankara-backed jihadist militia during the Turkish invasion of Rojava.


Commitment to a democratic and decentralized system


Xelef, who was also known as the “Jasmine of Peace,” was killed together with her driver, Ferhad Ramadan, near Qamişlo. The Future Syria Party paid tribute to her as a symbol of the resistance of Syrian women and as a voice for peace, national unity, and opposition to policies of occupation. “Hevrîn Xelef was not only an outstanding political trailblazer but remains a role model for women’s social struggle in Syria,” the party stated.


The party remarked that Xelef’s murder did not break the political will to establish a pluralistic, democratic, and decentralized system, but instead strengthened it. “We reaffirm our goal of a political system in which the rights of all social and ethnic communities in Syria, as well as their participation in shaping their future, are guaranteed.”


At the same time, the party renewed its condemnation of the murder and called on international human rights organizations and judicial institutions to take responsibility for investigating the crime and bringing the perpetrators to justice. “On behalf of all bodies and offices of the Future Syria Party, its women and youth, we renew our pledge to the Jasmine of Syria,” the statement concluded. The party said it would continue to carry the torch of peace and follow the path of those who had fallen until freedom, justice, and equality were achieved in Syria.


Militia leader responsible integrated into the new Syrian army


Hevrîn Xelef (also spelled Havrin Khalaf) was a trained civil engineer and the first secretary-general of the Future Syria Party. On October 12, 2019, just days after the start of the Turkish invasion of Serêkaniyê (Ras al-Ain) and Girê Spî (Tal Abyad), the then 34-year-old politician was ambushed and executed on the M4 highway by members of the Turkish-backed jihadist militia Ahrar al-Sharqiya. The attackers severely abused Xelef and mutilated her body. The autopsy report documented, among other injuries, gunshot wounds, fractures to her legs, face and skull, as well as injuries to her scalp.


In addition to Xelef and her driver, seven other civilians were also killed in the attack. Human rights organizations and the United Nations classified the politician’s killing as a targeted execution. Seven years after the crime, the militia leader held responsible has still not been brought to justice. Ahmad Ihsan Fayyad al-Hayes, known by his alias “Abu Hatem Shaqra,” is now commander of the 86th Division of the Syrian army under the Islamist transitional government of Ahmed al-Sharaa.

title: YRJ commemorates journalists Dilîşan Îbiş and Dilovan Gever
content:
The Association of Women Journalists in Rojava (YRJ) commemorated journalists Dilîşan Îbiş and Dilovan Gever on the anniversary of their deaths. Both journalists were killed while reporting on the war in North and East Syria. In a statement on Monday, the organization paid tribute to their efforts to document war crimes, highlight the suffering of civilians, and convey the realities of society.


Dilîşan Îbiş documented the suffering of civilians


Dilîşan Îbiş was among the media professionals who reported directly from the scenes of events following the beginning of the Rojava Revolution on July 19, 2012. Working under dangerous conditions for the ANHA news agency, she documented developments on the ground and brought the plight of civilians to international attention.


On October 12, 2017, she was killed in an attack by the Islamic State (ISIS) terrorist group while reporting on civilians fleeing the area during the final anti-ISIS offensive in Deir ez-Zor. Other members of the independent press were also killed alongside her.


“Dilîşan Îbiş was among the women journalists who consciously chose to be at the heart of events. Her death exemplified the dangers faced by journalists documenting the truth under wartime conditions,” YRJ stated.


Dilovan Gever reported on the resistance against the Turkish offensive


The association stated that Dilovan Gever (Dilan Ölmez) also regarded her journalistic work as a social responsibility. In 2014, she crossed the Turkish border during the mobilization for Kobanê and joined the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ). Following the liberation of the city, she worked in the morgue’s archives, documenting the lives, struggles, and deaths of thousands of fallen fighters. From 2018 onward, she worked at the YPJ Press Center. As a YPJ correspondent, she took part in the final offensive against ISIS in Deir ez-Zor, among other operations, and reported from the front lines.


Following the start of the Turkish invasion of Serêkaniyê (Ras al-Ain) and Girê Spî (Tal Abyad) on October 9, 2019, Dilovan Gever reported on the war and resistance in the region. On October 13, 2019, she was killed alongside several others in a Turkish airstrike in Girê Spî.


“The memory of our comrade Dilovan Gever will live on in the history of the free press and in the collective memory of women journalists who gave their lives to bring her message to the public,” the association stated.


“The events they documented are an indelible part of our collective memory”


YRJ paid tribute to both journalists as representatives of a form of journalism committed to the truth and to amplifying the voices of women and society. “We remember Dilîşan Îbiş and Dilovan Gever with great pride and respect. The images, testimonies, and events they documented are an indelible part of the collective memory of the press,” the statement said.


“Attacks on journalists cannot silence independent reporting. Rather, the legacy of our slain colleagues carries a responsibility to continue their work. The targeted killing of journalists will not silence the voice of truth or deter the free press from its path,” the YRJ emphasized.

title: Syriac Federation condemns demolition measures in İdil
content:
The International Syriac Federation of Azech has strongly condemned the demolition measures targeting Syriac residents in the İdil district of Şırnak province.


In a written statement, the federation accused Mayor Türkan Kayır and municipal council member Ekrem Şimşek of using the municipal administration as a tool for personal vendettas. The measures reportedly targeted families who had returned to their homeland after decades of displacement.


On October 6, the municipal administration ordered the demolition of a residential and commercial building belonging to Alyet Karagöl. In addition, four other residential buildings and the newly constructed guesthouse of the Syriac Orthodox Church of St. Mary were sealed off. The municipality justified the measures by citing violations of building regulations.


https://twitter.com/gazetesabro/status/2107848754317447376


“We expected impartial municipal governance”


The federation recalled that Türkan Kayır was elected mayor on the DEM Party ticket in the 2024 local elections. “The Syriacs, Kurds, and other residents of İdil expected the elected mayor to govern impartially,” the statement said. Instead, Kayır allegedly began targeting members of the Syriac community who had criticized her policies. According to the federation, she was significantly influenced by municipal council member Ekrem Şimşek, whom the federation accused of personal enrichment and deliberate interference.


The cooperation of the persons in question with the DEM Party ended in December 2024. The party leadership expelled both Kayır and Şimşek for acting “in accordance with anti-party mindsets.” Kayır subsequently refused to resign as mayor and continued in office as an independent. Around 20 months later, she switched to the AKP. On August 14, during celebrations marking the ruling party’s 25th anniversary in Ankara, she officially joined the AKP. President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan personally pinned the party badge on her.


According to the federation, Kayır was also expelled from Syriac organizations. It was only after her switch to the AKP that she reportedly began implementing the previously approved measures against Syriac families. First, the guesthouse of St. Mary’s Church was sealed off on the grounds of building regulations. On Tuesday, the building belonging to Alyet Karagöl was demolished. At the same time, the homes of Süleyman Karagöl, Ibrahim Konutgan, Şemun Gösteriş, and Filiz Tokuş were sealed off.


Accusations of double standards in building regulations


“Türkan Kayır and Ekrem Şimşek have disregarded all laws and considered any means acceptable to pursue their own interests,” the federation criticized. According to the federation, neither the will of the voters nor social relations, moral standards, or their responsibility toward the population played any role in their actions.


The federation was particularly critical of the selective enforcement of building regulations. In İdil, nearly 80 percent of buildings, including public facilities, were reportedly constructed outside the framework of regular urban planning and building inspections. According to the federation, the private house Kayır had built after her election was also constructed without a permit and is located in a protected area. Nevertheless, despite complaints filed against it, the building has not been demolished.


Furthermore, the federation has leveled bribery allegations against the mayor. It accuses Kayır of accepting contributions toward the construction of her private home from contractors who had been awarded public contracts. According to the federation, personal conflicts with relatives of Alyet Karagöl and other families were behind the measures taken against them. Kayır and Şimşek apparently believed they could now pursue their interests with the backing of the AKP.


The policy of displacement has taken different forms


The federation places these developments within the historical context of the persecution of Syriacs in Tur Abdin. It recalls the murder of Mikael Bayro in İdil and the 1915 genocide known as Sayfo. “The policy of displacement and extermination has continued in various forms from the years of Sayfo to the present day. As a result of these policies, İdil has been largely depopulated of its Syriac inhabitants,” the statement said. The federation considers it all the more painful that a mayor from the Syriac community is now targeting the few families who have returned to their homeland …

title: Talabani says PUK ready to protect Kurdistan amid regional tensions
content:
Bafel Jalal Talabani, President of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), has warned that the region is facing a precarious situation, stressing the need for greater preparedness, political agreements and cooperation to address mounting security and economic challenges.


Speaking during a panel discussion at the Middle East Research Institute (MERI) Forum 2026 in Erbil on Monday, Talabani said the global economic downturn, alongside the security and economic risks facing Iraq and the Kurdistan Region, made it essential for political forces to work towards practical solutions.


“We must all support the peace process,” he said, adding that the PUK was strengthening its historic relationships across different sectors while maintaining strong international ties and engaging with a broad range of political parties.


During the session, titled “

Building a Stronger Kurdistan: Unity, Security, and Regional Partnerships

”, Talabani discussed developments in the Kurdistan Region, Iraq and the wider region, as well as international affairs and possible ways to address current challenges.


Addressing the PUK’s international relations, Talabani said he was proud of the party’s ties with the United States, Iran, Russia, the United Kingdom and other countries.


“However, the PUK has never been, nor will it ever be, subservient to anyone,” he said. “Anyone who claims that the PUK follows the agendas or directives of other countries simply does not understand politics.”


On forming the new Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG), Talabani said negotiations were progressing and that a government could be formed quickly if outstanding issues were resolved.


“We could form the government within 24 hours, but we must first resolve the existing issues,” he said.


He noted that constructive meetings had taken place in recent days, including what he described as positive discussions between Qubad Talabani and Masrour Barzani. He also confirmed that he had met Shaswar Abdulwahid, adding that the PUK remained in contact with all political parties while further discussions continued away from the media spotlight.


Regarding the possibility of renewed conflict, Talabani said the PUK had its own plans to protect the people of the Kurdistan Region.


“Should war break out again, the PUK has its own plan. We are capable of protecting our people alongside the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP), given the strong coordination between us,” he said.


Commenting on the withdrawal of US forces from Iraq, PUK President said Washington could return to the country relatively quickly, pointing to the presence of US forces in neighbouring Jordan.


Turning to efforts to disarm armed groups in Iraq, he said many were willing to surrender their weapons and that Iran could help bring them under the authority of the Iraqi government.


“With Iran’s assistance, we could bring them under the umbrella of the Iraqi government, although this process requires time and trust,” he said.


Talabani added that Iran has several red lines and argued that avoiding crossing them was important to maintaining regional stability.


During his recent visit to Iran, he said, discussions had included ways to protect the Kurdistan Region in the event of renewed conflict between the United States and Iran.


The President of PUK said Iraq’s current Prime Minister was seeking to introduce fundamental changes and held no negative attitude towards the KRG.


“This is beneficial for the Kurds. Everyone in Kurdistan must understand that today’s circumstances are different from those in 2003 and 2004, when Iraq was weak and the Kurdistan Region was strong. Today, the situation is reversed: a strong and prosperous Iraq means a strong and prosperous Kurdistan,” he said.


Commenting on the agreement between the PUK and the New Generation Movement, he stressed that the understanding was genuine and could benefit the political process, including the KDP.


He said the agreement demonstrated that the largest opposition party recognised the current circumstances and was willing to contribute to forming the new government.


Talabani dismissed media reports suggesting that the PUK was misleading New Generation, describing such claims as unfounded.


“We are ready to reach any fair agreement to form the government, particularly as everyone acknowledges that the previous administration had numerous flaws and shortcomings,” he said.
