author: Angela Chukunzira
title: Governo do Quênia abre as portas para as Big Techs e população não tem acesso a acordos
content:
Esta reportagem foi produzida com o apoio do Pulitzer Center e faz parte da etapa africana da “Mão Invisível das Big Techs”, uma investigação transnacional liderada pela Agência Pública e pelo Centro Latinoamericano de Investigación Periodística (CLIP).


Quando uma empresa terceirizada que trabalhava para a Meta foi processada no Quênia, ela levou o problema diretamente ao presidente do país, William Ruto.


A disputa teve início em maio de 2022, quando o ex-moderador de conteúdo do Facebook Daniel Motaung processou a Sama e a Meta por causa das condições de trabalho. Em março de 2023, outros 43 moderadores também entraram com uma ação judicial. 


Os trabalhadores haviam sido contratados pela Sama para moderar conteúdo no Facebook, uma atividade que exigia que frequentemente entrassem em contato com materiais perturbadores. Eles argumentaram que a Meta, que se beneficiava diretamente do trabalho e controlava alguns de seus aspectos, também deveria ser responsabilizada.


A Sama não era uma terceirizada qualquer no Quênia.

A empresa fazia parte da cadeia de contratação que permitia à Meta transferir para trabalhadores quenianos algumas das tarefas mais nocivas da internet.

 A companhia de Mark Zuckerberg tentou retirar seu nome do processo, argumentando, entre outros pontos, que os tribunais quenianos não tinham jurisdição sobre a empresa norte-americana. Mas em 20 de setembro de 2024, o Tribunal de Apelação queniano rejeitou o argumento.


Em 11 de novembro de 2024, menos de dois meses após essa decisão, foi publicado o projeto de lei Business Laws (Amendment) Bill. A proposta estabelecia novas regras para o setor de terceirização no Quênia, incluindo disposições sobre a responsabilidade pelas condições de trabalho dos funcionários contratados por empresas terceirizadas.


Menos de um mês depois, em 9 de dezembro,

 o presidente William Ruto declarou publicamente que a Sama o havia procurado para tratar de seus problemas judiciais

: “Agora posso informar a vocês que mudamos a lei. Ninguém mais vai levar vocês à Justiça por nenhum motivo”.


Mas o projeto de lei ainda estava em tramitação no Parlamento, onde acontecia uma disputa sobre quem deveria ser responsabilizado pelos trabalhadores terceirizados. Organizações empresariais, entre elas a Associação de Fabricantes do Quênia,

argumentaram

 que a responsabilidade deveria permanecer, em grande medida, com a empresa terceirizada. 


Os trabalhadores do setor de tecnologia, por sua vez, defendiam que as empresas que controlam ou se beneficiam de seu trabalho também deveriam ser responsabilizadas.

 Essa questão foi fundamental para os trabalhadores que tentavam processar empresas como a Meta, em vez de responsabilizar apenas suas contratadas locais.


Membros do Africa Tech Workers Movement em coletiva de imprensa, em agosto de 2025, na qual manifestaram preocupação com o projeto de lei Business Laws (Amendment) Bill, de 2024


Os trabalhadores também recorreram à Justiça para tentar impedir a aprovação do projeto. Em junho de 2026, o Tribunal Superior se

recusou

 a intervir. Em 19 de agosto de 2026, a Assembleia Nacional aprovou as emendas.

O texto aguarda agora a sanção presidencial.


Para James Oyange, ex-moderador de conteúdo, a declaração do presidente Ruto deixou claro de que lado o governo estava. Os trabalhadores haviam recorrido à Justiça em busca de proteção contra algumas das empresas de tecnologia mais poderosas do mundo. Em vez disso, afirmou Oyange, o governo parecia estar mudando as regras em benefício dessas companhias.


“Estamos por conta própria.

É responsabilidade do governo nos proteger, mas ele está tomando o partido das Big Techs.

 Isso significa que as empresas podem fazer o que quiserem.”


Oyange teme que, se as empresas de tecnologia puderem recorrer ao governo quando forem processadas por trabalhadores, o desequilíbrio de poder se aprofunde ainda mais em detrimento dos funcionários.


Envio de dados da agricultura para a Microsoft  


O caso da Sama é apenas uma parte de uma relação muito mais ampla entre o governo queniano e as empresas globais de tecnologia.

O The Continent identificou pelo menos 12 reuniões, acordos, interações com órgãos reguladores e parcerias documentados publicamente entre o governo do Quênia e as empresas Microsoft, Google, Amazon, TikTok e Starlink desde 2023.


A reportagem também identificou um padrão nessas relações. Grandes empresas de tecnologia estão sendo incorporadas à prestação de serviços …

author: radical.guide
title: There are no natural disasters
content:
A hazard alone does not create a disaster. A disaster happens when a hazard meets exposure and vulnerability. Vulnerability is shaped by political, social, economic, and ecological conditions, including how communities are governed. To reduce disaster risk, address the conditions that make communities vulnerable in the first place.


From the "Mutual Aid Disaster Relief Search and Rescue" workshop at the 2026 International Workshops.


A Radical Guide is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that builds movement infrastructure, including a global directory of radical spaces, mutual aid programs, and educational resources for people doing liberation work around the world.

title: Beşli: Laz and Kurdish peoples fell victim to the same state mentality
content:
Laz Culture Association President and lawyer Mehmedali Barış Beşli said social peace in Turkey cannot be limited simply to an end to conflict.


Beşli said the Laz and Kurdish peoples have historically fallen victim to the same state mentality and stressed the importance of resolving the Kurdish question for Turkey. He said,  “Resolving this bleeding wound of our country is, above all else, extremely important.”


Beşli said building social peace requires a democratic legal order in which different peoples and identities can live together on the basis of equal citizenship.


Laz Culture Association President and lawyer Mehmedali Barış Beşli spoke to ANF.


What does “social peace” mean to you?


Social peace, for us, does not simply mean silencing the guns or a state of non-conflict; it means establishing the rule of law, justice and the principle of equal citizenship. As the Laz Culture Association, we believe social peace is possible only if the state establishes an equal relationship with all identities on a constitutional basis. Social peace is possible when the ethnic identities of the people of Turkey can coexist in both the public and private spheres, and when society as a whole regards this coexistence as a value.


If peace means not only silencing the guns but also ensuring that all different identities and cultures feel equal, where do the Laz identity and the Black Sea region stand in this process?


I would prefer to speak more specifically about Laz identity. The Laz Culture Association, with its modest presence, has contributed, even if only to some extent, to the democratization of Turkey.


Our country should be a place where all differences can exist equally in the public sphere and where no identity establishes hierarchical superiority over another. The Laz identity therefore positions itself within this peace equation as a direct advocate of the ideal of a democratic and pluralistic Turkey, defending its own cultural existence on the basis of the rule of law while standing alongside the struggles for rights of all other marginalized identities.”


According to United Nations/UNESCO reports, Laz is among the “endangered languages.” What are your expectations regarding constitutional or legal guarantees for mother-tongue rights as part of a possible social consensus?


UNESCO’s classification of Laz as an ‘endangered language’ shows that a part of humanity’s cultural heritage, and particularly that of our country, is under threat of disappearing. We do not choose our mother tongues. The mother tongue is a fundamental right that cannot be relinquished or deferred. As part of any possible social consensus, our first expectation would be for the state to take genuine action against the threat of the Laz language disappearing.


Without legal guarantees, we cannot save a language from the threat of assimilation through elective courses left to the discretion of the authorities or through merely symbolic steps. The state must fulfil its positive obligations to protect languages that are at risk of disappearing.


The Black Sea region is historically and politically perceived as a region where security concerns and nationalist reflexes are strong. How do you assess the local population’s approach to the discourse of peace and democracy, and what can be done to make peace part of social life in the Black Sea region as well?


I do not think the Eastern Black Sea region is very different from other parts of our country. For peace to take root in society in the Black Sea region, we need to build a system in which the law provides guarantees for everyone and resolve the economic and, particularly, ecological problems facing the region. In our view, ecology also encompasses language and culture.


How can a bridge of empathy and dialogue be built between people from the Black Sea region and Kurds?


As people of Turkey, these two cultures are already in contact and dialogue with one another. I do not think there is an absence of dialogue between them. Perhaps the two societies also share a common feature in being multilingual. Both peoples have fallen victim to the same monolithic state mentality. If we, as rights advocates, genuinely defend the rights of others rather than doing so merely for appearances, we will have gone beyond empathy and dialogue.


The Kurdish political movement frequently calls for “strengthening local governments.” How is this model viewed in the Black Sea region? As the Laz Culture …

title: Octobre 2010, il y a 16 ans, Geoffrey avait 16 ans, la police tirait déjà sur des enfants
content:
Voici une histoire qui dure depuis 16 ans.


16 ans, c'est aussi l'âge qu'avait Geoffrey lorsqu'il fut visé et touché en pleine tête par un tir de

LBD

 40, le 14 octobre 2010 à Montreuil, par l'agent de police Jean-Yves Césaire. Il intervenait avec son unité pour réprimer les blocages de lycées lors des mobilisations contre la réforme des retraites Fillon/Sarkozy.


Si Geoffrey a du mettre ses projets et sa vie d'adulte entre parenthèses, Césaire a conservé son boulot, n'a perdu aucun jour de salaire, il n'a pas été interdit d'exercer par la justice et pas davantage par son administration : se rendre coupable de faux en écriture lui a juste couté un conseil de discipline. Sanction : 5 jours d'exclusion temporaire…

AVEC


SURSIS

 

! Dès 2012, il avait été promu, nommé brigadier, comme son supérieur Landurain qui était passé brigadier-chef. En 2016, Césaire a été muté, à sa demande, en Guadeloupe, devenu chef d'unité avec douze agents sous ses ordres. Le combat est vraiment inégal, il faut s'y préparer.


Voilà les enjeux avant que ne s'ouvre cette nouvelle audience devant la cour d'appel de la chambre civile. Un premier rendez-vous avait été fixé en février 2026. Nouveau coup tordu : audience reportée, l'

AJE

 n'a pas rendu son mémoire à temps. Huit mois dans la vue.


Voilà où on en est.


Après avoir soutenu le flic en lui offrant la protection fonctionnelle, en l'ayant promu, muté, puis payé à sa place une petite partie des indemnités pour aller dans une cassation pourrie par son baveux Liénard, avec l'idée qu'il ne dénoncera jamais sa hiérarchie sur la question du faux et usage de faux en écriture publique en bande organisée, l'État, se croyant sorti d'affaire, le laisse tomber sur la question des indemnisations avec la complicité du tribunal de Bobigny.


Comble de tout, la victime se retrouve au côté du flic pour engager la responsabilité de la l'État concernant l'agression, la réelle cause des blessures de Geoffrey. Le tout dissimulé derrière son faux en écriture, condamné mollement par le tribunal et sauvagement récupéré par l'

AJE

 pour ne pas payer «

 

solidairement

 

» avec le policier mutilateur.


16 ans après, report après report, décision inique après décision inique, dégradation après dégradation, harcèlement après harcèlement, la justice nous a démontré qu'elle est minée par l'appareil policier, installé dans tous les rouages des institutions.


Si tout le monde déteste la police, tout le monde doit aussi détester la justice.


Le prochain acte se jouera le 13 octobre 2026, dans le vieux tribunal de l'ile de la Cité, à deux pas de la Sainte-Chapelle et de la préfecture de police. Ce sera 16 ans exactement après le tir qui lui a déchiré la vie. Ainsi Geoffrey, reconnu victime, a déjà passé la moitié de sa vie en procédure par les turpitudes de la police et de leurs petites mains trafiquant dans les tribunaux. Ce qui est le plus désolant, c'est qu'on a oublié Geoffrey, seul face à ces sordides procédés.


—


Geoffrey et ses proches n'appellent pas à venir en soutien au tribunal le 13 octobre, ils et elles n'en attendent rien et encouragent plutôt toutes celles et ceux qui le peuvent à soutenir les enfants qui se révoltent partout en ce moment, les jeunes gardé-es à vue dans les commissariats comme celleux qui sont jugé-es à la chaîne au tribunal judiciaire de la Porte de Clichy. Cette jeunesse qui doit encore et toujours affronter la férocité de l'État, de ses armes et de sa police.

content:
Tract diffusé à Rennes dans le mouvement lycéen


La vie qu'on nous promet est un cauchemar. L'école en est le début.


À la maison il y a les darons, à l'école il y a les profs, au taf il y a les patrons et dans la rue il y a les flics. Ils veulent qu'on baisse la tête, contrôler chaque moment de nos vies, nous dresser comme des animaux. 8H - 18H sous 40 degrés, tout ça pour rentrer dans le moule du bon citoyen, du bon travailleur, du petit soldat prêt à se sacrifier.


Au bahut on apprend à rester assis toute la journée en fermant sa gueule, à ingurgiter la propagande de l'État - travail/famille/patrie - aussi dégueulasse que la bouffe de la cantine. Dès le plus jeune âge on nous empêche de réfléchir par nous-même pour mieux nous conditionner à aller bosser. Et bientôt on devra marcher au pas derrière le drapeau bleu-blanc-rouge pour défendre les intérêts de ceux qui nous mènent à la guerre. L'école, apprend aux riches à devenir des cadres efficaces et aux pauvres à leur obéir sagement. À nous mettre en compétition les uns contre les autres, à gagner les meilleures place en écrasant les autres.


Et si on se révolte, qu'on refuse l'individualisme, la police attaque, mutile et la justice fout en taule. Déjà l'État fait des blessés graves, arrête en masse, colle des procès à tout va et menace de supprimer les aides sociales aux familles de ceux qui manifestent leur colère. Les syndicats et politiques cherchent à diviser le mouvement entre les revendications acceptables et ceux qui refusent l'immobilisme et luttent pleinement.


Alors voir des centaines de lycées bloqués, certains brûlés, des barricades enflammées, des condés qui se font bolosser, des pillages, des occupations, des feux d'artifices qui pleuvent, le son qui pète, des manifs sauvages, des gens qui débatent, qui s'organisent et refusent les leçons de morale, ça casse la résignation ambiante qu'on subit au quotidien. On devrait tous faire pareil...


Personne ne veut d'une vie de con, sans joie et dictée par Parcoursup.


La solidarité c'est ici et maintenant dans le mouvement.


C'est rejoindre les blocages et les actions dans la rue.


Qu'on soit au lycée, au taf, au chomâge, élargissons la révolte.

title: Bolu’da 10 Ekim anması: “Adalet mücadelemizden vazgeçmeyeceğiz”
content:
Bolu Emek ve Demokrasi Güçleri, 10 Ekim Ankara Garı Katliamı'nın 11. yılında yaptıkları açıklamada, saldırıda yaşamını yitirenleri anarak emek, barış ve demokrasi mücadelesini sürdüreceklerini belirtti. Açıklamada, katliamın tüm sorumlularının açığa çıkarılması ve ihmali olan tüm kamu görevlilerinin yargılanması çağrısı yapıldı.

10 Ekim 2015’te Ankara Garı önünde düzenlenen Emek, Barış ve Demokrasi Mitingi’ne yönelik IŞİD saldırısında yaşamını yitiren 104 kişi, katliamın 11. yılında anıldı. Bolu Emek ve Demokrasi Güçleri adına açıklamayı okuyan Bolu Eğitim Sen Şube Başkanı Dilek Çakman, aradan geçen 11 yıla rağmen acının tazeliğini koruduğunu vurgulayarak “10 Ekim’i unutmadık, unutturmayacağız” dedi. 10 Ekim'de yitirilen canların barış ısrarının takipçisi olunacağı dile getirildi.

Açıklamada 10 Ekim'in yalnızca bir katliam olmadığı, emeğinin hakkını isteyen; eşit, özgür ve demokratik bir ülkede yaşamak isteyen herkesin iradesine yönelmiş bir saldırı olduğu belirtildi.

Açıklamada, Türkiye'nin onlarca yıldır süren bir çatışmanın sona ermesi açısından tarihi bir eşikte olduğu belirtilerek silahların bırakılması ve çatışmaların durması yönünde atılan adımların ülkenin demokratik geleceği açısından önemsendiği ifade edildi. Ancak gerçek ve kalıcı barışın yalnızca silahların susmasıyla kurulamayacağına dikkat çekildi.

Kürt sorunu özelinde kalıcı barışın inkâr ve güvenlik politikaları yerine demokratik siyaset, eşit yurttaşlık ve temel haklar temelinde mümkün olduğu vurgulandı. Barışın demokratik ve eşitlikçi bir toplumun inşasıyla mümkün olabileceği belirtilirken, sürecin toplumun tüm kesimlerinin iradesine dayalı yürütülmesi gerektiği kaydedildi.

10 Ekim'de yaşamını yitirenlerin demokrasi, düşünce ve ifade özgürlüğü, örgütlenme ve toplanma hakkı ile eşit yurttaşlık için mücadele ettikleri hatırlatıldı. Katliamın, barış çağrısının en güçlü biçimde yükseldiği kitlesel bir mitingde gerçekleşmiş olmasının tesadüf olmadığı, emekçilerin barış ve demokrasi talebini susturmaya yönelik bir girişim olduğu belirtildi.

Halkın yoksullaştığı, gelir dağılımındaki adaletsizliğin arttığı, emekçilerin açlık sınırının altında yaşamaya mahkûm edildiği bir dönemde; itiraz eden herkesin terör ve düşmanlıkla yaftalandığı bir düzenin inşa edilmeye çalışıldığı aktarıldı. Bundan dolayı 10 Ekim'de katledilenlerin savunduğu demokrasi talebinin bugün daha güncel ve daha acil olduğu öne çıkarıldı.

Demokrasinin yalnızca seçimlerden ibaret olmadığına dikkat çekilen açıklamada, herkesin özgürce konuşabildiği, örgütlenebildiği, itiraz edebildiği, farklı kimliklerle eşit ve özgürce var olabildiği bir düzenin gerekliliği vurgulandı.

Katliamın üzerinden 11 yıl geçmesine rağmen adaletin tam anlamıyla sağlanmadığı, saldırının ardından yürütülen yargılama süreçlerinde bazı failler cezalandırılsa da katliamın arkasındaki asıl sorumluların korunduğu ifade edildi.

Güvenlik bürokrasisindeki ihmallerin, istihbarat bilgilerine rağmen önlem alınmamasının, denetim eksikliklerinin ve sorumlulukların yeterince aydınlatılmadığı savunuldu. Açıklamada, devletin kendi sorumluluğunu inkâr eden tutumunun, gelecekte yaşanabilecek benzer katliamlarda da sorumluluk üstlenmeyeceği anlamına geldiği belirtildi.

Katliamın tüm sorumlularının açığa çıkarılması ve ihmali olan tüm kamu görevlilerinin yargılanması için adalet mücadelesinden asla vazgeçilmeyeceği ve emeğin, barışın, demokrasinin egemen olduğu bir Türkiye'nin mutlaka kurulacağı vurgulandı.

Açıklama, “Yaşasın Emek, Barış ve Demokrasi Mücadelemiz” sloganıyla sona erdi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 11 octobre
content:
L'éphéméride des luttes du 11 octobre est partisane du sabotage, de la lutte radicale contre tout ce qui nous exploite et nous opprime, sans oublier les camarades que nous perdons dans cette entreprise difficile qu'est le fait de lutter pour la liberté.


1492 :

 Les navires de Christophe Colomb aperçoivent les côtes américaines pour la première fois.


1910 :

 Au dépôt de trains de Tergnier, plusieurs wagons et locomotives sont sabotés lors d'une grève des cheminots.


1914 :

 A Coimbra au Portugal, parution du premier numéro du journal anarchiste 'A Revolta', très largement dédié au refus de la guerre.


1954 :

 Pendant la guerre du Vietnam, le Viet Minh occupe le Vietnam du Nord.


1974 :

 A Londres, l'IRA pose des bombes dans deux lieux de loisir fréquentés par l'armée : le Victory, un club d'officiers de la marine, et le Army and Navy Club. Une personne sera blessée.


1977 :

 - A Rome, un groupe de jeunes est intercepté avec de nombreux cocktails molotov à proximité du siège de la Démocratie Chrétienne, le parti au pouvoir, et sont accusés d'avoir voulu l'incendier.


 A Turin, les Brigades Rouges tirent dans les jambes d'un chef de secteur de Fiat dédié aux négociations avec les syndicats.


1978 :

 A Naples, le groupe armé communiste Prima Linea exécute un criminologue qui travaillait dans la prison de Pozzuoli.


1981 :

 Dans le Tarn-et-Garonne, à Pont-Trescasses, l'entreprise Bourdet, qui travaille sur le site de construction de la centrale nucléaire de Golfech, perd des vélocompteurs, tandis qu'un transfo EDF de 20.000 volts est détruit. Revendiqué par des 'antinucléaires en colère' qui affirment : "

“Ce n'est pas un débat, continuons les dégâts

".


2011 :

 Début du campement de Occupy Oakland.


2013 :

 A Athènes, 'des incendiaires avec une conscience' brûlent une voiture du corps diplomatique en soutien aux prisonniers anarchistes et en mémoire de Pavlos Fyssas, rappeur antifasciste assassiné par les néonazis d'Aube Dorée.


2018 :

 Dans le 19ème arrondissement de Paris, une voiture de Vinci (constructeur de prison) et une autre de la SCNF (qui balance des sans-papiers)

sont brûlées

 en soutien aux anarchistes en prison.


Voir

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 11 octobre.

author: Kodao Productions
title: Tagle elected as first Asian Dean of College of Cardinals
content:
Filipino Luis Antonio Tagle had been elected as the Dean of the College of Cardinals of the Roman Catholic Church, the first Asian to be named to one of the world’s oldest bodies. He replaced the 92-year-old Italian, Cardinal Giovanni Battista Re who recently resigned from the post.


Tagle, 69, becomes

primus inter pares

 (first among equals) among the 152 cardinals in the global Church, one of the oldest and biggest religions in the world with 1.422 billion members. The appointment to the top-ranking position in the ecclesiastical hierarchy was announced on Friday.


As Dean, among Tagle’s primary responsibilities is to coordinate with brother cardinals and to preside over a papal conclave to elect a new Pope once the current one dies or resigns.


Who is Cardinal Tagle?


Born in 1957 in Manila, he is of Filipino, Spanish and Chinese descent from a middle class lineage. As a boy, he distinguished himself by earning scholarships in Catholic-run schools.


He was influenced by priests to enroll in seminaries and was ordained priest in 1982.


After earning his doctorate at the Catholic University of America in 1991, he was appointed as Bishop of the Diocese of Imus, and later Archbishop of Manila when he was elevated as Cardinal.


A polyglot, he is proficient in Filipino, Latin, English, Italian, Spanish, French, Korean, and Cantonese. He is often asked to represent the Pope due to his facility with global languages.


He was first appointed to a Vatican office by Pope John Paul II, and went on to serve in the Holy See under Popes Benedict XVI, Francis, and Leo XIV.


Prior to his election on Thursday, October 8, the Filipino had been heading the Church’s evangelization office. Previously, he was appointed to head the church’s social service arm Caritas Internationalis in 2015; as Prefect of the Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples in 2020; member of the Administration of the Patrimony of the Apostolic See that administers assets and central bank; among other important Vatican positions.


As a Cardinal-Bishop, Tagle hold the highest rank about the princes of the Roman Church, making him eligible for the election. There are only 12 Cardinal-Bishops in the Church.


Tagle is the first to serve under a reform edict by the late Pope Francis that Deans would no longer serve for life but for a five-year term and renewable only once.


Regarded as a Papabile (Italian for “able to be pope”) in the last two enclaves that elected Francis and Leo XIV, Tagle has become one of the top leaders of the two thousand year old church, along with the Pope and the Secretary of State of the Holy See (Vatican), Cardinal Pietro Parolin.


Glad tidings


Devout Filipino Roman Catholic and university professor Presto Suyat said Tagle’s assumption as the new Dean is “great news for the Philippines and the whole Catholic world.”


“It is a testament that he is performing well in various capacities in Vatican and continues to enjoy the respect and recognition of Pope Leo,” Suyat said.


Suyat agrees that Tagle’s election supports his chances of being elected to the papacy once Leo XIV’s reign ends. “As the new dean, it can make him more popular with all the cardinals of the world,”he added.


Journalist Marc Lino Abila said Tagle’s elevation to one of the Roman church’s highest offices inspires Filipino Catholics “to continue our mission of bringing Christ’s message of justice and peace to all.”


Abila said the development brings great honour to the Catholic Church in the Philippines and Asia. “The recent appointment is a testament of his commitment to the faith,” he concluded. #

(Raymund B. Villanueva)


 


The post

Tagle elected as first Asian Dean of College of Cardinals

 appeared first on

Kodao Productions

.

content:
By

Atty. Ephraim B. Cortez

 /

President,

 National Union of Peoples’ Lawyers


The Philippine Air Force (PAF) is lying to through its teeth in denying any involvement in the suspension of University of the Sto. Tomas (UST) student leaders Raven Racelis, Ralph Christian Manuel, Dex Andes Fogoso, and Sean Caparal.


Raven, Ralph, Manuel, and Dex were accused of violating the Code of Conduct and were suspended for ten days by the Office of Student Affairs (OSA).


The Philippine Air Force claims that the suspension of the four student leaders is an internal matter unrelated to its actions. But this is farthest from the truth. Records indicate that the PAF initiated the complaint, and the OSA inquiry relied primarily on its incident report. The disciplinary inquiry record cites the PAF’s involvement as the basis for the complaint. The opening statement of the OSA Resolution imposing the suspension states:


“This refers to two separate incident reports filed by the PAF Public Affairs Office (PAF) and Mr. David Nadora at the UST-OSA last 25 April 2026 and 28 April 2026, respectively. These incident reports stated the alleged violation of the University’s Code of Conduct by Ms. Raven Kristine Racelis, a second-year AB Philosophy student of the University, included in a group of students who participated in the PAF 79’h Anniversary Exhibit held at the Buenaventura Garcia Paredes, O.P. (BGPOP) on 21 April 2026.”


Evidently, the PAF’s incident report, which was treated as a complaint, initiated the investigation. As expected, the PAF is now trying to deny what happened. The denial is belied by the very resolution that imposed the penalty of suspension. The PAF is caught lying through its teeth.


More than the lying, this incident reveals how repressive our educational institutions can be. It highlights a tendency to discourage critical thinking and to be intolerant of dissent or different opinions.


Raven, Ralph, Manuel, and Dex were accused of violating the Code of Conduct after they asked critical questions at a PAF exhibit at the University of Sto. Thomas. Instead of just asking about the features and usage of the pieces of military equipment on display, they wanted to know if these pieces of military equipment were linked to reported human rights violations against civilians. These questions deserve honest answers and open discussion, since human rights affect everyone. But the air force personnel did not seem open to these questions. They are used to following orders without question in their own ranks, so they expect everyone else to do the same. They wanted the students to behave like soldiers in front of a military officer.


Interestingly, OSA, in the conduct of its investigation, acted more like an inquisition, instead of a student disciplinary body governed by the law, rules and regulations. It cited the bible to justify the imposition of the disciplinary measures against the student leaders. The concluding statement of the OSA Resolution, states:


“Disciplining a student would also serve as a deterrent to others who may be similarly minded. Proverbs 13:24 states ‘Whoever spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is diligent to discipline him.’”


Quoting the Bible does not change the fact that the school is trying to silence any dissent on campus. This is the message students are receiving. Such actions go against rights protected by the Constitution. Raven and others are being punished for defending these rights. Being assertive does not make them rude. It shows they understand their rights and have the courage to stand up for them. Even the Supreme Court has said that student leaders are “hardly timid” and are effective because they are “likely to be assertive and dogmatic.” In Malabanan vs. Ramento, G.R. No. L-62270, May 21, 1984, the Supreme Court held:

author: Unknown
title: Fact-checking : l'audiovisuel public est-il une annexe du Ministère de l'intérieur ?
content:
Une célèbre affiche de mai 68 proclamait «

 

la police vous parle tous les soirs à 20h

 

». En 2026, l'

ORTF

 n'existe plus et le monopole de l'audiovisuel public sur l'information accessible a volé en éclat. Mais on pourrait actualiser cette affiche pour évoquer le traitement médiatique du mouvement lycéen.


La télévision et la radio publiques, ainsi que leurs sites web apparentés, montrent des poubelles qui brûlent sans expliquer pourquoi, invitent des lycéen-nes ou des témoins de moralité présenté-es comme neutres alors qu'iels sont apparenté-es à la droite ou à l'extrême droite,

interviewent les lycéen-nes indépendant-es ou de gauche de manière agressive

. Leurs journalistes se donnent aussi beaucoup de mal pour minimiser ou justifier les violences policières. Et si on fact-checkait le journalisme du service public

 

?


Le fact-checking est une pratique journalistique qui s'est répandue dans les rédactions dans les années 2010. Elle consiste à prendre un fait ou un énoncé, le plus souvent une déclaration politicienne, pour en vérifier l'exactitude. Bien souvent, ça donne des articles sur le modèle scolaire thèse («

 

pourquoi c'est plutôt faux

 

»), antithèse («

 

pourquoi c'est plus vrai

 

»), synthèse («

 

pourquoi la vérité est au milieu

 

»). Comme les journalistes n'ont pas le monopole des plans en trois parties, on s'y adonne en amateur et on applique aujourd'hui cette méthode à la question «

 

l'audiovisuel public est-il une annexe du Ministère de l'intérieur

 

?

 

»


Pourquoi c'est plutôt faux


Le Ministère de l'intérieur est Place Beauvau, dans le 8

e

 arrondissement de Paris. Le siège de Radio France est avenue du Président-Kennedy, dans le 16

e

. Celui de France Télévisions est esplanade Henri de France, dans le 15

e

. Cette analyse géographique montre que les sièges de l'audiovisuel public et du Ministère de l'intérieur ne sont pas au même endroit. L'audiovisuel n'est donc au sens strict pas une annexe du Ministère de l'intérieur.


Pourquoi c'est plutôt vrai


Mais quel est donc l'intention de ces policiers

 

?


Prenons quelques exemples parus dans le cadre du mouvement lycéen. Et pour commencer, fact-checkons les fact-checkeurs. Mercredi 7 octobre,

France 3 Hauts-de-France

 a publié

un article signé Léo Marron

 intitulé «

 

Mobilisation lycéenne : une voiture de la police nationale a-t-elle foncé sur un groupe de manifestants à Dunkerque

 

?

 

». Le titre est assorti d'une illustration sur laquelle on voit une personne courir devant un 4x4 beige siglé Police Nationale qui lui fonce dessus. Mais on ne peut pas être sûr de ce qui se passe à ce stade, car peut-être s'agit-il simplement d'un policier en voiture qui se rapproche d'un jeune pour lui demander l'heure ou s'il a besoin d'eau.


Le chapeau de l'article précise «

 

Une vidéo largement relayée sur les réseaux sociaux montre un 4x4 de la police nationale se diriger à vive allure vers un groupe de lycéens, lundi 5 octobre à Dunkerque. La scène a suscité de nombreux commentaires indignés. Nous avons vérifié les images avec le service Les Révélateurs.

 

» Les Révélateurs, c'est le service de fact-checking maison, gage d'une analyse on ne peut plus sérieuse.


Après quelques lignes descriptives, l'article présente une première vidéo où l'on voit des lycéen-nes qui courent effrayés parce qu'un 4x4 leur fonce dessus à vive allure. Le 4x4, qui traine des objets (une poubelle

 

?) sous son par-choc, tourne à droite dans une autre rue, fonçant toujours sur les lycéen-nes. Au milieu du chaos, un lycéen laisse échapper un «

 

fils de pute

 

» qui pourrait sembler anodin, mais pas pour nos journalistes à qui rien n'échappe, on y reviendra. La vidéo continue, le 4x4 fait marche arrière puis demi tour et fonce de nouveau sur les lycéen-nes.


Les paragraphes qui suivent donnent lieu à des descriptions minutieuses dans lesquels on mesure toute le professionnalisme de Léo Marron, qui précise : «

 

Le véhicule percute une barrière de chantier et un plot, sans que l'on sache à ce stade s'il a été placé là par les manifestants.

 

» Et c'est vrai que c'est une bonne question. Savoir qui a placé ces objets là change totalement la lecture de la scène.


Bien sûr, on a le droit à des interviews contradictoires. L'une avec la présidente de la

LDH

, Emmanuelle Jourdan-Chartier. Et l'autre avec une syndicaliste policière, en l'occurrence Anouck Fourmigué, secrétaire générale adjointe du Syndicat des …

title: Agenda cultural, segunda semana de octubre
content:
Manifiesto Monstruo. Obra solista de Daniel Ojeda, se puede ver en el Festival: Al finsolos, en Aérea Teatro, Bartolomé Mitre 4272.


Esta semana nos llevó puestos. Entre movilizaciones, marchas, fallos y contramarchas,

volaron los días

. La constancia, aunque a deshora, nos sostiene. Un montón de discos que se presentan. Un festival de

solos de danza

  y

 8(ch0)

, en Aérea Teatro

.

Tertulias eróticas

, en versión cyborg.  Norman Briski sigue con

Piedra Libre

, su último trabajo. Fernando Peña continúa el cine en fílmico todos los martes. Tenemos el bolsillo más flaco que nunca, las ganas a veces desahuciadas, pero salir nos fortalece. Ocupemos las calles. Hay mucho para ver/ escuchar/ hacer gratuito y a precios módicos. R

ecorré nuestra agenda. Armá un plan. Organizate. Elegí compartir cultura. Si tenés propuestas, podés enviarlas a nuestor mail: culturasanred@gmail.com. Revisam

os la casilla hasta el lunes previo a la publicación.

Por ANRed.


Viernes 09


Mala Madre. 

Una obra documental sobre maternidad, duelo y deseo. Relato de una madre que atravesada por la muerte temprana de su hermano, revisa su historia personal para poner en crisis los mandatos, culpas y contradicciones que rodean a la maternidad. A partir de su historia personal y de material audiovisual registrado durante años, la pieza indaga en las zonas menos idealizadas de maternar. Laa obra abre una conversación íntima y colectiva. Protagonizada por la multipremiada actriz 

Raquel Ameri

 y con dirección de 

Paola Luttini.

Se estrena el viernes 4 de septiembre 22.30 HS en Nün Teatro Bar (Juan Ramírez de Velasco, 419, CABA). 

Entradas por Alternativa.

 (Hasta el 30 de octubre)


Cementerio Club.

Lanzamiento de un nuevo sello discográfico que tiene como fin resucitar joyas perdidas. Buenos Aires y Berlín se unen para crear Cementerio Club de la mano de Jay Low. Un nuevo sello que contará con un catálogo atemporal, haya nacido en un estudio casero de los años ochenta o en uno digital del presente. Aquí, su primer lanzamiento: «Trulepa» de Mimilocos, grabado en 1986 y prácticamente inhallable durante casi cuarenta años.

A todo el disco aquí.


Annemarie

.

 El documental de 

Mariana Sanguinetti

, bisnieta de la fotógrafa 

Annemarie Heinrich

, se sumerge en la vida y obra de esta pionera, autora de algunos de los retratos más emblemáticos de la cultura nacional. A través de su archivo, testimonios familiares y la obra de Heinrich, la directora emprende una búsqueda que trasciende el retrato de una artista para convertirse en una reflexión íntima sobre la memoria, la familia, el paso del tiempo y la propia mirada. Una película sobre una fotógrafa, pero también sobre los vínculos que construyen una vida. Estreno en

MALBA Cine

, en octubre.


Piedra Libre: Una razón escondida

. Queda lejos Gaza… la dignidad está lejos, qué tan cerca los mapuches, cerca como lo atómico… y el horizonte está dando la vuelta, está en la espalda el horizonte como indiferencia. La brújula loca tiene Norte por Sur y la segunda guerra sigue haciéndose tercera. ¡Tendremos la otra cara de la luna! Con la otra como llegada de todas las novedades. Y ruedan las monedas, maldición esta arca de Noé. A la cara de Franklin se le cae el rayo de su cometa y el verde es de papel ¿Y ese hombre soterrado? Camina entre las raíces del oasis…  Piedra buena es insultado como escombro y habla totalmente, absolutamente, habla por sordo. Sordo por el estruendo de los misiles que entraron por su oreja. Y canta porque cantó y ríe porque rió. Inevitable la razón, pierde su vigencia y el olor de la destrucción de los cuerpos queridos se acerca tanto a los sentidos que podemos ser estrellas. (Sustancia es el desayuno). Tienen modos que no tenemos que esperar. Ese hombre buscó profetas y ninguno se mueve de sus estatuas entonces por buscar comida inventa desayunos de media lunas. Voces de siempre del otro hemisferio arrojan envases cúbicos de frutales y cereales y melones pelados y un poncho incari. Se cierra la escotilla con el suspiro del aire. Dice: “hay otra madre, hay otros hermanos, no es magia del engaño, son los que saben que los vivos van a cuidar la inocencia. Escrita y dirigida por

title: Kocaman şehirde yalnızlığa itilmek:'Emekçiler neden sürgüne mahkum?
content:
Şehir kocaman, üç metrekarelik bir odaya sığan ve bir galaksi gibi sonsuz*

İçinde yaşadığımız şehir Octavio Paz’ın şiirinde bahsettiği gibi pek çoğumuzun zihninde hem 3 metrekarelik bir oda ile hem de amansız imkanları ile özdeşleşen bir mefhumdur. Peki bu mefhumun gerçek sınırları nerede başlar ve nerede biter? Şehirde herkesin düşlediği gibi bir rotaya bağlı kalması mümkün müdür yoksa hayat bazıları için sadece 3 metrekarelik odanın peşinde geçen bir ömürken bazıları için ise bir galaksi sınırsızlığında şeyler mi sunar? Şüphesiz bu soruya bugünün ve dünün gerçekliği ile baktığımızda salt romantik bir yanıt veremeyiz. Şehirde yaşanan gerçekliği görebilmemiz için, şehrin kaosunu yaratan temel koşuşturmalar arasındaki sınıfsal farkı görmemiz gerekmektedir. Bugün o sınıfsal farka odaklandığımızda; şehirdeki kaosun bir tarafında gerçekten daha ucuza 3 metrekarelik odalar bulmak için koşuşturanlar, bir tarafta ise şehrin nimetlerini hiçbir sınır olmadan tüketebilenler karşımıza çıkar.

Türkiye’de pandemi sonrasında yaşanan fahiş kira artışları ve kiralık ev bulma rutininde yaşanan zorlaşma; şehir merkezlerinde hiç olmadığı kadar keskin bir kırılma hali yaratıyor. Özellikle büyükşehirlerde hasbelkader bir mahalleye yerleşmiş ve senelerdir aynı muhitte hayatını sürdüren insanlar için; içinde yaşadıkları mahallenin tüm avantajları değişen ekonomik koşullar ile birer dezavantaj olma noktasına evrilmiş durumda. Eskiden iş yerine yakın yerlerde mahalle inşa eden veya kiralık ev bulmaya çalışan emekçi sınıflar, artık mevcut kiraların maddi yükünden biraz olsun sıyrılmak için merkezden uzaklaşma seçeneği ile hayat planları arasında bir denge kurmaya çalışıyor. Bu hali yaratan iki temel döngü ise emekçi sınıfların hayatında ciddi şekilde bir seçim yapma zorunluluğu yaratıyor. Bunlardan ilki; merkezi muhitlerde yaşayan emekçi ailelerin evlerinin depreme dayanıksız olması hasebiyle kentsel dönüşüm uygulamasına katılması ve geçici süre ile evleri inşa edilene kadar farklı bir noktada barınma ihtiyacının ortaya çıkması. İkinci durum ise doğrudan merkezi alanlardaki pahalılıktan kaçarak şehrin çeperlerinde yer alan ve şehrin asıl kimliği ile özdeşlemeyen alanlara doğrudan yönelim. Bugün İstanbul açısından bakacak olduğunuzda iki temel döngü de şehir yaşamını biçimlendiren ve şehrin makro formuna etki eden bir gerçekliğe dönüşmüş durumdadır. İstanbul gibi eski bir imparatorluk merkezinde emekçilerin yaşadığı ilçe ve semtlerin, neredeyse İstanbul ile alakası olmayan yeni kentleşme alanları olması bu yüzden tesadüf değildir. İstanbul’da işçilerin yoğun olarak yaşadığı ilçelere baktığımızda hem Avrupa hem de Anadolu yakasında, sürekli olarak daha da uzağa meyleden ilçe sınırları ve yeni konut alanları projeleri görmemiz de bu yüzden bir artık kabul edilmiş bir trende dönüşmüştür. Kent merkezlerinde barınamayacak şekilde yalnız bırakılan emekçi aileleri; Beşiktaş ve Kadıköy gibi ilçelerde yaşamak yerine Esenyurt ve Ümraniye gibi ilçelerde yaşamaya bir noktada mecbur hale gelmişlerdir. Yani İstanbul’da emekçilerin 3 metrekarelik bir odada daha ucuza oturmak için şehrin bütün albenisinden uzaklaşması ve kendine izole bir yaşam sürmesinden başla bir seçenek bırakılmamaktadır. Emekçi sınıflar kağıt üzerinde hiçbir zorlama olmadığı görülen fakat sınıfsal olarak neredeyse sopayla kovalandıkları bir şekilde, yeni emekçi muhitleri oluşturmak adına şehir merkezinden uzağa sürülmektedir adeta.

Bu savımıza ev sahibi olan işçi sınıfı mensuplarının da olduğu ve herkesin aynı koşulları paylaşmadığı savı ile itiraz edenler olacaktır muhakkak. Fakat bu noktada da devletin yaşanan bu barınma krizi-iç göç kaosu dengesini yönetebilmek için attığı adımların keskinliğine bakmamız yeterli olacaktır. Bugün İstanbul’da ev alabilme fırsatı olan bir emekçi ailenin bu evi alabileceği semtler az çok bellidir. Neredeyse herkesin hemfikir olacağı şekilde hiçbir emekçi, Bebek’te, Boğaz şeridinde bir ev alamaz. Kaldı ki artık günümüzde emlakçıların bile ev gezdirmek için randevulu ve ücretli çalıştığı bir evrende, eve bakmaya bile gidebilmesi bir emekçi için mucizedir. Bu noktada devlet, sınıfsal olarak yönünü belirlediği suyun akışına inşaat endüstrisi ve sermayesinin bütün açlığı ile müdahale etmeye başlar. Bir emekçinin ev alabileceği yeni nesil işçi mahallesinde eli yüzü düzgün apartmanlar birbiri ardına inşa edilmeye başlanır, kat sayıları artar, bir anda nüfusu ikiye katlanan ilçeler peydah olur. Devletin bu noktada aldığı sorumluluk, kent merkezi ile bağı …

author: Unknown
title: Ücret kiraya, hayat borca: İkitelli'de işçi ailelerin konut çıkmazı
content:
İkitelli sanayi bölgesinde çalışan işçi aileler için barınma sorunu, yalnızca kira ödemekten ibaret değil. Dar ve kalabalık evler, güneş görmeyen bodrum katları, küf, geçim sıkıntısı ve biriken borçlar, gündelik yaşamın parçası. Üç işçi kadının anlattıkları, ücretleriyle insanca yaşam koşullarını karşılayamayan ailelerin konut sorununu ortaya koyuyor.

Depo işçisi Leyla, eşi ve çocuklarıyla birlikte 1+1 bodrum katındaki bir evde dört kişi yaşıyor. Güneş almayan, küflü evde çocuklarının hastalanmasından endişe ediyor. Ailenin 60 bin lira kredi borcu bulunuyor. Okul alışverişiyle aylık mutfak masraflarını karşılamakta zorlanan Leyla için çocuklarının sağlığına ilişkin kaygılar, geçim derdiyle iç içe geçmiş durumda.

Leyla’nın evinde çocukların yalnızca sağlıklı bir ortamda yaşaması değil, ders çalışabilmesi de sorun. Dört kişinin yaşadığı 1+1 evde çocukların rahatça ders çalışabileceği ayrı bir alan bulunmuyor. Güneş almayan, küflü bodrum katında yaşamaya çalışan aile, bir yandan çocukların sağlığından endişe ederken diğer yandan onların eğitim ihtiyaçlarını karşılamakta zorlanıyor.

Dilem ise eşi ve iki çocuğuyla 2+1 evde yaşıyor. Ailenin tek çalışanı olan eşi, aylık 50 bin lira ücret alıyor. Bunun 25 bin lirası kiraya gidiyor. Böylece ücretin yarısı, daha diğer temel ihtiyaçlar karşılanmadan konut giderine ayrılıyor. Biri küçük, diğeri okula giden iki çocuğun ihtiyaçları için geriye kalan parayla geçinmeye çalışan aile, yüksek kira karşısında bütçesini denkleştirmekte zorlanıyor. Sonuç yine kredi kartlarının bitmeyen taksitlerine çıkıyor.

Dilem’in kaygıları da evin duvarlarıyla sınırlı değil. Çocuğunun okulunda yaşanan sorunlardan endişe duyduğunu anlatan Dilem, artık hayatın ve sokakların da yaşanmaz hale geldiğini söylüyor. Barınma, geçim ve çocukların geleceğine ilişkin kaygılar birbirine eklenirken işçi aileler, yalnızca bugünü değil, çocuklarının nasıl bir yaşam süreceğini de düşünmek zorunda kalıyor. Ailesinin geçimini tek başına sağlayan işçiler için bu yük daha da ağırlaşıyor; artan yaşam maliyetleri karşısında hem evin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak hem de çocuklarına daha iyi koşullar sunmak giderek zorlaşıyor.

Tekstil çalışanl Fatma, eşi, annesi, babası, kayınvalidesi ve okula giden çocuğuyla birlikte altı kişinin yaşadığı 2+1 evde, üç yıldır ailenin tek çalışanı. Eşi hasta olduğu için çalışamıyor; kendisi de sağlık sorunları yaşıyor. Buna rağmen ailenin geçimini tek başına üstlenmek zorunda. Yaklaşık 30 yıllık binada yaşayan Fatma’nın ailesinin borçları da bulunuyor.

Geçimlerini sürdürebilmek için borçlanmak zorunda kalan aile, kamu desteğine ulaşamayınca tefecilerden borç alıyor. Fatma, başvurularına rağmen belediyeden üç yıl içinde yalnızca 5 bin lira yardım alabildiğini anlatıyor. Düzenli gelir güvencesinin bulunmadığı, sağlık sorunlarının da çalışmayı güçleştirdiği koşullarda borç, ailenin yaşamını sürdürebilmesinin bir aracı haline geliyor.

Üç kadının anlattıkları, konut sorununun işçi aileler açısından kira bedeliyle sınırlı olmadığını gösteriyor. Ücretin önemli bir bölümünün kiraya ayrılması, kalabalık ve sağlıksız konutlarda yaşamayı zorunlu kılması, çocukların ihtiyaçlarını karşılamayı güçleştirmesi ve aileleri borçlandırması, barınma koşullarını doğrudan bir geçim sorununa dönüştürüyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Елена Моргунова смогла покинуть Россию
content:
После «карусельных арестов» по сфабрикованным обвинениям Елена Моргунова, жена либертарного художника Павла Крисевича, смогла покинуть Россию. Об этом сообщает No Future.

«Дали три дня на отъезд. Сказали, что меня задержали потому я жена Паши», — рассказала Моргунова обстоятельства своего освобождения.

История началась в августе, когда Лена прилетела из Парижа в РФ, чтобы навестить родных и оформить документы на перевозку собаки. В Скопине Рязанской области силовики буквально сняли её с пригородного автобуса вместе с мамой и собакой. Под угрозами запереть мать и выбросить собаку на улицу фсбшники вымогали пароли от телефонов, а затем впаяли 10 суток ареста.

На этом беспредел не закончился: прямо на выходе из спецприемника силовики запустили «карусель». Мусора заявили, что у Лены якобы «расширены зрачки», и за отказ проходить освидетельствование без адвоката закинули её обратно в одиночную камеру ещё на один срок. Все это время Лена держалась стойко, пока на воле её муж Павел Крисевич и адвокат Леонид Соловьёв подтягивали правозащитников и информационную поддержку.

Павел Крисевич написал в своём канале: «Всем огромное спасибо за поддержку и огласку, без этого всего Лене и мне было бы гораздо тяжелее. Сейчас у нас будет продолжаться тяжёлый эмоциональный период, но я уверен, что мы справимся, ведь сейчас над нами хотя бы не весит угроза новых Репрессий.»

title: Antifada - émission d'idées autonomes. Episode 9
content:
à écouter ici :

https://www.rdwa.fr/Productions/antifada-episode-9/


Bonsoir,


après cet été de nouveau caniculaire,


des phrases dans nos rues, des affiches déters avec la mention «

 

plus de canadairs moins de millionnaires

 

».


Une émissions de radio pseudo révolutionnaire en tournée à huit clos au théâtre des aires.


Des cendres dans l'atmosphère, du tourisme sans eau dans les rivières, des histoires de guerres,


de monté en l'air des droites réactionnaires, du prix de la bouffe, de l'essence et de la vie de plus en plus chère.


La colère monte dans les lycées, le gilet jaune se ré-invite à l'Élysée.


Il est grand temps d'arrêter de subir, temps, de s'unir pour résister.


Nous ne manqueront plus d'air sous les genoux de la répression policière.


Nous ne lâcheront rien face à l'avenir, face aux menaces des filières identitaires.


La résistance reste en place, l'autogestion s'organise, tout feux tout flamme.


Sans jeux de mots et sans état d'âme, il est 20h en ce premier mercredi de chaque mois, jour de la sirène d'alarme.


Jour où malgré le vacarme, il est temps d'ouvrir les yeux et les oreilles.


La dystopie sans pareil, l'intelligence artificielle, les enjeux d'avenir, de fascination de la fascisation générale.


Siamo touti antifascisti

 

!


Antifada reviens sonner le glas sur les ondes de Rdwa.


Reste à l'écoute, mobilise toi, le feu était là et il reviendra.


L'avenir sera ce que l'on en fera.

!

title: Comme des éclaircies dans les nuages de lacrymos
content:
Un texte à imprimer et diffuser sous forme de tracts, en solidarité avec les révoltes en cours.


(Les pdf sont en bas de l'article)


Comme des éclaircies dans les nuages de lacrymos


La révolte est partie d'un lycée

 de banlieue parisienne mi septembre, et s'est étendue en traînée de poudre, devant les bahuts et dans les rues. Les blocages et les barricades se sont fait écho en solidarité à travers tout le territoire dominé par l'État Français, en métropole comme dans les "anciennes" colonies (

DOM

-

TOM

).


On sort à peine d'un été passé à suffoquer de la catastrophe écologique en cours, pendant que le fascisme et la guerre nous sont matraquées comme seules perspectives d'avenir.

 Alors c'est clair que ça fait une grosse bouffée d'air de voir ce refus et cette rage sortir,_et les désirs d'un autre monde s'exprimer

 

!


Les raisons de se révolter sont déjà là et s'accumulent, depuis bien trop longtemps.

 Cette fois, la tempête n'a pas attendu une nouvelle loi ou un nouveau meurtre policier auquel réagir pour se déclencher. Le pire qu'on nous promet est déjà là. Et c'est pas celles et ceux qui nous ont foutu dans cette merde (ou leurs pseudos-adversaires politiciens) qui vont nous en sortir_

 

!


Le pouvoir flippe de ce vent d'insoumission de la jeunesse qu'il n'avait pas vu venir,

 et qui prend des formes bien plus difficiles à contrôler que les défilés tout bien encadrés et muselés de ses partenaires syndicaux. Et on espère qu'ils ont raison d'avoir peur_

 

! :)


Bon nombre de lycéennes et lycéens revendiquent leur autonomie, refusent la récupération des politiciens de tout bords, et s'auto-organisent pour faire vivre leurs luttes, qui sont bien plus larges et profondes que la question des conditions matérielles dans les lycées.


Face à ces imaginaires qui ouvrent tant d'autres possibles, l'État met les moyens pour refermer la brèche et forcer tout le monde à rentrer dans ses rangs.

 En interdisant jusqu'au matériel de protection face aux armes de la police, le message est clair.


La machine Police/Justice joue son rôle habituel pour défendre ce système_ : des milliers d'arrestations, des mutilations, des enfermements et des condamnations pour traumatiser les corps et les esprits. Tout ça entouré de discours dégueulasses, remplis d'un mépris adulte, bourge, raciste et sexiste (entre autre).


Les récupérateurs sont appelés à la rescousse pour recadrer la lutte en manifs pacifistes, en revendications avec des "représentants" (et autres petits-chefs) du mouvement qui dialogueraient avec l'État.


Et pour légitimer la répression, tout le monde devrait se désolidariser des actes qui ne rentrent pas dans le cadre de contestation toléré par le pouvoir.


Mais de quelle violence on parle_

 

?


Ce système qui détruit la vie et écrase tout sur son passage ne va pas s'arrêter avec des pétitions et des bulletins de vote.


Alors oui c'est beau et inspirant ce débordement.


Et ça donne de la force_

 

!


Ça fout la patate de voir ce soulèvement qui répond à d'autres à travers le monde ces dernières années, et par delà les frontières meurtrières que ce système nous impose.


Ca fait plaisir de voir des moments ou les oppositions mensongères entre «

 

_gentils-manifestants-lycéens-légitimes_

 

» et «

 

_méchants-casseurs-extérieurs_

 

» volent en éclat.


Ça fait du bien de voir ces joies sur les visages, des élans euphoriques sur les barricades enflammées entre 2 battles de danses, des cours en visio sabotés par des cris ininterrompus, des «

 

_Siamo tutti antifascisti_

 

» et «

 

_A Bas l'État, les flics et les fachos_

 

» repris en cœurs, comme de l'entraide et de la prise de soin au milieu des affrontements avec les keufs.


Quand des portes solidaires s'ouvrent pour planquer des personnes pourchassées ou blessées par les flics, que des voisin.e.s filent des bouteilles d'eau ou des masques par les fenêtres, et que des meufs et des queers sont présent.e.s en nombre, déters et solidaires dans les émeutes.


…


On dirait que ça ne va pas être si simple que prévu de mettre en place leur grand plan national de militariser la jeunesse

, et la faire tranquillement mourir au service de l'État et du Capitalisme… Le chef des armées françaises dit que le pays doit être prêt à «

 

accepter de perdre ses enfants

 

», nous on lui répondrait plutôt d'aller crever tout seul au front si il tient tant à sa guerre_

 

!


Ces derniers jours, et sans rien attendre de personne, une partie de …

author: groundxero
title: এসআরএফটিআই-তে ধর্মঘটকারী পড়ুয়াদের সঙ্গে সাক্ষাতে নারাজ উপাচার্য, আক্রান্ত ছাত্রদেরই শো-কজ, অচলাবস্থা কাটাতে চেয়ারপার্সন-এর হস্তক্ষেপ দাবি
content:
৯ অক্টোবর, শুক্রবার, কলকাতার এসআরএফটিআই-এ এক সাংবাদিক সম্মেলন করেন ছাত্র ইউনিয়নের সদস্যরা। তারা জানান হিন্দুত্ববাদী দুষ্কৃতিদের প্রতিষ্ঠান ও পড়ুয়াদের উপর হামলার দায় উপাচার্যকে নিতে হবে এবং অবিলম্বে পড়ুয়াদের নিরাপত্তা সুনিশ্চিত করতে হবে।


 


সুদর্শনা চক্রবর্তীর

 প্রতিবেদন


 


“

আমরা ক্লান্ত, মানসিক চাপের মধ্যেও আছি আর চাপটা আসলে কর্তৃপক্ষের উপরে নয়, আমাদের উপরেই আছে আমাদের কোর্সটা ভালোভাবে সময়ের মধ্যে শেষ করার, আমরা সেটাই করতে চাইছি। কিন্তু ভবিষ্যতে আবার একই ঘটনার পুনরাবৃত্তি হতে পারে। আমাদের জানতে হবে তা প্রতিরোধে কী পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া হচ্ছে। কারণ আমরা এরজন্য কর্তৃপক্ষকেই দায়ি করব,” বলছিলেন এসআরএফটিআই-এর ছাত্র ইউনিয়ন-এর সভাপতি ব্লসম। হঠাৎ করে এই প্রতিষ্ঠানটিই কেন নিশানায়? ব্লসম-এর বক্তব্য, ২৯ সেপ্টেম্বর-এর ঘটনা না ঘটলেও কোনো না কোনো সময় এই আঘাত আসতই। “এটা ফিল্ম ইন্সটিটিউট। এখানে মুক্তচিন্তা চলে, আমরা ফিল্মমেকার্স। কখনো না কখনো এমন সিনেমা এখানে তৈরি হতই, দেখানো হতই, যা এদের অস্বস্তিতে ফেলত। ২৭ তারিখ না হয়েও অন্য যেকোনো সময়েই তা হতে পারত। আর এটা এমন একটা প্যাটার্ন, যার পুনরাবৃত্তি সারা দেশ জুড়ে হয়ে চলেছে,” বললেন তিনি।


 


“

আমরা এবার চাই এস আরএফটিআই-এর চেয়ার পার্সন সুরেশ গোপী আমাদের সঙ্গে কথা বলুন। এই প্রতিষ্ঠানের এগজিকিউটিভ কাউন্সিল, গর্ভনিং কাউন্সিল, সোসাইটি আছে। আমরা চাইছি তাঁরা সকলে এই বিষয়ে নিজেদের মতামত দিন ও এক্ষেত্রে সদর্থক ভূমিকা নিন। উপাচার্য আমাদের সঙ্গে কোনো রকম কথা বলতে চাইছেন না। আমরা দেখা করার সব রকম চেষ্টা করে ব্যর্থ হয়েছি। উনি গত ৮ অক্টোবর আমাদের সঙ্গে কথা বলার শেষ সময় দিয়েও আর দেখা করেননি,” বক্তব্য এসআরএফটি আই-এর ছাত্র ইউনিয়ন-এর। 


 


৯ অক্টোবর, শুক্রবার, কলকাতার সত্যজিৎ রায় ফিল্ম অ্যান্ড টেলিভিশন ইন্সটিটিউট (এসআরএফটিআই)-এ শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠানের সামনের রাস্তায়, মূল ফটকের সামনে খোলা আকাশের নীচে এক সাংবাদিক সম্মেলন করেন এসআরএফটিআই-এর ছাত্র ইউনিয়নের সদস্যরা। বক্তব্য রাখেন ব্লসম, শুভম, সুদীপ, অনামিকা, পূরবী। তাঁদের মধ্যে অনামিকা গত ৪ অক্টোবর হিন্দু জাগরণ মঞ্চের এসআরএফটিআই-তে মিছিল করে এসে হিংসাত্মক আক্রমণে আহত হয়ে মাথায় চোট পান। একই সঙ্গে কেরালার এক ছাত্রও সেদিন হাতে চোট পান। তিনি নিজের বাড়িতে গিয়ে চিকিৎসা করাতে চান জানালে কর্তৃপক্ষ জানায় তিনি কলকাতায় থেকে চিকিৎসা করালেই তাঁর চিকিৎসার খরচ প্রতিষ্ঠান বহন করবে নতুবা নয়। 


 


এদিনের সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে ইউনিয়ন-এর ছাত্ররা জানান, উপাচার্যর কাছে ৪ তারিখের ঘটনার পর তাঁরা যে দাবিগুলি রেখেছিলেন, যার মধ্যে অন্যতম ছিল পড়ুয়াদের উপর ২৭ সেপ্টেম্বর মূল অডিটোরিয়ামে আরএসএস সমর্থিত অখিল ভারত গ্রাহক পঞ্চায়েতের অনুষ্ঠানে ধর্মীয় উস্কানিমূলক বক্তব্য ও এই প্রতিষ্ঠানে নীতি বর্হিভূতভাবে রাজনৈতিক সংগঠনের অনুষ্ঠানের বিরূদ্ধে পড়ুয়াদের প্রতিবাদকে কেন্দ্র করে তারপর থেকে বিজেপি- আরএসএস ও হিন্দুত্ববাদী দুষ্কৃতিদের প্রতিষ্ঠান ও পড়ুয়াদের উপর হামলার দায় উপাচার্যকে নিতে হবে এবং অবিলম্বে পড়ুয়াদের নিরাপত্তা সুনিশ্চিত করতে হবে। কারণ ৪ অক্টোবরের মিছিলের আগাম খবর থাকায় পড়ুয়ারা উপাচার্য, সংশ্লিষ্ট সব কর্তৃপক্ষকে এমনকি মন্ত্রককে আগাম জানালেও তাঁরা কোনোও ব্যবস্থা নেননি। উপরন্তু পড়ুয়াদের শান্ত থাকতে বলা হয় ও সেই নির্দেশ মানার পরেও এক নাগাড়ে হিংসার শিকার হন তাঁরা। 


 


৪ তারিখ উপাচার্যকে ঘেরাও করেন পড়ুয়ারা। পেশ করেন দাবিপত্র। যেখানে অন্য বেশ কিছু দাবির সঙ্গে ছিল উপাচার্যের ক্ষমা চাওয়ার কথাও। কিন্তু ৪ থেকে ৮ তারিখ পর্যন্ত একবারও উপাচার্য পড়ুয়াদের সঙ্গে দেখা করেননি। মেনে নেননি তাঁদের দাবি মতো এফআইআর ও তারপরে চার্জশিট দাখিল করা, সাংবাদিক সম্মেলন করার কথাও। বরং এরপর তিনি পড়ুয়াদের বিরূদ্ধেই শো-কজ নোটিস জারি করেন। এমন অনেক পড়ুয়া যাঁরা সেদিন ঘেরাওতে উপস্থিত ছিলেন না, কলকাতার বাইরে ছিলেন তাঁদের কাছেও শো-কজ নোটিস যায়। 


 


সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে পড়ুয়ারা কয়েকটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয়ের দিকে দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করেন।


  


৪ অক্টোবরের ঘেরাওয়ের সময় থেকে যা আগে কখনোও হয়নি, এসআরএফটিআই-এর এক বড় সংখ্যক কর্মী ছাত্রছাত্রীদের বিরূদ্ধে চলে গিয়ে ঘেরাও তুলে নেওয়া, শারীরিকভাবে জোর-জবরদস্তি করা, এমনকি বহু ভাষাভাষী পড়ুয়াদের একটি শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠানে বাংলা ভাষাই বলতে হবে এমন কথাও বলতে শোনা যায় তাঁদের, যা আগে কখনোই হয়নি।


 


উপাচার্য শুধুই ধর্মঘট ও ক্লাস বয়কট তুলে নিয়ে ক্লাস চালু করে দিয়ে সকললে স্থিতাবস্থা বজায় রয়েছে এমনটি দেখাতে চাইছেন এবং তারজন্য ক্রমাগত পড়ুয়াদের উপর চাপ সৃষ্টি করে চলেছেন, তাঁদের সঙ্গে দেখা না করে।


 


পড়ুয়দের নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত না করেই, প্রতিষ্ঠানের বাইরে কাছাকাছি অঞ্চলে যে ছাত্রছাত্রীরা থাকেন, তাঁদের জন্য যে বিশেষ শাটল পরিষেবা চালু করা হয়েছিল, তা বন্ধ করে দেন এবং যুক্তি দেওয়া হয় যে পরিস্থিতি শান্ত ও নিরাপদ তাই এই পরিষেবার আর প্রয়োজন নেই।


 


যাদের থাকার ব্যবস্থা নেই তাদের অবিলম্বে হোস্টেল, বা গেস্ট হাউজ বা ক্যাম্পাস-এর ভেতরে নিরাপত্তার খাতিরে থাকার ব্যবস্থা করতে হবে। 


 


খুবই সাদামাটা ও দায় এড়ানো একটি বিবৃতি প্রকাশ করা হয় ও এফআইআর নয়, সংশ্লিষ্ট থানায় নেহাতই একটি সাধারণ অভিযোগ দায়ের করা হয়।


 


পড়ুয়াদের তরফে এদিন বারেবারেই বলা হয় যে, ক্লাস বয়কট করা বা ক্লাস কও৩রতে না পারায় তাঁদেরই সমস্যা, অসুবিধা সবচেয়ে …

author: groundxero
title: প্রতিবাদের অধিকার; অধিকার কেড়ে নেওয়ার বিরুদ্ধে প্রতিবাদ
content:
সরকারের বিরুদ্ধে সাধারণ মানুষের ক্ষোভ আজ দেশব্যাপী এক গণ-আন্দোলনে পরিণত হয়েছে। ভারতের ঔপনিবেশিকতা বিরোধী স্বাধীনতা আন্দোলনের পরম্পরাই তো অহিংস গণ-আন্দোলনের মাধ্যমে রাস্তার, গণ-পরিসরের দখল নিয়ে ক্ষমতাকে প্রশ্ন করা, অন্যায়ের প্রতিবাদ করা। কিন্তু, স্বাধীনতা আন্দোলনে যাঁদের ন্যূনতম অংশগ্রহণ ছিল না, ছিলেন দখলদার শক্তির অনুগ্রহভাজন, তাঁরা শান্তিপূর্ণ, অহিংস আন্দোলনের ঐতিহ্য বুঝবেন না।


 


শুভজিত সিংহ


 


The right to protest is not dependent on government approval

– Amnesty International


 


গান্ধির জন্ম জয়ন্তীতে (২ অক্টোবর ২০২৬), দেশের রাজধানীর কেন্দ্রস্থিত যন্তর-মন্তরে কোনও নাগরিক জমায়েত করতে দেওয়া হল না, কয়েকদিন আগেই সে তথ্য সংশ্লিষ্ট অঞ্চলের পার্লামেন্ট ষ্ট্রীট থানায় জানানো সত্ত্বেও। সে অঞ্চলে দিল্লি প্রশাসনের তরফ থেকে ভারতীয় নাগরিক সুরক্ষা সংহিতার ১৬৩ ধারা (পূর্বতন সিআরপিসি ১৪৪ ধারা) জারী করে, জমায়েত নিষিদ্ধ করতে জারী করে দেওয়া হয়েছিল। ইতিপূর্বে, ভিন্নমত দমনের উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি রাষ্ট্রের এই স্বৈরাচারী কৌশলকে ব্যর্থ করার চেষ্টা করেছে তরুণদের এই আন্দোলন।


 


পরদিন থেকে, নাগরিক সমাজসহ প্রায় সমস্ত বিরোধী রাজনৈতিক দল ধারাবাহিকভাবে, রাস্তায় নেমেছেন। বিরোধী সাংসদরা মিছিল করে নির্বাচন কমিশন যাবেন ঘোষণা করেছিলেন, তাও বাতিল করা হয়েছে। ১০ই অক্টোবরে (২০২৬) ছাত্র-যুবদের সদ্য গঠিত ককরোচ জনতা পার্টির আহ্বায়িত জমায়েত নিষিদ্ধ তো করা হয়েছেই, সেই সঙ্গে ট্রেন, মেট্রো, বাস বাতিল করে, দূর পাল্লার ট্রেন মধ্যপথে রুখে দিয়ে, রাস্তায় রাস্তায় ব্যারিকেড করে, হাজার, হাজার সশস্ত্র বাহিনী মোতায়েন করে, সাধারণ মানুষের গতিবিধি নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে, প্রত্যেক হোটেল, অতিথিশালা, ছাত্র হস্টেল, অন্যান্য অতিথি আবাসগৃহ তল্লাশি করে, শহরের সমস্ত রেসিডেন্সিয়াল অ্যাসোসিয়েশনকে দিয়ে রাস্তায় না বেরনোর নোটিশ করিয়ে, প্রত্যেক মহল্লায় অধিবাসীদের অতি প্রয়োজন ছাড়া রাস্তায় বেরনোর নিষেধাজ্ঞা জারী করে, দিল্লির নাগরিক জীবনের উপর সীমাহীন নির্যাতন নামিয়ে আনা হয়েছে। ইতিমধ্যে, ৯ তারিখ রাত থেকেই, ইউনিয়ন সরকারের গৃহমন্ত্রক দিল্লিতে ইন্টারনেট স্তব্ধ করে দিয়েছে। সরকারের বিরুদ্ধে সমালোচনা, প্রতিবাদ রুদ্ধ করতে, সাধারণ মানুষের বিরুদ্ধেই অঘোষিত যুদ্ধ ঘোষণা করেছে সরকার। এসবই, সরকারের বিরুদ্ধে বিরুদ্ধ মত, সমালোচনা রুদ্ধ করতে।


 


১০ তারিখ (২০২৬) দিল্লি সাক্ষী থাকল বিরুদ্ধ মত, সমালোচনা দমনের পুলিশি দুর্গের, যা ছিল স্বাধীনোত্তরকালের এক  অভূতপূর্ব নিদর্শন। কেন্দ্রস্থল থেকেও বহুদূর পর্যন্ত শহর থাকল ঘেরাটোপে বন্দী। আটক হলেন সমস্ত দলের সব ধরণের নেতা। কিন্তু তবু, শহর দেখল অনিঃশেষ জনস্রোতের ঢেউ। সে ঢেউ রোখার সাধ্য যেমন ব্রিটিশ পুলিশের হয় নি, বর্তমান জমানার বাহিনীও ব্যর্থ হল।


 


আজই (১০ অক্টোবর ২০২৬) ভারতে বিক্ষোভ ও নির্বিচার ধরপাকড়ের বিষয়ে জাতিসঙ্ঘের মানবাধিকার বিষয়ক মুখপাত্র থামিন আল-খিতানের এক প্রেস বিজ্ঞপ্তির মাধ্যমে বলেছেন, দিল্লিতে আজ অনুষ্ঠিত ব্যাপক বিক্ষোভের আগে ও চলাকালীন সময়ে বিক্ষোভকারী, আন্দোলনের নেতা, সুশীল সমাজের প্রতিনিধি, আইনজীবী এবং সাংবাদিকদের গণহারে আটকের খবরে আমরা উদ্বিগ্ন। সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষের প্রতি আমরা আহ্বান জানাই যেন শান্তিপূর্ণ সমাবেশের অধিকারের প্রতি পূর্ণ সম্মান প্রদর্শন ও তা নিশ্চিত করা হয়। শান্তিপূর্ণ বিক্ষোভে যেকোনো ধরনের বিধিনিষেধ অবশ্যই প্রয়োজনীয়তা ও আনুপাতিকতার কঠোর মানদণ্ড অনুযায়ী হতে হবে। শান্তিপূর্ণ বিক্ষোভকারীদের মোকাবিলায় আইন-শৃঙ্খলা রক্ষাকারী বাহিনীকে সর্বোচ্চ সংযম প্রদর্শনের বিষয়টিও কর্তৃপক্ষের নিশ্চিত করা উচিত। খেয়ালখুশিমতো বা নির্বিচারে আটককৃত সকলকে অবিলম্বে ও নিঃশর্তভাবে মুক্তি দিতে হবে।


 


বিকেলে (১০ অক্টোবর) অন্যতম বিজেপি নেতা, রবিশঙ্কর প্রসাদ সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে এসে বললেন বিক্ষোভকারীরা দেশে নাকি, বৈদেশিক হস্তক্ষেপের মাধ্যমে অরাজকতা সৃষ্টি করছেন। রবিশঙ্কর বলেন “তাঁরা বার বার বলছেন

আমাদের প্রতিবাদ করার অধিকার রয়েছে—যা সংবিধানের ১৯ নম্বর ধারার ২ নম্বর উপধারায় বিধৃত। তবে, যদি আপনি দেশের নিরাপত্তা বা ক্ষতির কারণ হতে পারে এমন কোনো বিষয়ে প্রতিবাদ করেন, তবে আপনার সেই অধিকার সীমিত বা সংকুচিত করা হবে।

(বার বার কহা রহে হ্যায় সংবিধান, সংবিধান; হামে রাইট টু প্রোটেস্ট হ্যাঁয়, সংবিধান কী ধারা ১৯ কী ক্লজ ২ মে প্রাবধান হ্যায়, কী, অগর আপ দেশ কী সুরকসা, হারমোনি ইত্যাদিওঁ কা বিরোধ করতে হ্যাঁয় তো আপকো উহ্ অধিকার কো নিয়ন্ত্রিত্, সীমিত্ কিয়া জায়গা….)।” যদিও সে অভিযোগের স্বপক্ষে কোনও প্রমাণ দেন নি, যা কোনও দিনই তাঁরা দেন না। তাঁর বক্তব্য কী পুরোপুরি সঠিক?


 


ভারতের সংবিধানের পাতা উল্টোলেই দেখতে পাওয়া যাবে, অনুচ্ছেদ ১৯(১) (ক) এবং (খ) অনুযায়ী মতপ্রকাশের অধিকার, নিরস্ত্র ও শান্তিপূর্ণ জমায়েতের অধিকার মৌলিক অধিকারের মধ্যে পড়ে, এ ক্ষেত্রে অবশ্য সরকারের কিছু নিয়ন্ত্রণ আরোপ করার ক্ষমতা আছে। সংবিধানেরই ১৯(৩) অনুচ্ছেদে, সরকারকে শান্তিপূর্ণ জমায়েতের অধিকার নিয়ন্ত্রণ করার এক্তিয়ার দেওয়া হয়েছে মাত্র তিনটি ক্ষেত্রে– দেশের সার্বভৌমত্ত্ব, সুরক্ষার প্রশ্নে এবং জন-শৃঙ্খলা রক্ষার জন্য। তবে, সেই আরোপ করা বিধি-নিষেধ অবশ্যই যৌক্তিক হতে হবে (Reasonable restriction)।


 


কোনও জন-পরিসরে পূর্ব নির্ধারিত একটি শান্তিপূর্ণ, নিরস্ত্র, অহিংস প্রতিবাদী জমায়েতের বিরুদ্ধে কী করে জন-শৃঙ্খলা …

author: Unknown
title: KNK calls for urgent action against environmental destruction in Southern Kurdistan
content:
The Environmental Commission of the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) has strongly condemned the systematic destruction of forests and natural habitats by the Turkish military in Southern Kurdistan. In view of the ongoing deforestation in the Turkish-occupied border regions, it is calling for international investigations and decisive action by the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG). The commission described the destruction as ecocide aimed at permanently destroying Kurdistan’s natural foundations of life.


Satellite images document forest destruction


The statement comes in response to recent reports on the scale of environmental destruction in Duhok province. Comparisons of satellite images from twenty areas document changes in forest cover between 2013 and 2023. Particularly affected are the mountainous regions around Zaxo and Amêdî in Behdînan, where forests have been cleared and roads and military bases constructed in the course of the Turkish occupation. The images illustrate the extent to which the Turkish military presence has altered the landscape. In addition to the clearing of large forest areas, the transport of timber to Turkey and the destruction of other natural habitats have repeatedly been documented.


Kurdistan’s identity is being erased


According to the KNK, Turkey’s occupation policy extends far beyond the military control of areas near the border. "It is directed not only against Kurdistan’s territory and natural resources, but, through the systematic destruction of forests and woodlands, also aims to erase the ecological identity of the region," the KNK commission said, describing these actions as a serious violation of international agreements and calling for urgent countermeasures.


Call for international investigation and clear stance from the Regional Government


In a five-point appeal, the KNK called on international human rights and environmental organizations to break their silence and immediately launch investigations into environmental crimes in the border regions of Southern Kurdistan. The appeal was also directed at the Kurdistan Regional Government and all political forces, which, it said, must take a clear stance against the Turkish occupation and the destruction of nature. The commission warned against contributing to the continuation of environmental destruction through inaction. “Silence in the face of ecocide is a serious offense,” the statement said.


The KNK also said that the media bear responsibility. It urged journalists and news organizations to increase their coverage of the ecological consequences of Turkish military operations and, in particular, to draw international attention to the burning and clearing of forests.


Call for civil society resistance


The Environmental Commission called on Kurds and environmental activists worldwide to raise their voices against the destruction of nature in Kurdistan. It stated that protecting forests, trees and natural habitats is a shared social responsibility. “Protecting Kurdistan’s environment and trees is a moral and national duty for everyone. The systematic destruction must therefore be stopped through all forms of civil society protest," the statement said.

author: Unknown
title: Seriously ill prisoners Orak and Karsu must be released
content:
The Prison Commission of the Istanbul branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD) held the 759th of its weekly “F Sitting” protests in front of the association’s building in Beyoğlu.


The protest highlighted the health condition of Abdulhalik Orak (52), an ill prisoner held in Kırıkkale F-Type Prison. Attended by numerous human rights defenders, the demonstration featured a banner reading “Release ill prisoner Abdulhalik Orak”, while slogans were chanted including “Release ill prisoners”, “Treatment is a right and cannot be obstructed” and “Isolation kills, solidarity keeps people alive”.


The Initiative for Freedom for Sick Prisoners also gathered on Sakarya Street in Ankara for the 631st week of its protests. The demonstration drew attention to the health condition of seriously ill prisoner Botan Karsu, who is being held in Van High-Security Closed Prison.

author: Unknown
title: Protest against drugs in Şirnak
content:
The Şirnak Democratic Institutions Platform issued a press statement to draw attention to the increasing use of drugs and substance addiction.


Representatives of political parties, democratic mass organisations and many others attended the press conference, which was held on Sanat Street in the Silopi (Silopya) district of Şirnak. A banner reading “We are determined to combat drug use” was displayed, and the press statement was read out by Ziynet Şimşek, a member of the Silopi Municipality Council.


Saying that the rise in drug use and substance addiction in the city was a serious problem affecting all society, Ziynet Şimşek added: “One of society’s most significant problems in recent times has been the increase in drug use and substance addiction. We therefore need to address this issue seriously and take the right steps to resolve it.


Substance addiction is not a problem limited to those who use these substances. It affects families, young people, children and society as a whole. The oppression and exploitation of women and children are also connected to this problem. Furthermore, the widespread availability of drugs not only harms individuals’ health but also affects society’s safety, peace and future. This situation poses a serious problem, particularly for our young people and the future of our society.”

author: Unknown
title: Bayındır: The only way to bring this process to success is to organise and unite
content:
The Democratic Regions Party (DBP) held a public meeting in the Alucar neighbourhood of the Karayazı (Qereyazî) district of Erzurum under the slogan “We are building the promise of peace with the people”. DBP Co-Chair Keskin Bayındır, Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) Colemêrg MP Onur Düşünmez and many others attended the meeting.


Keskin Bayındır said that, for the first time in history, a Kurdish movement had held official-level talks with the state over its own status, demonstrating that the Kurds had become a force. He continued: “That is why, despite all the uncertainty and concerns, we are not afraid of negotiations. Just as we were not afraid 45–50 years ago when we rose up in the mountains against oppression, today we are not afraid to sit at the negotiating table. From now on, we will continue our struggle through democratic politics, taking it into a new phase in accordance with the spirit and requirements of this new process.”


Bayındır added: “We are following all the statements being made. Some people comment that ‘the Kurds have abandoned the struggle’, either because they do not understand the situation or because they approach it with hostility. Yet, at the stage we have reached today, the Kurdish people have established their existence beyond any ambiguity. The fundamental issues before us now are our freedom and our status. From this point forward, we will achieve this goal through the struggle for democracy. The only way to bring this process to success is to stand together, organise and unite.”


Speaking at the gathering, one citizen said: “For more than two years, Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan has been leading a process. The Kurdish Freedom Movement has fulfilled its responsibilities. However, the state has taken no visible, tangible steps. So why are our political prisoners still not free? Why has Mr Selahattin Demirtaş not been released, despite the rulings of the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR)?”


Another citizen criticised the state’s description of the Peace and Democratic Society Process as “Terror-Free Türkiye”, saying: “A process has been initiated. All wars end in peace. But why are the terms ‘terror’ and ‘terror-free’ still being used? Everyone should know that the Kurdish people are not terrorists. We are disturbed by this terminology.”


Another citizen asked, “What gains does this newly enacted law offer the Kurdish people? We do not know. The Kurds are not being informed. What did 12,000 young people give their lives for? In my opinion, this law is a lie, a law designed to deceive us.” Another citizen added: “There is nothing inside this framework law. The framework is completely empty.”
